chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 640: Zhou Zhiruo of Yitian and the Dragon Slayer
paragraphs: This is just Ding Ling’s speculation.
As for the specific facts, Ding Ling is also unaware.
He casually placed the knife and sword into the storage pouch.
Then he used the Dragon Capturing Skill, gathering Vigorous Qi, and turned over Pojun’s jacket from a distance.
Sure enough, something was flipped out.
It was a key resembling the other half of a swastika shape.
Ding Ling accepted the half that Wuming handed over.
The two halves combined to form a swastika.
As soon as the swastika key formed.
From the key shot out a ray of light, landing on the top of the cave wall, and then after several reflections and refractions, crack!
In the depths, it’s as if a crisp sound was heard.
Then Ding Ling saw a Secret Manual, glowing with gold, slowly descending from the void.

Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly, he originally thought he would have to use Secret Skills like Array Dao, mechanisms, and Stargazing to find this Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root Secret Manual, but now it seems Pojun’s arrival was just in time.
He used the Dragon Capturing Skill to grab the Secret Manual mid-air, unexpectedly, a graceful figure suddenly floated out from the depths of the cave.
This person’s hand speed was in no way inferior to Ding Ling’s!
And even better due to its suddenness!
Thus, with a flicker, snap!
The Secret Manual of Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root was taken.
Wuming was a bit stunned, how is there one more person?!
Previously with Pojun, everyone did not expect anyone here, so it can be considered a sudden event.
After Pojun’s incident, everyone, including Ding Ling, carefully sensed here, and did not find any suspicious traces. How did this person appear?!
Ding Ling was also moved, and fixed his gaze.
He saw that the owner of the graceful figure had landed, smilingly looking at Ding Ling.
This is a young girl of sixteen.

Slender figure, blue dress trailing, as clear as water, elegantly refined, charmingly unique, ethereal like a celestial, as if embodying Zhong Ling of Han River and elegance of Emei, like a Celestial Being!
This kind of orchid-like purity, extraordinary and refined woman, truly rare in the world, could be said to be equally matched with Zhao Min, hard to distinguish superiority!
Little Zhao is not mature yet, but if she were, she could perhaps rival this girl.
"Zhou Zhiruo!"
Little Zhao seems to recognize the person, couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Zhou Zhiruo?!"
Ding Ling was surprised, Zhou Zhiruo from Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber World?! When did Zhou Zhiruo’s skills become so advanced?! This is a bit contrary to common sense!
"So this little girl’s name is Zhou Zhiruo?"
The young girl smiled brightly, her voice like beads and pearls dropping onto a jade plate, extremely pleasant:
"It’s a pleasant, beautiful name. But little girl, I’m not called Zhou Zhiruo."
"Then who are you?!
Little Zhao flustered, stepped back, hid behind Ding Ling, poking her head out, looked puzzled:
"I know Zhou Zhiruo. Clearly you are her, how could you not be her?!"
"I am Bai Suzhen."
The young girl said quietly to herself:
"I am known to the world as the Demon Lord!"
"The wife of the Immortal God!"
Wuming looked amazed, shocked:
"How are you still alive?!"
"Why shouldn’t I be alive?"
Bai Suzhen glanced at Wuming, her smiling face suddenly turned serious, said:
"Besides, I am at odds with the Immortal God. I am no longer his wife. Wuming, please do not be so rude in the future, otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude."
"I don’t care who you are. Return the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root Secret Manual to me."
Ding Ling reached out.
"What if I don’t give it to you?"
Bai Suzhen tilted her head, looking at Ding Ling, her radiant and captivating face full of curiosity:
"Do you want to fight me?"
Ding Ling’s corners of the eyes twitched twice.
This Demon Lord Bai Suzhen is already an old monster, yet she behaves so pure and innocent, it can only be said her acting skills are first-class, Ding Ling, noncommittal, said:
"You possessed Zhou Zhiruo! Hiding here, just for this Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root?"
Ding Ling wanted to get a clear understanding of Bai Suzhen’s background.
"I did not possess Zhou Zhiruo."
Bai Suzhen’s expression solemn, said indifferently:

"When I met Zhou Zhiruo, she was already dead. Seeing her natural talent and resemblance to me in appearance, I naturally chose her body as a vessel. You should know, ordinary bodies, I would not fancy. Zhou Zhiruo can gain my recognition, enough to prove her excellence, but alas, she’s dead, if not, I might have taken her as a disciple."
"Zhou Zhiruo is dead?"
Little Zhao was somewhat dazed.
But Ding Ling was relieved.
Daisi is dead.
For Zhou Zhiruo to be dead is not unexpected.
The martial power of the Lower Realm compared to Wind and Cloud World is quite different.
If one is not careful, caught in a battle of masters, just the aftershocks are enough to severely injure them!
How exactly Zhou Zhiruo died?
Ding Ling didn’t know, but surely it must have been a calamity. Just like Little Zhao and Daisi, if not for Ding Ling intervening, Little Zhao would certainly be dead by now.
Little Zhao clearly thought the same, couldn’t help feeling more determined to strive and master Supreme Divine Skill!
"By the way, I didn’t come here for Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root."
Bai Suzhen raised the Secret Manual in her hand, smilingly looked at Ding Ling:
"I came for you, Ding Ling!"
"For me?"
Ding Ling was surprised:
"I don’t seem to have met you before."
Demon Lord Bai Suzhen, an unrivalled genius.
Created the Six Great Demonic Crossings!
Among them, the Rebirth Crossing can achieve soul transfer, which is similar to the divine technique of possessing others’ bodies!
This is Ding Ling’s fragmentary information gathered from comics, etc.
It’s just unknown what the real situation is.
"You haven’t seen me. But I have seen you from afar several times."
Bai Suzhen said with amazement:
"I must say, your rapid growth rate is indeed somewhat incredible! In my opinion, whether this world can be reshaped depends on you."
"Reshape the world?"
Wuming looked bewildered.
"Yes."
Bai Suzhen looked up at the Celestial Palace:

"Two months ago, I experienced a devastating battle. My body was shattered, fell to the earth, if it weren’t for my own Six Great Demonic Crossings being truly extraordinary. This time, I would be dead."
Ding Ling said nothing.
Wuming was puzzled:
"Demon Lord, an extraordinary genius, insights into creation, your strength must have long reached the Shattered Realm, who can destroy you?"
"I don’t know who it is."
Bai Suzhen pointed to the sky:
"But I know, he is certainly watching us from above!"
Ding Ling was moved.
Wuming was staring, becoming more suspicious:
"Who could be watching us from above?"
"Perhaps they are real Gods and Demons, maybe."
Bai Suzhen sighed:
"Once thinking myself invincible in the world, could rely on the Six Great Demonic Crossings to achieve immortality. But unexpectedly, I, Bai Suzhen, in some people’s eyes, am merely a grasshopper."
She paused suddenly, her eyes shining brightly towards Ding Ling:
"I came here to see how your Divine Skill methods measure."

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 641: Ding Ling vs. Demon Lord
paragraphs: Bai Suzhen placed the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root into her bosom, and forcefully sent a palm towards Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, let me test your skills!"
Bang!

She struck out with her palm, and an Extreme Cold True Intent coalesced into an Ice Nether Hand! This hand was as unpredictable as the Void Nether, akin to ethereal clouds, swiftly reaching towards Ding Ling’s chest, with chill breath swirling wild, seeming to freeze everything.
Ding Ling did not dodge nor evade, his eyes shining as he glanced twice, surprisingly countering with an Ice Nether Hand of his own.
Boom!
The two hands fiercely collided in mid-air, like two bolts of lightning meeting, rumbling thunderously, after a brief confrontation, they both dissipated and scattered.
"How do you know the Ice Nether Hand!"
Bai Suzhen was astonished.

But thinking that many others knew the Ice Nether Hand, she assumed it was passed down by others, and, without further thought, countered with a finger of Fire Thunder Gang Qi piercing towards Ding Ling.
This Fire Thunder Gang Qi was indeed the Divine General’s Supreme Skill.

Bai Suzhen knowing the Divine General’s Supreme Skill was not surprising to Ding Ling at all, after all, the Divine General was a disciple under the Immortal God, and Bai Suzhen had once been wed to the Immortal God, knowing these skills was quite normal.
Moreover, the World-Ending Demon Body was passed from Bai Suzhen to the Divine General, indicating her martial skills were extremely vast.
Clang clang clang!

The Fire Thunder Gang Qi in Bai Suzhen’s hands was tens of times stronger than the Divine General, akin to light and electricity, swiftly shooting towards Ding Ling like a meteor falling from the Nine Skies, a trail of sparks and lightning.

Ding Ling did not look long at Bai Suzhen’s Fire Thunder Gang Qi method, instead he activated the Breathing Technique, Divine Form Power, Ten Directions Invincible Power, and punched heavily at the Fire Thunder.
Ten Strong Martial Dao!
Mountain and Sea Fist Scripture: Fist Overturning the World!
Once this punch was released, a fist intent surged like the ocean, threatening to annihilate and crush all of Jiuzhou!

The gathered fist light was vast, fierce, swift, with a roaring sound it heavily clashed with the Fire Thunder Gang Qi, Bang! It shattered the Fire Thunder Gang Qi in an instant, subsequent residual power was unabated, surging like an unstoppable force, shooting towards Bai Suzhen like lightning.
Bai Suzhen gasped in shock, hurriedly dodging, whoosh whoosh!
Her Lightweight Skill was outstanding, stepping on a whirlwind, evading the punch in a whoosh, boom!

The fist light brushed past Bai Suzhen, falling into the cave, carving through the mountain like a heavenly tornado, with a thunderous drilling sound, forcibly boring out a tunnel dozens of meters long.
It was indeed a punch that blasted apart the mountain’s side of the cave, using brute force to create a path through the mountain!
"What a strong punch."
Bai Suzhen was moved, becoming cautious, loudly saying:
"The quality of this cave is quite nice, but at this rate, I’m afraid it cannot withstand the might of our battle. We should fight outside.
Upon saying this.
She flashed out of the cave.
Ding Ling closely followed.
Wuming and Little Zhao exchanged glances, and also went after them.
The two did not dare get too close, watching the battle from afar.
Seeing Ding Ling and Bai Suzhen soar into the sky after leaving the cave, exchanging blows back and forth, rapidly bringing the battle to a fever-pitch state.
One’s punch seemed like Mount Tai pressing down; the other’s palm like a frozen sea overturning the Celestial Extreme;
One’s Fierce Strong Leg Technique, furiously trampling mountains and rivers, amidst Star Shifting, each leg seemed capable of crushing Heaven and Earth;
One seemed able to wield Infinite Power, dark clouds forming beneath, with the Power of Wind and Cloud, swirling the sky-high unchanging clouds, shapeless wind, forming into a sweeping dark storm!
Both were exceedingly formidable.
Each move.
They shook Heaven and Earth!
Where they passed, trees fell, grass bent, mountains collapsed, debris flying!
Little Zhao glanced for only a moment before feeling dizzy, unable to withstand it, not daring to watch further.

Wuming, despite reaching the Celestial Sword Realm, if purely competing in strength, felt self-consciously inferior to Ding Ling and Bai Suzhen, secretly clicking his tongue in amazement and admiration:

"Bai Suzhen has lived a long time, her power is so high, it’s understandable, Ding Ling is still so young! Already possessing such profound strength, really remarkable! What’s most admirable is he can fight against someone like the Demon Lord, whose skill rivals creation, and battle experience so rich, proving his match! No..."
Wuming watched for a while, his pupils tightening:
"It seems Bai Suzhen is about to lose!"
Bai Suzhen indeed was about to lose!

Her newly ’inhabited’ body, although extraordinarily gifted, had its Eight Extraordinary Meridians quickly cleared, mastering two Unparalleled Divine Skills, Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, World-Ending Demon Body!
Even the Six Great Demonic Crossings were inscribed into this body.
But ultimately the time of coupling was too brief.
Unable to mold this body into a true Shattering Level strong person of the Supreme realms ’Water and Fire Invulnerability’ ’Invulnerable’.
Thus.
Even when she used her self-created Earth-level Infinite Power!
Activated the Power of Wind and Cloud.
Her Martial Arts Cultivation tenfold amplified, she was still oppressed by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling thirtyfold amplified, fighting beyond his level as if it was trivial!
Bai Suzhen, merely at the Peak of Shattered Initial Tier, approaching Middle Tier of Shattering, how could she withstand the crush of thirtyfold amplification power?
Ding Ling, each punch and kick seemed capable of shaking wind and cloud, splintering mountains!
Though Infinite Power was extremely strong, once Ding Ling drew his saber, slicing out the No-Two Blade Technique’s Sky Dome Fury, he still shattered the sweeping dark storm.
Followed by subsequent swift saber strikes!
Draw Sword and Cut Water!
Clouds Breaking Through the Blue Sky!
Each saber faster than the last, each surpassing the last, the sky filled with radiant hundred zhang saber light seemed to cleave all, akin to the Sword God angrily cleaving the world!
One saber showed the astonishing hundred zhang saber light!
The saber light’s refinement, broadness far exceeded past eighty, hundred meters!
Reaching an astonishing hundred zhang!
Such enormous saber light, swept across, seemed capable of instantly obliterating a mountain, Bai Suzhen, incredibly capable, constantly exerting Infinite Power!

But after battling for a while, her True Qi was depleted, knowing it was difficult to persist in prolonged combat, especially after being sent flying dozens of zhang by one saber from Ding Ling, unable to suppress the blood spilling from her mouth, her heart trembled immeasurably!
Seeing Ding Ling still vibrant like a dragon, unable not to be moved, loudly saying:
’Enough, I concede!’
[Awarded D-level Achievement Medal: You received Bai Suzhen’s deep admiration.]
[Note: Bai Suzhen seeks cooperation with you against the ’Celestial God’, her attack was only to probe your true level. After one battle. Your strength, methods far exceeded her expectations.]
Upon hearing the notification.
Ding Ling sharply sheathed his saber, this battle brought him considerable benefit.
Understanding the strength of Shattering Level masters.
Knowing how to better utilize Shattering True Qi against opponents.
"Unexpected that I only lost track of you for a few days. You advanced to the Shattered Realm. Truly incredible."
Bai Suzhen sighed in admiration.
Ding Ling felt a chill.
Being trailed without realizing it.
Proving Bai Suzhen’s former skills absolutely far surpassed his own!
Reflecting on Bai Suzhen hiding in the cave, entirely undetected by him, he could not help but ask:
"Where were you hiding in the cave earlier?"

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 642: Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique
paragraphs: "It’s within an ice cave inside the limestone cave."
Bai Suzhen seemed to admire and appreciate Ding Ling greatly, and didn’t hide anything from him, saying:

"In order to deal with that unpredictable divine-level expert, I thought of gathering the world’s strong to use them for myself. During these months, I found quite a few talented people I approve of and gave them the Martial Arts Secret Manual."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s heart stirred:

"Seems someone beat us to it."

Unless they had Full Level in Array Dao, it would be hard to find the place where the manual was hidden.

Players leave no stone unturned, knocking, digging, taking away corpses—all too normal.
Ding Ling felt relieved.
These days, he’s been logging in and out hurriedly because his strength has been increasing rapidly.
Now, he can slash out a hundred-zhang blade beam in the real world as well!
Unbelievably formidable.
With his current cultivation, he can traverse the mundane with ease, and continuing to cultivate might make him indifferent to a nuclear bomb.
Thus, he’s been going online less often. Not knowing the recent players’ movements is reasonable.
"I don’t know what purpose the Demon Lord has in coming here."
"I’m here waiting for someone. Yet, I didn’t expect to meet you first."
"Oh?

"Who are you waiting for?"
"The Immortal God."
"He isn’t dead?!"
"I’m not dead, so how could he be?"
Bai Suzhen quietly said:

"His lifespan this incarnation probably has reached its limit. He might soon seize the body of some genius for his own use. Unlike me, I can utilize a corpse as long as it retains vitality, human presence, its meridians haven’t decayed, and the body hasn’t rotted. For me, it poses no hindrance.
He is different.
His Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, while seemingly granting immortality to ordinary people, truly cannot. It merely prolongs life.
Thus, every few decades or centuries as a reincarnation, he seizes upon a genius’s body, forcibly taking it for his own use."
At this point.

None understood Infinite Power.

After all, you are the future emperor of Jiuzhou; if Jiuzhou collapses, can you stay uninvolved?"
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
After defeating Bai Suzhen.
Mission 2, progress is also 0.
Evidently, Bai Suzhen isn’t the number one in this world.

"I certainly will take care of Jiuzhou’s matters. Even the gods and demons you speak of, I will try to challenge or even kill them!"
"The young are formidable.
Bai Suzhen looked appreciatively at Ding Ling and said:

"My intention is to join forces with some supreme powerhouses, and charge to the Celestial Realm once more. Since you have this confidence, Ding Ling, I will pass you some Secret Manuals, to make you stronger! I wonder what Martial Arts you would like to learn?"
"If the Demon Lord can impart all the Martial Arts Secret Manuals she knows to me, nothing could be better."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"I am confident I can learn all your Secret Manual Martial Arts."
"Good."

The Demon Lord generously transmitted the World-Ending Demon Body and other Martial Arts to Divine General, Pojun, etc., so of course, she wouldn’t begrudge teaching Ding Ling. Moreover, she sincerely doesn’t wish for this world she lives in to crumble, and most importantly, she hopes someone can emerge to kill the gods and demons.
Those gods and demons shattered the perfect body she painstakingly cultivated!
In her shock and fear, how could she not hate?
Immediately.

"This Divine Skill is impossible to cultivate without high comprehension and strong innate talent. Seeing how you learned the World-Ending Demon Body instantly, I assume cultivating this Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique should be no problem either."
She merely recited the Mantra Technique without further explanation.

Because during her search for worldly talents, she discovered such a heaven-defying anomaly like Ding Ling, followed him for a while, and found that Ding Ling mastered any technique instantly. She hid in the shadows at the time, also shocked and deeply impressed.
Therefore, she eagerly wanted to see if Ding Ling could quickly master her current Heaven-defying Level Martial Arts.
Ding Ling listened to the mantra of the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique.
Meditated once in his mind.

Once Full Level.
The Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi surged like tidewater; Ding Ling activated the Eternal Youth Technique, and soon, a drop of Longevity True Water appeared in his Dantian.
[True Power Value 63 points]
After reaching Full Level, Ding Ling’s lifespan increased once more.

Because the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, when cultivated to its peak, indeed has the wondrous effect of extending lifespan. Additionally, it possesses detoxification, restoration, healing effects, which are quite impressive.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 643: Six Great Demonic Crossings
paragraphs: "Indeed, it has been accomplished."
Bai Suzhen was moved:

"Even the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique can reach Great Perfection in an instant. Ding Ling, your natural talent is truly extraordinary. I now have a certain confidence in your challenge against the Gods and Demons."
She gave a faint smile, appearing in a good mood:

"Next, I will pass on to you the Six Great Demonic Crossings. I only hope that after you succeed in cultivating them, you can upgrade these Six Great Demonic Crossings within your lifetime, and not end up like me, having to use others as a vessel. This feeling is quite unpleasant."
She said softly:

"Even now, I still long for my own body. Only one’s own body best fits one’s soul! So unless absolutely necessary, you must not abandon your own body, otherwise, you might end up in my situation, struggling to ascend to the Supreme Path."
Ding Ling nodded solemnly.

His path of body refining was progressing smoothly, and if the War God Technique consumed enough Spiritual Vitality and Divinity in the future, it could reach the point of being undefeated even when beheaded.
Ding Ling would never abandon his own body.
"Listen closely. The Mantra Technique for the Six Great Demonic Crossings is..."
The Demon Lord finished speaking and even demonstrated the key movements of the Six Great Demonic Crossings once.
After one demonstration.
A secret manual inscribed with four large characters immediately appeared on the bookshelf in Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness library.
In an instant.
[Six Great Demonic Crossings Full Level]
[Strength +1.2]
[Agility +1.4]
[Defense +1.2]
[Constitution +1.2]
[Wisdom +0.6]
These Six Great Demonic Crossings are essentially six ’skills’!
Each skill can enhance attribute points!
The Rebirth Crossing of the Six Great Demonic Crossings can transfer the soul, increasing wisdom.
The other skills also have their attribute point enhancements, some increase one attribute, and others increase three.
Therefore, the final increase in attribute points is quite considerable.
Enhancing attribute points is secondary.
Mastering the Six Great Demonic Crossings.
Ding Ling was akin to mastering six highly-ranked skills!
This is different from magic.
Magic increases cultivation.
Skills are the means to utilize cultivation and more!
Having cultivation without skills puts one at a great disadvantage against those with skills!
And mastering the Six Great Demonic Crossings, Ding Ling was like having six top-tier skills of a broken state level.
Even if someone shatters his body in the future.
With Rebirth Crossing, he can still form a soul body, achieve soul transfer! Seize the body!
As long as there is someone who has just died, Ding Ling can immediately achieve soul transfer! Perfectly seize their shell.
Of course, as the Demon Lord said.
Others’ bodies can never truly fit one’s soul!
It’s like someone else’s hand; no matter how it fits, it’s not your own hand, and it can’t perfectly match with the soul!
’Compared to the Demon Lord, my soul body is relatively fragile. So although my Rebirth Crossing has reached Great Perfection, it’s certainly not as convenient or smooth as hers for use in transfer.’

The Demon Lord had lived for a long time, and Rebirth Crossing was her own creation, she had naturally reached Great Perfection many years ago, and had since continuously refined her soul, so now, she only needed a body with a hint of vitality to be resurrected again.
Ding Ling was somewhat inferior to her.
But he was also not afraid of being killed.
Besides Rebirth Crossing.
Death Crossing, Snow Crossing, Scripture Passage, Heart-Loss Crossing, Infinite Crossing are all extremely strong as well.
And the so-called Infinite Crossing, is precisely the Earth-level Infinite Power created by the Demon Lord.
After Ding Ling reaches full level in Infinite Crossing, his body would naturally generate two divine powers, Wind and Cloud!
Formless Wind, Yun Wuchang!
The combination of the two!
Forms Infinite Power!
And these two forces exist in every world! To activate it, one only needs to use Infinite Crossing, which can then harness the Power of Wind and Cloud! Transform it for self-use, amplifying oneself!
As long as it is deployed perfectly.
This Infinite Crossing can amplify combat power tenfold!
Boom!

After Ding Ling’s Six Great Demonic Crossings reached Great Perfection, various powerful energies surged and activated within his body, unleashing uncontrolled Power of Wind and Cloud from Infinite Crossing, creating a whirlwind storm out of thin air that continuously swirled around Ding Ling!
This whirlwind storm carried an extraordinary wind power!
Swirling with it, it seemed capable of sweeping away everything from all directions!
"So strong!"
Bai Suzhen stepped back two steps, her face filled with shock:

"Although I created the Six Great Demonic Crossings, it took me an extremely long time to cultivate them to Great Perfection! Ding Ling actually achieved Great Perfection in an instant! Unfathomable! Truly worthy of being a heaven-defying prodigy!"
She had long known that Ding Ling’s talent was incredibly frightening.
After all, she had observed Ding Ling for a while.
But after several teachings where Ding Ling reached Great Perfection instantly, Bai Suzhen still couldn’t help her heart from trembling, filled with amazement and admiration to the utmost!
Closely followed by delight:

"With such a talent here! Even the Gods and Demons may have a day where they are defeated by us mere mortals! Hmph! What are Gods and Demons? With Ding Ling, I believe that one day, we mortals can ascend in Reverse Ascension, pulling the Gods and Demons from their heavenly thrones!"
Her most perfect body was shattered.
And being forced to choose an extremely fragile body as a vessel.
This was an extremely unfortunate matter for Bai Suzhen, and what frightened her most was that her soul nearly shattered in the last great battle!
The techniques of Gods and Demons are extraordinary and unfathomable!

Bai Suzhen was frightened by the beating and didn’t dare to return to the Upper Realm, because she knew clearly, relying on her current frail body, it’s absolutely impossible to return to her former combat abilities.
Previously, she was knocked so her body shattered and her soul body nearly sustained heavy damage, now there’s nothing more to say.
"Only Ding Ling can be relied upon."
Bai Suzhen looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes.
Ding Ling’s Infinite Crossing is different from hers.
Her Infinite Crossing is dark.
Ding Ling’s is of Yin and Yang Qi.
Inherently carrying the power of darkness and light:
"Truly miraculous. As long as this child doesn’t fall, his future is bound to be smooth."
Thinking of what the alien had said.
Bai Suzhen couldn’t help but be moved, deciding to place all her bets on Ding Ling!
Woosh!

After Ding Ling awoke, the power of the Six Great Demonic Crossings transformed into streams of light outside his body and re-entered within, the Infinite Power of the universe quickly dissipated as well.
He rose up and respectfully thanked Bai Suzhen.
Bai Suzhen waved her hand and said:

"Finding a successor like you is a fortune for me as well. All these years, I have sought many talents to cultivate my magic and skills. Unfortunately, none were able to truly achieve Great Perfection, let alone surpass me. Only you! Achieving Great Perfection in an instant, you are truly the most exceptional prodigy throughout the ages!"
Bai Suzhen’s confidence in Ding Ling exploded, even more than Ding Ling himself:
"You’re right. With you here, the day will come when you defeat or even kill the Gods and Demons. Alright, I won’t waste time anymore. Now I’ll pass on more techniques to you."
Following this.
Bai Suzhen also passed on to Ding Ling the Divine Movement Skill, Extreme Blade Skill, Fire Thunder Gang Qi, and more than twenty other top supreme skills.
Most of these supreme skills were her own creations.
Quite a few were acquired from the folk.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 644: Immortal God
paragraphs: Over the years, Bai Suzhen has traveled the world, discovering extremely powerful martial arts. If she could obtain them, she would naturally take a look to absorb the essence and use it for herself.
She wanted to create her own techniques.
She naturally needed to browse through the world’s martial arts.
Thus, it’s imaginable that Bai Suzhen is like a walking library!
She knows too many martial arts.
And all her martial arts.
Ding Ling would reach full level just by hearing the heart technique and watching the demonstration.
This left Bai Suzhen speechless and amazed.
Of course.
Regarding how Ding Ling knew the Ice Nether Hand before, she also asked.
Ding Ling didn’t conceal it from her.
He straightforwardly passed on the Qiankun Great Shift technique to her.
The Demon Lord, after carefully comprehending it, was moved and realized why Ding Ling could use the Ice Nether Hand.

The level of the Ice Nether Hand was slightly weaker than the Seventh-Layer Qiankun Great Shift of Great Perfection level, so as long as Ding Ling saw through her practice of the Ice Nether Hand’s qi movement technique, he could naturally replicate it.
But even though he could replicate the Ice Nether Hand and even exert similar power to it to a certain degree,
without the mantra of the Ice Nether Hand, he couldn’t truly cultivate this martial art to Great Perfection.

Ding Ling obtained the mantra of the Ice Nether Hand and cultivated it to Great Perfection. Naturally, its power became more natural and at ease, surpassing the Ice Nether Hand used with the Qiankun Great Shift before!
One day later.
The Demon Lord passed all the martial arts he had learned throughout his life to Ding Ling.
Because these martial arts included Lightweight Skill, Body Refining Technique, Saber Technique, Sword Technique, Palm Technique, etc.
Thus, his defense and other attributes all increased.
Ultimately, the growth of the four-dimensional attributes was:
[Strength +6.9]
[Agility +7.3]
[Constitution +6.8]
[Defense +4.2]
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Root Bone 6, Intelligence 9.6, Strength 149.4, Agility 100.7, Constitution 149.3, Defense 143.4, Charisma 13. True Power Value: 63 points]
His strength and other attributes skyrocketed again.
Not to mention Ding Ling’s extended lifespan,
his defense and other attributes advanced to a new realm. At Ding Ling’s current body refining level, he could easily lift an object weighing over ten thousand catties.
Sun Wukong’s Ruyi Golden Cudgel weighs thirteen thousand five hundred catties. Ding Ling estimated that if there were no usage requirements, he should be able to lift it too!
And this is purely the power of body refining.
If the Breathing Technique bursts tenfold, imagine how great the strength would be! A single punch could effortlessly destroy a hill!
"Unknowingly, body refining has become this powerful!
Ding Ling’s confidence soared.
Having acquired the Demon Lord’s lifetime knowledge,
Ding Ling’s foundation deepened to an unimaginable level.
He sensed the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body: 95%
Previously, it was 85%.
It jumped a full 10 points.
During this period, he learned Mysterious Swordsmanship, Supreme Sword Dao, Indestructible Golden Body, World-Ending Demon Body, and more, all of which are extremely high-tier supreme skills.
Supreme Sword Dao and the like are unparalleled techniques.
And now, he has acquired the Demon Lord’s lifetime knowledge.
Dozens of high-tier cultivation techniques.
Other first-class techniques are too numerous to count.
It took Demon Lord a whole day and night just to quickly recite heart method mantras and demonstrate moves, which shows the sheer number of these secret manuals!
And now, all these have turned into Ding Ling’s resources,
also turning into nourishment for the sublimation and manifestation of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace!
"Incredible."
Wuming and Little Zhao had long arrived by Ding Ling and the Demon Lord’s side.
The Demon Lord Bai Suzhen is evidently an extremely generous person. Seeing how she didn’t hold back and imparted complete versions of techniques, her magnanimity surpasses Xiong Ba by untold times.
Xiong Ba, after dividing the Three-in-One Essence Qi into three parts, even removed the strongest moves and didn’t teach Nie Feng and the others!
The comparison highlights Bai Suzhen’s elegance, nobility, grace, and grandeur.
When Bai Suzhen passed martial arts to Ding Ling,
Wuming and Little Zhao watched intently.
Unknowingly, both of them remembered a lot of top martial arts.
Both Wuming and Little Zhao are extremely gifted individuals.
Especially Wuming, who remembered as much martial arts as Bai Suzhen spoke, he can be said to have fully received Bai Suzhen’s true inheritance.
Of course, the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique and Six Great Demonic Crossings were exceptions.
When these two techniques were being transmitted, Wuming and Little Zhao had not yet reached Ding Ling and Bai Suzhen’s side.

It was only after Bai Suzhen had finished imparting these two techniques that they came beside Ding Ling. Bai Suzhen took the initiative to indicate that Wuming and Little Zhao could observe, after which they stayed.
This transmission of techniques will significantly benefit both their futures.
But even so,
compared to the amazingly myriad martial arts Ding Ling reached Great Perfection with in an instant,
Wuming still felt a great gap between him and Ding Ling, like the difference between heaven and earth, involuntarily sighing.
Little Zhao was filled with pride and joy.
Proud because her family’s young master is so highly praised by lofty figures like Demon Lord and Wuming, she shared in the honor.
Joyful because Ding Ling could become stronger.
Another half-day passed.
While Ding Ling was still brushing up the proficiency of top-tier techniques like Divine Movement Skill and Extreme Blade Skill, Bai Suzhen suddenly spoke:
"He has arrived!"
Ding Ling stopped, focused his gaze toward the east.
As expected.
Atop the snowy mountain, a figure was approaching through the air.
A surge of wind and cloud energy erupted from his body, engulfing the sky and earth!
This influx!
Even from afar, one could clearly sense it.
It seemed to be reminding Bai Suzhen.
He had arrived!
Boom!
Bai Suzhen used Divine Movement Skill, transforming into a stream of light, heading straight towards the person:
"Divine Lord, prepare to die!"
"Hahaha, Demon Lord, I never expected you to actually come! This time, I will definitely kill you!"
The man flickered in the void, like a thunderbolt, taking a step akin to instant teleportation, flying right above the Demon Lord, and struck heavily down toward Bai Suzhen!
This strike seemed like it smashed down a mountain!
One could faintly see the shadow of a mountain gathering in momentum, pressing down on Bai Suzhen head-on!
Bai Suzhen remained fearless, her delicate hands flipping, directly striking out with the ultimate technique Six Great Demonic Crossings! Infinite Crossing!
With one strike!
The surging Power of Wind and Cloud, infused with the strength of Dark Demon Dao, thunderously crashed toward the man’s location, boom!
In just an instant, the Infinite Power shattered the mountain shadow, continuing inexorably to strike toward the man’s location.
"Haha..."
The man laughed, his figure flickered, retreating a hundred zhang, dodging the Infinite Crossing:
"Demon Lord, after all these years, has your power declined to this level?! Like this, it seems today you are surely going to die!"
He took a long breath.
Stopped probing the Demon Lord.
Instead, he raised a hand.

The inconstant clouds and intangible wind were forcibly summoned by him, then condensed into a concentrated wave of Infinite Power, which he casually waved, sending it like a streak towards the Demon Lord.
His realm of Infinite Power had evidently reached a level where he could control it freely, with ease and elegance!
A move of the Power of Wind and Cloud in Infinite Power was controllably grasped within his palm!

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 645: Ding Ling vs. the Bu Divine Race’s Deity
paragraphs: This kind of strength is extraordinary.
In the past, Bai Suzhen could also achieve this level, but her perfect body was shattered two months ago. Although her realm remained, her strength was far inferior to before.
Yet, she did not retreat in the slightest.
With a long roar, she unleashed all her power, and the Power of Wind and Cloud she gathered transformed into Infinite Power, striking towards Heaven’s Edge!
The Infinite Power from both sides looked similar, yet were vastly different.
One descended from the sky, primarily using the power of clouds—ethereal and unpredictable, swift and surging;
The other rose from the ground, primarily using the power of wind—wild and unstoppable, seemingly capable of shattering everything;
The two forces collided heavily in an instant, boom!
Visibly, amidst the lightning and thunder, an entire mountain peak crumbled! The snow mountain collapsed, and the snow tumbled continuously from the mountaintop, triggering an avalanche.

The man and Bai Suzhen, in the midst of the flying snow, fought more and more valiantly. Amidst loud laughter, his body suddenly spun, disappearing in mid-air, and reappearing behind Bai Suzhen the next moment, as he unhesitatingly punched heavily towards her.
Bright Fist!
This punch gathered the power of brightness, once executed, the Bright Power surged forth like a mighty river, the nemesis of darkness!
Bai Suzhen’s figure was agile and breathtakingly beautiful, she pivoted and dodged with a graceful leap, promptly turning to strike out with a palm!
Ice Nether Hand!

The solid palm seal, condensed from Extreme Cold True Intent, collided with the fist seal with a booming sound. The Ice Nether Hand exploded as the man laughed heartily, suddenly flashing close again, slapping towards Bai Suzhen’s face.
Great Stone-Smashing Hand!
As this slap was executed, a condensed ancient stele could faintly be seen in the void, its engraved Buddha Light luminous, seemingly capable of suppressing all darkness and evil spirits!
"Demon Lord, you should have died long ago, today I’ll send you to Western Heaven!"
Each move the man executed followed swiftly after the previous one.
The techniques in his hand were ever-changing, unpredictable, powerful, and boundless!

Not a single move was repeated, after exchanging over a hundred moves with Bai Suzhen, he had displayed over a hundred kinds of martial arts, each immensely powerful! Possessing the power to overturn rivers and mountains!
Bai Suzhen, gradually overwhelmed, was somewhat struggling.
With the man’s heavy punch, boom! Bai Suzhen blocked with both palms, but upon hearing a crack, her wrist was broken by the punch, she couldn’t help but groan, retreating a hundred zhang.
The man pursued relentlessly, intending to beat Bai Suzhen to death.
Ding Ling saw this and hesitated no longer, leaping into the air, drawing his saber, and slashing angrily towards the man’s location!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Chilling Glance!
The speed of this slash was the fastest, once swung, the hundred-zhang saber aura flashed across the void like a bolt of lightning, reaching the man’s waist and abdomen in less than half a blink.
The man flickered away, dodging, bang! The hundred-zhang saber aura landed on the mountainside, instantly demolishing countless tall trees and thorns, shattering rocks, and making the void tremble.
The power of the slash was this devastating.
The man was moved, glancing sideways, his bright eyes fixed on Ding Ling:
"Who are you? Why interfere in my battle with the Demon Lord!"
"Bai Suzhen is my friend."
Ding Ling, Soaring in the Void, seemingly like the Wind God, lightly landed beside Bai Suzhen, facing the man directly:
"Are you the Immortal God?"
At close range.
Ding Ling saw more clearly.
This man looked exactly like Bu Jingyun!
Just more arrogant and overbearing in demeanor.
From head to toe, filled with a kind of aloof, sovereign aura.
Knowing Bu Jingyun was also from the Bu Divine Race, Ding Ling understood.
"You know me and still dare to challenge me."
The Immortal God glanced at Ding Ling, sneering coldly:
"Who gave you the courage to think you can surpass me? If you don’t want to die, you better get out of my way now, otherwise, after I kill Bai Suzhen, you’ll be next."
Ding Ling, Observing People Skill, acting, etc., at Full Level.
Though the Immortal God is an old monster, well-concealed, but now that both sides are at the Shattered Realm, Ding Ling could see the Immortal God would certainly not spare them.
Even if he stepped aside.
The Immortal God would inevitably make every effort to kill them afterward. He’s a heartless, extremely cold-blooded person!
Not to mention Bai Suzhen had taught Ding Ling and guided him.
Even without that.
Ding Ling and the Immortal God would eventually have a showdown, for the Immortal God’s overbearing dominance, and sense of sole supremacy, would eventually clash with Ding Ling, the emperor.
It’s alright if the Immortal God hadn’t emerged, but now that he has, it indicates that in this era of great conflict, he will also contend!
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling stopped speaking nonsense.
Suddenly exerting his power.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Whizz! Whizz! Whizz!
A majestic surge of Sword Intent burst forth, like a thousand-zhang tide surging towards the Immortal God!
In an instant.
It enveloped and submerged the Immortal God.
Soon, the surging Sword Intent transformed into numerous Spirit Killing Swords, stabbing towards the Immortal God!

This Heartless Dao is broadly a Spiritual Killing Secret Technique, a sea of killing swords, more targeting the Immortal God’s viscera, head, and other areas, but plenty aimed at his Sea of Consciousness!
To eradicate his consciousness body in one stroke, leaving him in eternal damnation!
"Ah!"

The Immortal God roared towards the sky, boom! Flames ignited around him, many condensed into formless Shadow Flame, transforming into a wall of fire, standing before his Sea of Consciousness, blocking the Spirit Killing Swords!
More flames turned into a wildfire, sweeping towards Ding Ling.
"You brat, you’ve enraged me!"

The Immortal God was profoundly startled. If not for the recruitment and being taught a world-shaking mysterious martial art, from which he grasped its essence, and self-created a Spiritual Defense Secret Technique.
He might have died just now!
Thinking about this.
He couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat, followed by overwhelming fury, his eyes instantly turning blood-red:
"Ah. I will have you dead!"
Boom!
Gusts of Profound Wind swirled up around him!
The wind fanned the flames.
The rolling Celestial Fire swept towards Ding Ling, as if to completely obliterate him.
Ding Ling pushed Bai Suzhen towards the Lower Realm with a palm, while his own figure shifted, gracefully unpredictable.

Combining Free-Will Ascension Step, Soaring in the Void, and Divine Movement Skill, Ding Ling could seemingly perform Instant Teleportation amid the void, sometimes forward, sometimes backward, or left, right, up, or down, his speed was incredulously fast, akin to a Divine Being.
He was merciless towards the Immortal God.
Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi, Divine Form Power, Ten Directions Invincible, Infinite Crossing augmented his body, forty-fold amplification!
Unleashing an Ultimate Technique at once!
Supreme Sword Dao!
No-Self Dao!
As the move came forth, Ding Ling seemed to have transformed into twenty-one figures in an instant!
One hand wielding the Xuanyuan Sword, the other the Snow-Drinking Saber!
One hand executing the No-Two Blade Technique!
The other hand thrusting the Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Various Divine Skills and Mystic Techniques unfolded in Ding Ling’s hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 646: Fall of the God
paragraphs: In an instant.
In the void, dense saber light and sword rain fell, transforming into a rushing Sword River, snow surge, rushing towards the flames!
Boom!

The saber light and sword rain were condensed to the extreme, surging as if the entire sea was overturning. In just a few fleeting moments of confrontation, they fiercely pierced through the Celestial Fire occupying half of the sky, and then with a thunderous roar, pointed directly at the Immortal God!
The Immortal God was horrified!

"Ten Strong Martial Dao! Infinite Power! Divine Form Power! Actually concentrated into a single strike! Such strong methods! It is absolutely impossible to refine these martial arts and techniques to Great Perfection and then bind these completely different forces into one rope to strike!"
He retreated violently by hundreds of meters, avoiding the strike while unable to resist shouting loudly:
"Kid! Who the hell are you!"
"The one who will kill you!"
Ding Ling’s Earth-level Infinite Power within his body was limited!
It’s because even though this Earth-level Infinite Power had reached Great Perfection, within his body suddenly two magical forces were born; the unpredictable Cloud and the shapeless Wind!
These two forces, rising and falling within the Dantian, although just a wisp, condensed like a tornado, was extremely powerful!
It constantly absorbs the Power of Wind and Cloud from the outside, strengthening itself!
Given time, once it absorbs enough Power of Wind and Cloud, it will make Ding Ling as powerful as the true Wind God and Cloud God!
Therefore, the newly born Wind and Cloud Divine Power, although very strong, the duration of its tenfold power amplification lasted only a few minutes!
Ding Ling must finish this fight within a few minutes.
Therefore.
He chose to strike, without further ado, activating all means, directly amplifying forty times!
Constant use of the No-Self Dao of the Supreme Sword Dao!
The speed of No-Self Dao was extremely fast!
Fast enough to create multiple avatars in the void!
As if twenty-one people were simultaneously wielding swords and sabers!
Ding Ling perfectly integrated No-Self Dao with Ten Strong Martial Dao together!
While using No-Self Dao.
He showcased various Shattering Level strong martial arts such as No-Two Blade Technique, Celestial Destiny Sword Dao, Heaven-Questioning Spear Technique, Great Yi Halberd Manual, continuously.
Though it’s clearly one saber and one sword!
Yet with the support of No-Self Dao and Left-Right Mutual Struggle, Ding Ling seemed like he transformed into forty-two people in an instant, exerting power simultaneously!
At times, using Draw Sword and Cut Water, one strike made the hundred-meter saber light appear in the world, as if splitting the Yellow River into two segments;

At times, the sword transformed into a spear, one move of Heaven-Questioning Spear Technique, angrily questioning the beings, thrusting out, seemingly as a peerless Spear God, wielding a spear capable of destroying heaven and earth!
Each move, each style, fully revealed Ding Ling’s supreme excellence!
The Immortal God began to collapse upon first contact!
The gap was too large!
The fortyfold amplified Ding Ling could easily overcome two levels in battle.
The Immortal God was merely at the peak of the Shattering Initial Stage and was being chased and beaten by Ding Ling all the way!
From the beginning, he kept retreating and dodging!
Rumble!
Cold sweat was pouring down his forehead as he unleashed various strong ultimate techniques.
Celestial Extreme Infinite Power was wielded profoundly!

Tornado storms descended from the sky, he hid within the storm, amplifying himself tenfold, occasionally unleashing Bright Fist, Oblique Flower Seven-Star Fist, Great Stone-Smashing Hand, Sumeru Mountain Palm, Great Vajra Palm, and other Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills!

His Seventy-Two Skills had already reached perfection, even fused into one, transforming into a perfect Vigorous Qi of Primordial Ruyi, this Qi using any of the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills equated to simultaneously unleashing dozens of ultimate techniques!
Therefore.

He didn’t hesitate to deplete this perfect Qi, unleashing various Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills while using the tenfold amplification of Infinite Power, raising his strength to a new terrifying realm!
Comparable to twentyfold amplified powerhouses!
However, even so.
Each clash with Ding Ling was still getting crushed and overwhelmed!
Boom!
Rumble!
Ding Ling’s saber flashed like lightning, the sword moved like a dragon!

After performing Extreme Blade Skill, each saber was faster than the last, seemingly a trace of Aurora born in the world, rushing to the Immortal God at a speed difficult for the naked eye to discern!

The Immortal God roared furiously, performing Sumeru Mountain Palm, a mountain shadow collided with this trace of Aurora heavily, as if Mars hitting Earth, a spray of sparks and lightning, in the crackling sound, Aurora seemed like a golden drill, with a clang, it broke through the mountain shadow and then struck the Immortal God’s palm at a peerless speed with a snap!
Poof!
In just an instant, this trace of Aurora penetrated the Immortal God’s palm, making him let out a miserable scream, unable to stop retreating another hundred meters.
But this time Ding Ling pursued even more urgently!

With fortyfold amplified Soaring in the Void, Divine Movement Skill, Free-Will Ascension Step, making Ding Ling fast like a trace of starlight, a thunderbolt, hundreds of meters in an instant, his whole being in the void, crossing and turning fluidly like moving clouds and flowing water, all-conquering!
"Die!"
Ding Ling flickered behind the Immortal God in an instant, one saber one sword! Seemingly two people simultaneously performing two highly advanced secret skills!
Using No-Two Blade Technique!
Performing Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Clang!

Only hearing a crisp piercing sound echoing, vaguely a brilliant Sword River appeared between heaven and earth, a radiant saber light, and then the sky-encompassing Celestial Extreme Infinite Power condensed storm was pierced fiercely! Shattered!
The Immortal God at the storm’s center was moreover covered and submerged by sword qi and saber light, severely wounded, falling into the Lower Realm.
Ding Ling sheathed his sword.
Holding a single saber, swooping down.
He soon caught up with the Immortal God, saw his fearful yet incredulous eyes mixed with terror, he pressed a palm onto his chest.
"Ah!"
The Immortal God wailed in despair:
"I will bring you down with me!"
Dim flames loomed over his body, with the Force of Wind and Cloud seemingly about to explode!
Ding Ling immediately manipulated the Supreme Sword Intent to pierce the Immortal God’s consciousness body!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!

The spirit killing sword formed by the condensed sword intent once again struck toward the Immortal God’s Sea of Consciousness, this time, the defensive flame wall of his Sea of Consciousness had dimmed much compared to last time.
Instantly.
The fortyfold amplified spirit killing sword, like a Sword Dragon condensed from a rushing Sword River, wildly charged and stirred within his Sea of Consciousness!
Boom!
The Immortal God’s eyes dimmed, the explosion and rupture of the Force of Wind and Cloud began to slowly recede back into his body!
Ding Ling immediately stepped forward.
Activated Six Great Demonic Crossings of Infinite Crossing!
Placing one hand on the Immortal God’s Dantian.
Boom!
Rumble!
A muffled thunder sound passed through Celestial Extreme, then followed like rivers converging, the rolling Celestial Extreme Infinite Power flowed into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
The ’Juvenile Stage’ Wind and Cloud power, like a long drought meeting sweet rain, crazily absorbed this Celestial Extreme Infinite Power!

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 647: Wind and Cloud Divine Power
paragraphs: Whoosh!
The Power of Wind and Cloud in Ding Ling’s Dantian surged with visible speed.
From just one Wind Divine Power and Cloud Divine Power.
It soared all the way to a full ten Wind and Cloud Divine Powers!
Around these ten divine powers, ordinary Wind and Cloud Power was also condensing!
This made Ding Ling’s Infinite Power overall increase by no less than a hundredfold!
This is a terrifying kind of surge.
With this hundredfold Infinite Power enhancement, Ding Ling used Infinite Crossing to boost himself from a few minutes to several hundred minutes! Over ten hours!
Not only that.
At this moment, Ding Ling’s Infinite Power also increased tenfold!
The power of Infinite Power is related to the ’Wind and Cloud Divine Power.’
This is the root power of Wind and Cloud! It is the power generated from self-cultivating Infinite Power.
It will always exist! Even if consumed, it can recover rapidly.
But ordinary Wind and Cloud Power is different; if consumed, the recovery speed is much slower.
And this is ordinary Wind and Cloud Power refined in the Dantian.
If the Wind and Cloud Power is not refined, even if it is absorbed and used, it is not one’s own power; it belongs to heaven and earth.

And Infinite Power uses its own Wind and Cloud Divine Power to attract the Wind and Cloud Power of heaven and earth, achieving the terrifying effect of the convergence of wind and cloud, with two heavenly powers enhancing oneself infinitely!

"Now, I have 1 Earth-level Infinite Wind and Cloud Power in my Dantian, plus 9 Celestial Extreme Infinite Powers! This is a power containing divinity. If added with ordinary Wind and Cloud Power, if this power erupts, it would be absolutely astonishing."
Ding Ling glanced at the Immortal God.
His consciousness body had been shredded to pieces.
He had now become a living dead!
His soul had perished.
The shell was still alive.
If the Immortal God hadn’t died, by using his own Wind and Cloud Power as fuel and exploding his shell, the place where the Sword Sect was would likely shatter!
A god is called a god.
Of course, it had reached a realm unimaginable to mortals!
Unfortunately.
He still died.
Ding Ling grabbed his body, operating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Rolling True Qi was absorbed into his body.
After some time.
The surging True Qi of the Immortal God was refined into Longevity True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +620]
His True Qi far exceeded Pojun’s.
Pojun, close to the strength of a Grandmaster, only provided 100 points.
By rights.
After battling Ding Ling for so long, the Immortal God, having consumed much True Qi, shouldn’t provide such abundant ’Inner Power Value.’

But the cultivation technique practiced by the Immortal God was extremely brilliant, and since he was also a master of the Shattered Realm, his Shattering True Qi naturally converted with far greater efficiency than Pojun’s True Qi.
It was precisely because of the high conversion efficiency that he could achieve this effect.
[True Power Value: 65 points]
Strength increased once more.
Ding Ling sensed that if he had a forty-fold boost, he could now crush the Immortal God even more easily and smoothly.
Besides these.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill, flipped through the Immortal God’s clothes in mid-air, but found no other useful documents or secret manuals.
He couldn’t help but sigh, then handed the Immortal God’s body to Bai Suzhen, who descended from the sky.
Bai Suzhen thanked him, grasping the shell of the Immortal God, with a slightly dazed expression, and said:

"I never thought the Palace Master of the Divine Search Palace, a god once famous throughout the world, would fall like this. But death is also good. It saves him from stabbing us in the back during our true battle with the gods and demons. This guy, to win, would do anything; he looked overbearing and unrivaled, but he was actually a scoundrel. Keeping his shell is of no use to me."
Bai Suzhen lightly slapped the ground.
Created a hole in the earth.

She tossed the Immortal God’s remains into the hole, then with a wave of her hand, the Wind and Cloud Power surged, and amidst the rustling sounds, the earth and stones turned, completely burying the hole:
"Dust to dust, earth to earth! Let everything end here. From now on, my grievances with the god are gone!"
As if unraveling a knot in her heart.
Bai Suzhen’s expression was extremely complex and regretful.
The confusion in her eyes was unmistakably clear to anyone.

Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was at full level; he knew at a glance what she was thinking. She must have felt compassion for the Immortal God again. After all, Bai Suzhen used to be the Immortal God’s wife; she loved him! If not for the Immortal God’s ruthless nature, trying to poison his own wife, the two wouldn’t have fallen out.
But now the Immortal God was dead.
As Bai Suzhen said, when a person dies, grievances die too. No matter how significant the hatred, once the other is dead, it dissipates.

Killing the god was something Bai Suzhen had been actively pursuing. Now that the god was dead, she suddenly felt as if she lost her target, feeling dazed, confused, and uncertain, which was understandable.
But Bai Suzhen was clearly not comparable to ordinary people.
Soon.
She returned to normal, looked at Ding Ling, and said:

"The Immortal God practiced an unparalleled Demon Skill! If I’m not mistaken, this Demon Skill should come from the Great Demon God of Japan, Xiaao Jingtian’s Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities! This martial art is extremely terrifying; even some peerless geniuses, after practicing it, inevitably fall into the Demon Dao, turning into beasts with no humanity!
I didn’t expect the Immortal God would also practice this martial art, and it seems he even improved it in new ways.
Under such circumstances, you were able to kill him. Ding Ling, your strength is already at the pinnacle of the world!
Next.

You need to absorb resources from Jiuzhou and Japan to strengthen yourself, and it’s best to break into the legendary Sword Realm. There, you might learn better methods and comprehend a Sword Dao more suitable for yourself."
"Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities? Great Demon God? Sword Realm..."
Ding Ling listened thoughtfully.
He glanced at the Character Panel.
[Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Immortal God.]

[Note: The Immortal God prided himself on being unrivaled in the world, disregarding everyone except for a few like the Demon Lord. Naturally, he also looked down on you. But you, however, counterattacked and killed him, causing him great shock and disbelief.]
This was the prompt that appeared when the Immortal God was killed.
In addition.
Task 1 progress advanced a little bit.
Task 2 still had no response.
As anticipated.
The Immortal God was not the first in the world.
"Where do you plan to go next?"
Bai Suzhen took out the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root secret manual from her bosom and handed it to Ding Ling:
"I forgot to give it to you earlier. Take it."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, took it, and said:
"I’m planning to go to the Celestial Sect to deal with Emperor Shitian."
"I know Emperor Shitian. This person is very arrogant and unruly. He is even somewhat schizophrenic."
Bai Suzhen nodded in agreement and said:
"This person cannot be our friend, and naturally can’t be a teammate. Killing him and seizing his power is indeed a better choice."

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 648: Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root
paragraphs: Bai Suzhen said, "I’ll accompany you."
Ding Ling naturally agreed.
Bai Suzhen’s power was exceedingly strong.
With her by his side to assist.
Ding Ling’s rear was absolutely secure.
Ask throughout the world,
who besides the Immortal God and the few could harm Bai Suzhen?
Previously, Bai Suzhen was injured because she chose to directly confront the Immortal God; otherwise, if she wanted to leave, there were very few who could stop her.
"Oh!"

Bai Suzhen suddenly looked up at the sky, gently raised her hand, pointed into the void, swoosh! Thunderfire Gang Qi transformed into electric light and shot towards the direction of the sky, swoosh! This Finger Force was fast and urgent, with only a sharp whistle heard, boom! An eagle was shot, tumbling down from the high sky like a kite with a broken string.
"What’s that?"
Ding Ling noticed as well.
"Someone is watching us."
Bai Suzhen frowned and said:

"Someone knows the Eagle Taming Technique, remotely controlling the eagle, using the eagle’s eye to survey this earth realm. Needless to say, your battle with the Immortal God must have been observed by him."
"Who could it be?"
"I don’t know."
Bai Suzhen thought for a moment, shook her head, and said:
"The longer I stay in this world, the more it eludes me. The waters are too deep."
Ding Ling looked towards Wuming.
Wuming shook his head in bewilderment:
"Even the mighty Demon Lord doesn’t know, how could I possibly know?"
Wuming and Little Zhao were watching the battle from afar, between the Demon Lord and the Immortal God, their hearts tense. While Wuming was calmer, Little Zhao was in awe, deeply impressed.
The defeat of the Demon Lord caused Little Zhao some concern.

And Ding Ling’s battle with the Immortal God made Little Zhao not dare to blink; despite her eyes starting to hurt and her heart and spirit shaken, she forced herself to watch until the end. Fortunately, this time the battle wasn’t long, as Ding Ling crushed the Immortal God with absolute superiority, claiming victory!
For Little Zhao, it was as if celestial gods had descended to earth, deeply engraved in her heart; she feared she would never forget. Her admiration for Ding Ling reached an extreme at this moment!
Little Zhao was like this.
Although Wuming wasn’t as exaggerated, his respect for Ding Ling reached new heights, always displaying humility when facing Ding Ling, never putting on airs.
There was no other way.
Facing a genius as extraordinary as Ding Ling, although Wuming is a Martial Arts Myth, incredibly gifted, he was crushed into nothingness. How could he dare assert himself before Ding Ling?
"Let’s forget it."
Ding Ling looked at the Celestial Sect map again.
Then he showed the map to Bai Suzhen and the others.
Only then did he say:

"Let’s go to the Celestial Sect first. The Celestial Sect has been hidden for so many years. Emperor Shitian tried to use all people as pawns, and now knowing there are so many masters in this world, how might he feel?"
"I’ve heard the name of Emperor Shitian too.
Wuming said:
"He was defeated by you recently. If there’s a rematch. How could he possibly be your opponent, Ding Ling? I fear this trip to the Celestial Sect will be in vain."
"Judging from Emperor Shitian’s personality and actions, this possibility is high."
Bai Suzhen agreed with Wuming’s words.
Ding Ling said:
"No matter if he’s there or not, we’ll find out when we go."
Ding Ling soared in the void, holding Little Zhao’s hand, strolling through the air.
The speed was extremely fast.
Bai Suzhen and Wuming followed closely.
During the journey.
While camping on the ground, Ding Ling took out the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root to watch.
Just watched it once.
[Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root Inner Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root External Martial Heart Method Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
The Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root is similar to the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique and other techniques; it is also a supreme technique that cultivates both internally and externally!
Once full level.
Surging Spiritual Vitality flowed like a tide; Ding Ling operated the Eternal Youth Technique, and before long, a drop of Longevity True Water appeared in his Dantian.
[True Power Value 66 points]
Meanwhile.
A particularly remarkable Sword Qi naturally arose within Ding Ling’s body!
This Sword Qi was tough, sharp, noble, supreme, resembling a God of Swords! Once this Sword Qi emerged, Little Zhao’s sword trembled, voluntarily bowed, as if worshipping Ding Ling.
Wuming was startled:
"This is?!"
"Succeeded again."
Bai Suzhen sighed with admiration:
"Beyond human!"
Her almond-like eyes were getting brighter:
"My confidence in Ding Ling is growing more substantial. Perhaps he came from above to this world to help us break the shackles and reshape Heaven and Earth!

"Indeed. Even a legendary level supreme skill like Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root can reach Great Perfection instantly, so impressive. The title of Sword God, Martial Arts Myth should truly belong to Ding Ling."
Wuming and Bai Suzhen were watching in amazement!
This was also because Ding Ling had learned various supreme skills and techniques extremely quickly earlier on.
It made them accustomed to it.
Otherwise, they would have been even more shocked.
Indeed, once Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root reached full level.
The Sword Qi that naturally arose from Ding Ling was truly boundless and supreme! Seemingly able to make all swords bow!
Such Sword Qi!
Bai Suzhen was seeing it for the first time, and needless to say, Wuming was deeply moved!
The wind blew!
Ding Ling opened his eyes, reflecting deeply on himself.
The Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root was indeed extraordinary.
It seemed to possess all the advantages of various versions from TV dramas and movies!
Not only could he control swords, heal injuries, protect his heart, but he could also absorb others’ Inner Powers to connect his own broken Meridians!
It can be stated that this Inner Power was truly extraordinary!

The essence of Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root lies in its Inner Power. Without learning the Inner Power, merely mastering the External Skill wouldn’t be enough to produce the Supreme Sword God Qi!
Only the birth of this Supreme Sword God Qi could make thousands of swords submit, allowing one to wield thousands of swords to defeat enemies!
"Here."
Ding Ling handed the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root’s Secret Manual to Wuming.

Wuming had heard about Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root and was curious about it, and with the emergence of the Demon Lord, Immortal God, and others, made him foresee constant crises ahead in the Shenzhou Land.
Feeling immense pressure, he naturally wished to improve himself.
Therefore, Ding Ling gave the Secret Manual to him, and he accepted without hesitation, only thanking him before solemnly flipping through it.
Only after reading.
He was completely stunned.
"This, this, this..."
"What is it?"
Bai Suzhen glanced sideways.
"You should take a look."
After reading Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root, Wuming couldn’t calm his emotions for a long time, and when Bai Suzhen looked, he handed her the Secret Manual.
Bai Suzhen hadn’t read it before and now glanced over it, her pupils shrinking, saying:
"To cultivate this Martial Arts, one must abolish existing skills?!"
"Indeed."
Wuming said doubtfully:
"Ding Ling didn’t abolish his skills, yet he learned it instantly?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 649: Divine Mother Luo Xian
paragraphs: "Ding Ling is special, we can’t compare ourselves to him."
Bai Suzhen pondered over the "Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root" for a while and said:
"This secret manual is truly extraordinary. If one forcibly trains without abolishing their martial arts, they might end up dying suddenly!"
She shook her head and lamented:
"It seems this cultivation technique has nothing to do with me."
Her profound skills reach the heavens; how could she possibly abolish her martial arts?
Wuming also felt a bit regretful.
His skills were also exceptional, so it was naturally impossible for him to abolish his martial arts to learn "Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root."
If it were in the past, he might have considered it.
Now, however, he certainly would not entertain the thought.
It was because during his time following Ding Ling, he had obtained much fortune, and completely absorbed Bai Suzhen’s orthodox teachings.
Bai Suzhen saw Wuming’s remarkable talent.
She then told him the mantra of "Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique" and "Six Great Demonic Crossings"; no one could foresee how much fortune Wuming would have in the future.
In comparison, "Six Great Demonic Crossings" and "Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique" are not inferior to "Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root." In certain aspects, they even surpass it!
In comparison,
Wuming naturally had no reason to abolish his martial arts.

Little Zhao also had an excellent memory, silently reciting the mantra techniques of "Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique" and "Six Great Demonic Crossings" heard beside her. If she diligently practiced in the future, her achievements would definitely be limitless.
Following the map as guidance.
On this day,
Ding Ling arrived at the land of the far north.
The Celestial Sect was here.
A bleak and desolate view!
Withered silence and cold!
The biting cold swept rampant through this region! It was ten times colder here than the Sword Sect’s location!
Thinking of Emperor Shitian’s situation, Ding Ling felt relieved.
Emperor Shitian needed to delay aging, so choosing an extremely cold place as his dwelling was understandable.
Taptap!
Ding Ling, holding Little Zhao’s hand, flashed like wind through the void, and in the next moment, he landed in front of a vast palace sculpted entirely from ice!
This palace occupied a large area.
The internal structure was intricate and complex.
It was precisely the region where the Celestial Sect was located.
The Unmoving Human Realm and Free Earth Realm were on the first and second layers.
While that Void Sacred Realm was embedded in the mountain body of the Infinite High Mountain, others couldn’t know the specific location.
But fortunately, Ding Ling had a map.
He knew where the Void Sacred Realm was, although he was unclear about the specific internal situation of the Void Sacred Realm.
But knowing the entrance and exit of the Void Sacred Realm was enough!
"Who!"
Two people guarded the entrance of the Celestial Sect.
These two were Innate Experts.
They would certainly be renowned figures in the Jianghu, yet they were only guarding the entrance here.
Ding Ling did not even ask their names, just snorted lightly.
Boom!
The next moment, the two fell dead on the ground.
They had been pierced through the Sea of Consciousness by the Supreme Sword Dao of Heartless Dao!
Ding Ling walked over unhurriedly, grabbed casually, and absorbed!
He exercised the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +12]
Sure enough, Innate-level experts could only provide about 10 points.
Ding Ling casually discarded the two corpses and continued forward.
Concerning Ding Ling’s actions,
Bai Suzhen greatly admired him, considering Ding Ling decisive and ruthless against enemies, truly a hero!

Wuming felt a pang of discomfort, wanting to persuade him multiple times, but seeing Bai Suzhen’s demeanor stifled his heart; considering Emperor Shitian’s Celestial Sect was a menacing organization against the Human Realm, he could only endure it.
This was killing one to save hundreds! Thousands!
This was annihilating the Celestial Sect to save Jiuzhou!
Wuming could only comfort himself thus.
Taptap!
As they walked along.
The experts they encountered became more numerous.
But most were First-class Experts!
A few were Innate Experts.
Ding Ling’s Supreme Sword Dao was awe-inspiring here.
Just with a thought!
Streaks of Sword Intent condensed into Spirit Killing Sword, stabbing at the opponent!
These Innate Experts couldn’t react, falling dead on the ground one by one, dying extremely cleanly!
This is the fearsome power of the Spiritual Killing Technique!
The Martial Artist’s Sea of Consciousness was almost completely unprotected; facing this secret skill was akin to exposing one’s heart for the enemy to stab!
The power is imaginable!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +2]
As Ding Ling’s cultivation continually improved.
First-class Experts’ True Qi after being refined could only provide 1 or 2 points.
Innate 10 points or so.
Grandmaster Level about 80 points, Grandmaster Great Perfection about 100 points.
Ding Ling walked along.
Without encountering Grandmaster-Level strong individuals.
Until he reached the deepest center of the Celestial Sect’s Unmoving Human Realm, inside a giant main hall! There he finally saw a strong individual.
It was a graceful and delicate woman who did not yield to men!
She sat atop the highest throne in the main hall, exhibiting quite a queen-like commanding presence!
However, at this moment, she looked at Ding Ling, her eyes filled with panic, fear, and, of course, mostly anger:
"Ding Ling! Why are you killing my Celestial Sect people without cause?!"
"Who are you?"
"I am the Celestial Gate Envoy, Ghost Mother, the director of Unmoving Human Realm, Luo Xian!"
"Luo Xian?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"I know you. Emperor Shitian’s personal disciple, I heard you inherited the Holy Heart Technique, is it true?"
"What does that have to do with you?"
Luo Xian was both frightened, anxious, fearful, and at a loss, with various plans rapidly turning in her mind, all denied by her!
At that moment, as smart and wise as she was, she also felt a bit of despair!
Because she discovered that facing a master like Ding Ling, no amount of scheming or planning was useful!
Ding Ling’s pair of iron fists came upon her!
Her entire layout would collapse and shatter!
Thinking of the scene just reported by her subordinate stumbling into the main hall, Luo Xian couldn’t help gritting her teeth:
"Ding Ling, I recognized you at a glance! I claim I have no grievance with you, why are you killing so many of my subordinates! Trying to obliterate my Unmoving Human Realm forces!"
"Are you really clueless, or are you pretending to be dumb?"
Ding Ling employed the Dragon Capturing Skill, reached out to grab, a dragon-shaped Qi instantly tied up Luo Xian’s graceful body, dragging Luo Xian from the throne close to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t touch her.
He just used the dragon-shaped Qi to grasp Luo Xian in midair, took a step closer, faced her, and said:
"I’ll give you a chance. Hand over the Holy Heart Technique to me. I can let you leave."
"Pah!"
Luo Xian showed contempt, suddenly spitting towards Ding Ling.
The saliva was swift and urgent, seemingly about to land on Ding Ling’s face.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s protective Qiankun Great Shift Qi spun and twirled, causing the saliva to fly back onto Luo Xian’s face even faster.
She looked terrified, wanting to wipe it away, but tied so tightly she couldn’t move.
"You, you let me go!"
"Really uncooperative."
Ding Ling hovered and pointed downward slowly, thump!
Right on Luo Xian’s forehead!
A flash of blood lights up.
The esteemed Divine Mother Luo Xian, thus perished!
