chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 650: Divine Judgment
paragraphs: [Received E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Divine Mother Luo Xian.]

[Note: Your arrival was so swift that Luo Xian didn’t even have the time to organize her followers to retreat. Faced with you, she was panicked and at a loss, but when she learned that you needed the Holy Heart Technique, she calmed down considerably, originally intending to use the ’rather die than surrender’ approach to test waters and facilitate subsequent provocations and other tactics against you. Unexpectedly, she didn’t even get to speak, and you killed her.
She was filled with disbelief, bewilderment, and helplessness at the time of her death.]
A notification sound was heard.
Ding Ling didn’t think much of it.
He also had some understanding of the Holy Heart Technique.
After all, even his incomplete half of the Holy Heart Technique was at Full Level, so when he got close to the Divine Mother, he knew her Holy Heart Technique was also incomplete.
The only difference between her and him was that her Dantian had been artificially infused with an extraordinary amount of Perfection Holy Heart True Qi!
This True Qi can greatly enhance one’s lifespan, not to mention it can heal oneself and others!
But this Holy Heart True Qi belonged to someone else.
Not her own.
So once it’s used up, it’s likely very difficult to restore.
Even if restored, it would most likely only recover to her self-cultivated ’incomplete’ Holy Heart True Qi, impossible to reach this Perfection Level High Tier Holy Heart True Qi.
And the source of the infused Holy Heart True Qi, needless to say, was certainly Emperor Shitian!
This person has always been stingy in sharing the Holy Heart Technique, treating Divine Mother Luo Xian so, imagine how he treats others.
Ding Ling placed his hand on Luo Xian’s shoulder.
He practiced the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Rolling True Qi entered the body, rapidly refined.
[Inner Power Value +90]
Luo Xian’s strength lay in the good quality of the Holy Heart True Qi in her Dantian, which belonged to Emperor Shitian.
Thus, the Inner Power Value increased by 90 points in one go.
After absorbing Luo Xian’s True Qi.
A drop of Longevity True Water formed in the Dantian again.
[True Power Value: 67 points]
Power increased once more.

Ding Ling felt even stronger by a margin, if multiplied by forty times, this margin of strength would be greatly influential, now battling the Immortal God, Ding Ling might be able to kill him within a few moments!
Upon reaching the Shattered Realm.
Improving strength by a margin becomes extremely difficult!
Just look at Immortal God, Demon Lord, Emperor Shitian, etc., they’ve lived for many years but still haven’t reached the Middle Tier of Shattering!
As Ding Ling stepped into the Shattered Realm, he became increasingly aware of Emperor Shitian and the others’ strength and cultivation.
In front of Ding Ling, they practically had no secrets left.
Splat!
Ding Ling tossed Luo Xian’s corpse aside.
This Luo Xian thought he was an emperor, would be magnanimous, favoring the fierce and courageous? So she acted with stubborn resolve?
She overthought.
Indeed Ding Ling liked fierce and courageous people, but certainly wouldn’t favor those who insult him!
"Divine Mother Luo Xian..."
Wuming couldn’t help but speak:
"Ding Ling, I think it’s unnecessary to kill so many people."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling glanced sideways, just saying:

"The merger of World Association and Unrivaled City, my plan to unify Jiuzhou has spread widely. The Celestial Sect, with numerous ears and eyes, must know this, but they still chose to side with Emperor Shitian and oppose me. What is their intention?"
Furthermore, Ding Ling and Emperor Shitian were already at daggers drawn.
This was even more widely known.
Wuming evidently thought of this, feeling somewhat unnatural, refrained from speaking further, but felt a bit unwilling.
Ding Ling understood Wuming.
This is just his character.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have become the Martial Arts Myth that many admire.
Ding Ling didn’t say much to Wuming, just headed down to the next layer, Free Earth Realm.
The Unmoving Human Realm was the palace’s first layer, embedded in the earth’s surface first layer! Unmoving like a mountain, indomitable!
The second layer had many entrances, none guarded.
Ding Ling followed the map as if seeking a steed.
Quickly.
But didn’t see anyone along the way.
Until he reached the very center of the Free Earth Realm, in a Main Hall, he saw a man, hands crossed behind his back, who exuded an extraordinary aura.
He first made a salute towards Ding Ling, then said:

"I am the Celestial Sect’s Divine Judgment Divine Calculator. I anticipated that this time Celestial Sect would cease to exist. I wanted to flee, but after much thought, I decided to stay and pledge allegiance to Hero Ding!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling glanced at the Divine Calculator:
"Are you sincere?
"As honest as heaven and earth!"
The Divine Calculator solemnly said:
"Hero Ding, Emperor Shitian is rampant, lawless, a touch neurotic! He boasts to be the unparalleled, singular god on earth, unrivalled to the extreme.
But after being defeated by you, his aura became extremely downcast.

During this time, he hid in the Celestial Gate Void Sacred Realm, no one knows what he was doing. I only know one thing, many experts in the Celestial Sect have turned into monstrous beasts, neither human nor ghost!"
"Monstrous beasts?!"
Wuming was moved:
"Where?"
"At the entrance to the third layer Void Sacred Realm."
The Divine Calculator sighed:

"The second layer Free Earth Realm is empty because Emperor Shitian cleared it. If not for the low cultivation of Unmoving Human Realm people, not catching Emperor Shitian’s eye, they would suffer too!
But as it turns out, quite a few people in Unmoving Human Realm have suffered."
His eyes flashed with hatred, fear:
"Emperor Shitian is deranged! No, he has long been mad. I followed him, out of no choice. Because I know, if I don’t obey, he kills me. I don’t want to die, so I complied.
Someone who adapts to circumstances is a hero. Now Emperor Shitian was defeated by Hero Ding. I can finally breathe easy, joining your camp, no longer under Emperor Shitian’s manipulation."
Wuming’s expression turned subtle.
But Ding Ling said:
"Where is Emperor Shitian?"
"No one knows where he is."
The Divine Calculator shook his head and said:

"He ordered Luo Xian and me to guard Celestial Sect’s Unmoving Human Realm and Free Earth Realm, or face death upon any negligence. How could I resist? I dutifully complied. Fortunately and joyfully, I indeed awaited Hero Ding’s arrival!"
"Given this, you shall be a Divine Calculator within the Great Ming Dynasty."
Ding Ling knew of the Divine Calculator.

His fortune-telling and fate-forecasting skills were extremely high; he helped Emperor Shitian deduce the time point of the great calamity, along with the Divine Dragon’s specific location and time point.
With him, it would be much easier for Ding Ling to locate the Divine Dragon next.
That was secondary.

The main reason was that this Divine Calculator observed people and events very thoroughly; his insight was high. He greatly recognized Ding Ling’s side, otherwise, Ding Ling wouldn’t have easily accepted him.
"I shall lead the way for the Master."
After joining Ding Ling.
The Divine Calculator immediately changed address naturally calling Ding Ling the Master, then leading the way ahead.

[Note: Your arrival was so swift that Luo Xian didn’t even have the time to organize her followers to retreat.

Faced with you, she was panicked and at a loss, but when she learned that you needed the Holy Heart Technique, she calmed down considerably, originally intending to use the ’rather die than surrender’ approach to test waters and facilitate subsequent provocations and other tactics against you.
Unexpectedly, she didn’t even get to speak, and you killed her.
She was filled with disbelief, bewilderment, and helplessness at the time of her death.]

This True Qi can greatly enhance one’s lifespan, not to mention it can heal oneself and others!
But this Holy Heart True Qi belonged to someone else.
Not her own.
So once it’s used up, it’s likely very difficult to restore.
Even if restored, it would most likely only recover to her self-cultivated ’incomplete’ Holy Heart True Qi, impossible to reach this Perfection Level High Tier Holy Heart True Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 651: Mingyue
paragraphs: A winding and twisting path.
A moment later.
The Divine Calculator pointed to a complex mountain path ahead and said:
"Ahead is the domain of the legendary beasts. Defeat them, and you can enter the Void Sacred Realm."
Ding Ling released Little Zhao’s hand, stepped on the Free-Will Ascension Step, and in an instant, appeared at the entrance of the mountain path.
He looked around.
The mountain path twisted like a dragon or snake, with a small path spiraling up to the top of the cave wall, resembling a serpent’s flicking tongue.
And at the very top of this small path, perched a young girl with no expression, cold eyes, ten slender fingers, and nails three feet long, like ten sharp blades growing from her hands!

Upon seeing Ding Ling, she suddenly pounced down from the path, her ten ’blades’ opening wide, slashing wildly toward Ding Ling. In an instant, vigorous qi exploded, forming a blade storm so fierce it seemed poised to engulf Ding Ling!
Ding Ling activated his Protective Gang Qi Shield.

The blade storm clattered against Ding Ling’s shield, leaving him unscathed. With a twist and turn of the Qiankun Great Shift, the blade storm spiraled back toward the young girl with even greater speed.
Watching the girl about to meet her doom,
The Divine Calculator couldn’t help but gasp:
"Master, wait. This is Mingyue!"
Ding Ling swiftly withdrew his hand, redirecting the storm to crash into a wall, rumbling as rocks fell.
Yet the girl showed no gratitude, continuing her emotionless and frantic charge at Ding Ling.
Ignoring her attack, Ding Ling waved his hand, sending a burst of Dragon Capturing Skill to bind her, snapping!
The girl fell to the ground.
Her face hit the earth, and blood instantly oozed from her forehead, but she ignored it, only howling like a wild beast.
"Mingyue... she’s gone mad."
The Divine Calculator approached and sighed:
"Those who take Beast Medicine end up like this."
"Roar!"
Mingyue continued to howl incessantly.
Wuming’s expression changed drastically:
"To think there’s such a beast medicine in this world."
"Look ahead."
The Divine Calculator pointed forward:

"Only those with strong willpower and noble bloodlines partially mutate. Mingyue’s mere nail mutation is considered rare. Those with average bloodlines and weak willpower transform into all sorts of strange shapes."
Wuming looked.
Sure enough.
Perhaps the battle here disturbed the beasts deep within Snake Dao, as they began charging over.
Some had wolf heads and human bodies, or were outright giant wolves!
There were also others in leopard and tiger forms.
In an instant.
A dance of chaos among the beasts.
As if they had fallen into a demonic realm!
Wuming trembled, not from fear, but anger!
In his view, Emperor Shitian’s actions were utterly inhumane! Truly deserving of death!
Ding Ling delivered a chop, knocking Mingyue unconscious, and then charged into the horde of beasts!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Boundless sword intent transformed into countless Spirit Killing Swords, sweeping over the beasts like a tidal wave!
Thud!
Thud!
Each beast, charged halfway, was pierced by a Spirit Killing Sword, their consciousness body shattered, eyes turning ashen—truly dead!
When the consciousness body dies.
That signifies true death!
Ding Ling knew why these people had turned out this way.
But in his eyes, these people had mutated too thoroughly to be saved, so killing was more straightforward.
Bam bam bam!
Each beast fell to the ground, motionless!
Ding Ling’s killing was too swift!
Using Free-Will Ascension Step, he dashed back and forth through the beast horde like a ghostly phantom.
In just a few blinks of an eye.
He returned to his original position.
The once-ferocious beasts lay dead without exception!

The Divine Calculator had heard of Ding Ling’s prowess, but witnessing it firsthand left him secretly astounded and deeply impressed. He thought, no wonder he could defeat Emperor Shitian, truly extraordinary!
One must know these beasts each had Grandmaster Level, even Grandmaster battle power!
A few even had Shattering Level combat ability.
Yet.
Ding Ling easily cut through them like a hot knife through butter, killing them instantly here.
Such cheap deaths!
One must know, a Grandmaster could establish a sect in the outer world, let alone a Grandmaster!
However, these Grandmasters were obtained through Beast Medicines that ravaged the body and spirit, making them unstable.
Subsequently, Ding Ling used the Eternal Youth Technique to absorb their skills, feeling profound changes.
Though the beasts seemed strong.
They lacked the vigorous and profound power evident in the wolf demon Ding Ling encountered in Lingyun Cave previously.
Despite this.
None were much weaker than Pojun, indicating they were experts of that tier before transforming into beasts! Icons in Jianghu!
[Inner Power Value +80]
[Inner Power Value +60]
[Inner Power Value +70]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Six had frenzied due to Beast Medicine, reaching Shattering Level combat power, but were actually Grandmaster Tier experts at heart!
Due to cultivation techniques far inferior to World-Ending Demon Body, conversion efficiency was much lower. Averaging around 90 points each.
Ultimately:
[Inner Power Value +540]
Twenty Grandmaster Tier experts. Due to even poorer cultivation techniques, conversion efficiency was much lower.
Averaging around 30 points each.
Total [Inner Power Value +600]
In a fleeting moment.
Eleven strands of Longevity True Qi formed in his Dantian.
Combined with an earlier one.
Three into one.
Four additional drops of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 71 points]
Boom!
A stronger Shattering True Intent surged forth from Ding Ling’s body!
This was breaking through a new shackle, reaching the Middle Tier of Shattering!
Bai Suzhen glanced aside, moved.
Wuming was shaken.
"So quickly another breakthrough?! Such a technique of absorbing others’ cultivation without going astray? Truly rare."
Bai Suzhen marveled deeply.
Knowing this must be Ding Ling’s technique to protect his heart meridian.
If others used such a method recklessly, they would surely lose themselves in the rise of power, becoming slaves to power, unwittingly used by evil spirits.
But Ding Ling had a heart full of Righteous Qi and Buddha Qi, warding off evil! Naturally, he would never be lost.
"Middle Tier of Shattering."
Ding Ling pondered deeply.
Reaching this level.
The Shattering True Qi in his Dantian once again sublimed and condensed, becoming stronger.
Subsequent absorption and refinement of these Grandmaster and Grandmaster Level True Qi for self-enhancement would undoubtedly be more challenging.
Sure enough.
Ding Ling then went to absorb some Innate Experts’ True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
True Qi quantity plummeted!
This was not only due to the weaker cultivation techniques but fundamentally because Ding Ling had grown stronger.
Their True Qi paled in comparison to Ding Ling’s Shattering True Qi.
Ultimately, only a wisp remained to be absorbed by Ding Ling’s Eternal Youth Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 652: The Threefold Power of the Medicine
paragraphs: Ding Ling was not bothered.
He walked along the path.
A total of 83 Innate Experts were completely absorbed.
[Inner Power Value +102]
"I initially thought a Grandmaster level could increase about 80 points. Grandmaster Great Perfection could have 100 points. It seems I was mistaken."
After all, not everyone is Pojun.
Nor can everyone practice such Shattering Level arts like the World-Ending Demon Body!
Moreover.
These people, after transforming into beasts, their True Qi dissipated a lot, and it became much more impure!
To obtain so much, to achieve such growth.
Ding Ling was satisfied.
He glanced at Mingyue lying on the ground, then looked at Divine Calculator:
"Why is Mingyue here?"
"It was Emperor Shitian who revived her and fed her Beast Medicine, attempting to control her to use her in the future to threaten and manipulate Nie Feng!"
Divine Calculator paused for a moment, then said:

"After all, Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun are natural-born Wind and Cloud! Geniuses that are rarely seen in a thousand years. Their future prospects are immeasurable. It’s understandable that Emperor Shitian would save Mingyue to control Nie Feng."
Ding Ling asked no more and merely glanced at Mingyue twice.
This Mingyue had a face as beautiful as flowers, graceful and charming, with an aura of freshness, no wonder many people fancy her.
Ding Ling knew the location of Mingyue’s fall and had even brought Nie Feng down to look for her.
Unfortunately, they couldn’t find anyone.
At that time, he was quite puzzled.
Now it seems.
It must have been Emperor Shitian who took Mingyue away before him.
Players intervened.
The plot broke down.
Emperor Shitian’s Celestial Sect’s strength was extraordinary, with eyes and ears all over Jiuzhou, through players’ words, he would know many secret matters, which is naturally common.
Mingyue’s fate changed here, it seems understandable now.
Ding Ling placed his hand on Mingyue’s pulse, feeling carefully.
A majestic medicinal power was rampaging through Mingyue’s meridians, this power enhanced her strength!
But within the medicinal power, there was a potent demonic nature and a mysterious power!
This power could mess with one’s mind, causing mutations in the body.
Ding Ling had ways to deal with the demonic power.
He activated the Demon Scripture.
Extracting this demonic power.
Ding Ling’s strength advanced once more, the Demon Scripture also rose accordingly, making its use much more convenient and terrifying!
This was like a master using the simplest Long Fist to knock down a group of people!
Similarly, with Ding Ling’s strength increase, the Demon Scripture he wielded was naturally much more formidable!
In an instant, the demonic power within Mingyue was completely extracted.
The Inner Power Value didn’t change at all.
It was because Mingyue’s strength was merely in the Innate Realm, though enhanced by Beast Medicine, achieving the battle power of a Grandmaster.
But it was only extracting the demonic power, not all of Mingyue’s strength, so the Inner Power Value increase was almost zero.
Ding Ling didn’t care.
Instead, he focused on that mysterious power.
This power was the key to Mingyue’s bodily mutations.
Ding Ling couldn’t quite understand this power, for now, he termed it as Demon Power!
After the demonic power was gone.

Mingyue’s body trembled a bit, suddenly opened her eyes, she saw Ding Ling, first bewildered, puzzled, without understanding, but soon, she gasped in shock, looked down at her hand, upon seeing it, her pupils shrank, almost uncontrollably letting out a scream.
"Quiet."
Divine Calculator’s voice seemed to contain a warm, soothing power, calming people’s emotions, his voice calmed Mingyue significantly, he pointed at Ding Ling, taking the opportunity to say:
"Mingyue, my lord saved you. Will you not thank him?"
"Thank you, benefactor, for saving me!"
Mingyue quickly offered a formal bow of thanks.
"Do you remember what happened to you?"
Ding Ling asked.
"I have some impressions."
Mingyue seemed like she wanted to hold her head, but with ’blades’ on her ten fingers, she couldn’t do it, and said in frustration:

"That day, after Dugu Yifang knocked me off the cliff, I was falling all the way down and landed at the bottom of the Abyss. Luckily, as I kept falling, I bumped into several trees growing on the steep walls, borrowing force a few times, thus barely survived. But because I was injured by Dugu Yifang and then further hurt from the fall, knowing I wouldn’t live long.
Resigned to death.
In a daze, I don’t know how long passed. It seemed I saw a man with an ice-statue mask descend from the sky, saying something to me, then grabbing me and soaring up to the sky.
After that.
I saw you all. What exactly happened during this time, why I became like this, I don’t know at all."
Ding Ling nodded:
"Do you miss Nie Feng?"
"Nie Feng."
Speaking of Nie Feng, Mingyue’s almond eyes instantly lit up, she said excitedly:
"Is he okay?"
’He’s fine.’
Wuming interjected:
"He also acknowledged your benefactor as Venerable Lord! With your benefactor there, how could anything happen to Nie Feng."
"So benefactor is Nie Feng’s Venerable Lord."
Mingyue immediately showed great respect towards Ding Ling:
"Benefactor saved Mingyue, Mingyue has no way to repay, willing to follow Venerable Lord!"
She was indeed smart.
Knowing Ding Ling saved her.
So she wanted to see if Ding Ling could remove the ’blades’ on her hands.

Ding Ling’s idea was to use a Divine Weapon to cut them off, but with ten fingers connected to the heart, using brute force would severely injure Mingyue, furthermore, these blades were extremely tough and sharp, appeared quite extraordinary, seemingly related to that Demon Power.
Magic Power controls the mind.
Demon Power enhances strength.

Ding Ling then let Mingyue try to harness the Demon Power, and said her bloodline was extraordinary, if she could subdue this Demon Power, perhaps the blades could retract and extend as she wished, for her use!
Mingyue nodded, solemnly said:
"Venerable Lord, I understand. I will surely subdue this Demon Power!"
Even if it’s to become a normal human being in the future, to meet Nie Feng with a perfect appearance!
Mingyue felt it necessary to overcome and control this Demon Power in a short time.
"What is the fundamental principle of Beast Medicine?"
Bai Suzhen asked.

"It’s a mix of three powers. Magic Power controls the mind, Demon Power causes mutations, Medicinal Power increases strength. A Beast Medicine ingested. Some with extraordinary bloodlines may experience a tenfold, twentyfold increase in strength. But this way, their bloodline power is completely exhausted, future potential is exhausted."
Ding Ling had sensed a few corpses.
Also experimented on Mingyue.
He was quite clear on this.
After all, he was a peerless Divine Doctor connecting heaven and earth! Researching the human body was at his fingertips!
"To make Beast Medicine, medicinal power and magic power are not hard to acquire. Difficult is this Demon Power. I’m quite curious where Emperor Shitian got this power from."
Ding Ling looked at Divine Calculator.
Divine Calculator said:
"I’m not sure about this either, but I can calculate through divination."
"Go ahead and calculate."
Divine Calculator immediately took out a palm-sized tortoise shell from his bosom.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 653: Void Sacred Realm
paragraphs: He took out eight copper coins again.

The Divine Calculator tossed the copper coins onto a tortoise shell, murmuring incantations. Before long, his body trembled, his face turned pale, and blood trickled from the corner of his mouth. With a loud shout, he suddenly grabbed the copper coins, laid them flat in his palm, examined them closely, then looked at Ding Ling and said:
"Master, I have done my best."
"Speak."
"The source of this power lies in a person. However, this person’s cultivation is as vast as the heavens. I dare not continue calculating; if I do, I fear I might die immediately!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling said thoughtfully:
"In that case, forget it."
In this world, aside from the Divine Calculator before him, Mud Bodhisattva was also exceptionally skilled in fortune-telling and fate reading.
But Ding Ling had never met the Mud Bodhisattva.

However, the Mud Bodhisattva’s fortune-telling skills were unrivaled in the world, frequently leaking celestial secrets, and thus he faced celestial punishment, which showed that the divination skill was only so-so.
Ding Ling directly asked the Divine Calculator for the divination skill.
The Divine Calculator didn’t dare to refuse and recited the heart method mantra.
The next second.
[Divination Skill Full Level]
[Charisma +0.1]
Once it reached full level.
Ding Ling’s mind was instantly filled with all kinds of mysterious information points.
Ding Ling calculated with his fingers and immediately deduced many events in this world.
But when he tried to calculate deeper.
It was as if he touched the "Inverted Scale" of the heavens.
It seemed heaven was clearly telling him that if he calculated further, he would surely face celestial punishment!
Ding Ling glanced at the Divine Calculator, seeing his face pale, clearly not yet recovered from the previous calculation, and immediately abandoned the thought of continuing.
Even though the divination skill might not leak celestial secrets, it would still encounter celestial punishment!
No wonder the Mud Bodhisattva was unwilling to engage in fortune-telling and fate reading anymore.
This divination skill was truly too much of a chicken rib!
"Master."
The Divine Calculator noticed Ding Ling possessed an inexplicable familiar aura and couldn’t help but be astonished:
"You learned the divination skill?"
"Having listened, it’s only natural that I learned it."
The Divine Calculator, recalling the legends about Ding Ling, was tongue-tied and didn’t think further, only saying:

’Since Master has learned this divination skill, you should understand. This divination skill is difficult to learn and master. Without reaching Great Perfection in cultivation, one would need to rely on tools. Once reaching Great Perfection, one could find results by mere finger calculation, but if one forces it, there will still be great terror and great backlash!’

Recalling Ding Ling’s finger calculations just now, the Divine Calculator’s eye twitched twice. He had been practicing the divination skill for decades and still hadn’t reached Great Perfection. And Ding Ling?
The gap is simply too vast!
In his heart, he was dejected, yet he couldn’t help but see Ding Ling as celestial, becoming increasingly respectful towards him.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You’ve won the Divine Calculator’s high recognition.]
[Note: Your talent impressed him! Left him in awe, and from now on, he will willingly serve as your subordinate!]
Hearing the notification sound,
Ding Ling wasn’t very surprised.
This Divine Calculator was quite cunning; gaining his recognition was not easy.
Now that Ding Ling had learned his proud divination skill in an instant, he had completely subdued him!
"Let’s keep moving forward."
With Ding Ling’s divination skill at Great Perfection, he could naturally deduce many profound things.
But he chose not to do so.
The celestial punishment is better left untouched!
Otherwise, it would probably stick around and be impossible to shake off!
After reaching full level in divination skill.

Ding Ling knew that celestial punishment was a mark left by the Heavenly Dao on a person, gradually implanting into one’s soul until it completely eroded them, turning them into a puppet of the Heavenly Dao!
Ding Ling was never willing to become such a puppet.

He glanced at the Divine Calculator, who was completely unaware. Needless to say, the Divine Calculator surely didn’t know this point, and since he was now Ding Ling’s subordinate and genuinely acknowledged him, Ding Ling told him about the residual effects of the divination skill.
The Divine Calculator was terrified, repeatedly wiping his sweat, vowing never to misuse the divination skill again.
It’s said nicely to be the divination skill.
But it’s a skill that curses oneself if used.
Ding Ling would be foolish to use it.
It’s fine to use it for ordinary affairs, but deeper connections are better left untouched to avoid celestial punishment!
Clip-clop!
The group passed through the Snake Dao and entered a cavern.
There were ten roads in all directions here.
Ding Ling had a map and chose the third west road.
Proceeding by following the map.
With many twists and turns.
After some time.
Ding Ling finally reached the Void Sacred Realm!
This Void Sacred Realm was hidden within the belly of the Heaven-Reaching Mountain. To reach here, one must pass through maze-like passageways and checkpoints.
Without a map,
It’s very difficult to find the way here!
However, upon reaching here, Ding Ling looked around and saw ice sculptures and blocks everywhere.
This mountain belly was a gigantic natural ice chamber.
Even rooms storing books, secret manuals, and great medicine were made of ice.
Ding Ling spotted a room a hundred meters away.
After verifying no traps with numerous tossed stones, Ding Ling leisurely and swiftly walked into one of the rooms.
The room had no door.
The scattered secret manuals and great medicine inside were visible at a glance.
Ding Ling picked up the great medicine and glanced at it.
Two to three hundred years old.
No poison.
With a gulp, the spiritual vitality within was rapidly refined.
"It’s edible."
Ding Ling nodded, noticing that there were dozens of boxes of great medicine here.
So, he began opening each box and munching away.
He ate quickly.
’Swallowed whole.’
But the refining speed was even quicker!
Basically, it was refined as soon as eaten.
As his strength kept growing, many divine skills reached full levels.
Ding Ling’s power became increasingly terrifying.
The ability to refine now amplified tenfold with the Divine Form Power, making the refining speed incredibly fast.
Each one was instantly refined!
Over five hundred plants of two to three hundred-year-old great medicine were consumed by Ding Ling.
Taking less than a quarter of an hour.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling exhaled.
Feeling very satisfied.
Because at this moment, the constant sense of emptiness within him finally vanished.
Previously having obtained the Demon Lord’s true inheritance,
The increase in body attribute points was significant.
Causing Ding Ling to always be in a state of hunger.
But different from before.
With the Great Perfection of the two Divine Forms of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, Ding Ling’s tolerance towards hunger had also reached an astonishing level!
Not only was his body refining complete, but his True Qi also broke into the Shattered Realm, enhancing Ding Ling’s ability to resist hunger to a certain degree!
Therefore,
He could increase so many attribute points at once without passing out, which would previously have been unbearable.
He then turned his attention to the secret manuals beside him.
The first one surprised him.
It was "Iron Refining Hand"!
This martial art was one of the top ten arduous and marvelous skills in the Wind and Cloud World! The difficulty of cultivating this skill could be imagined!
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate and began flipping through it quickly.
Soon after, a book took form in his library.
In an instant.
[Iron Refining Hand Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 654: Great Divine Official
paragraphs: In an instant, Iron Refining Hand reached full level.
Ding Ling mastered all the esoteric truths and essence of Iron Refining Hand.
This form of martial arts is indeed extraordinary.
It is divided into five layers: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.
When cultivated to the final layer, one can meld metal and iron with bare hands into different weapons, truly a top-tier ’skill’!

For ordinary people to cultivate this martial art, they must endure the pain of blazing fire burning their heart, and must first forge their heart; only by forging the heart can they avoid the torment of being destroyed by flames!
Yet Ding Ling instantly reached full level in this skill.
He directly bypassed this painful cultivation process and achieved the most perfect Ruyi Realm.
With open hands, he could emit an extremely scorching temperature, so high that melting metal and iron was as easy as pie!
It was this high-temperature flame that allowed the metal and iron to be melted into different weapons.
After watching Iron Refining Hand.
Ding Ling began to look at other martial arts.
These martial arts were extraordinary.
Almost all were first-class or higher secret manuals!
It was obvious.
Emperor Shitian didn’t bother with those below first-class secret manuals and didn’t collect them in this Void Sacred Realm.
Ding Ling read quickly.
One martial art after another reached full level in his hands.
There weren’t many secret manuals here, just a few hundred.
Ding Ling read swiftly, completing them quickly.
All reached full level.
Because Ding Ling’s power had reached the Middle Stage of Shattering Realm, his body refining cultivation was increasingly terrifying.
Making even first-class secret manuals that could only be cultivated to the Innate Realm useless to him; they could only enhance his foundation.
Only secret manuals cultivated to Grandmaster, Great Grandmaster, or even Shattering Levels could significantly boost his attribute points.
As for such secret manuals.
There were only a few dozen.
Because secret manuals cultivated to Grandmaster level had very small growth increments, the final attribute point increase was:
[Strength +3.5]
[Agility +3.9]
[Endurance +3.8]
After reading all the secret manuals and consuming all the great medicine here.
Ding Ling walked to the next room.
It contained some medicinal wine.
Ding Ling opened and drank a bottle, it was highly toxic.
But he was not afraid.
He was immune to all poisons.
How could mere poison harm him?
He drank hundreds of jars of medicinal wine in one go.
The hunger caused by the greatly increased attribute points disappeared once more.
After drinking, Ding Ling left the room and chose to continue onward.
The internal space of this Void Sacred Realm was intricate and complex.
Resembling a small maze.
The secret manuals, medicinal wine, and great medicine placed at the entrance could only be considered appetizers.
The deeper he went.
The higher the treasures and great medicine he saw.
"Emperor Shitian doesn’t seem to be here."

Wuming watched the secret manual of Iron Refining Hand, and after reading it, he couldn’t help but gasp. Such a secret manual was too hard to cultivate, requiring too much suffering; it was not suitable for him to train.
Yet Ding Ling could reach Great Perfection in such a secret manual instantly; it was unfathomable to Wuming. Didn’t he need to forge his heart either?!
Although waves were surging in his heart, after following Ding Ling for a while and not finding the key figure here, he couldn’t help but say:
"It seems the Great Demon has escaped."
He looked toward Mingyue.
Mingyue looked confused:
"After taking the beast medicine you mentioned, my mind was dazed, seemingly completely out of self-control. Memories of that time seem to not exist as well."

She lacked keen insight and didn’t notice Ding Ling instantly mastering various divine skill secret manuals, but the fact that Ding Ling took medicine and drank medicinal wine without batting an eyelid, consuming so much without any issue, left her in awe of him as a celestial being.
She thought to herself, worthy of being the Venerable Lord! Truly too powerful!
Bang, bang!

Just as Ding Ling and his group reached a room’s entrance, two figures suddenly sprang out one after another and crashed into the stone wall beside them. With a clanging sound that passed everyone’s ears, upon looking again, the two figures vanished into thin air.
"Who are they?!"
Bai Suzhen couldn’t help but shout.
Their speed was too fast.
And their aura was grand and boundless, like deities descending to survey the world! It was simply overpoweringly majestic!
From their aura, it could be judged that the person must be extremely magnificent and domineering!
"I recognize one of them; it should be the Divine Official."

Divine Calculator quickly stepped forward and looked inside the icehouse, seeing it in utter disarray; the weapon racks and bookshelves holding secret manuals were all overturned, causing his expression to change slightly as he said:
"We’ve almost reached the very center of this Void Sacred Realm! Emperor Shitian’s good stuff must be stored around here. The Divine Official might have taken the stuff with someone else just now."
"Divine Official?"
Ding Ling looked askance.
"Indeed."
Divine Calculator said solemnly:

"There are five Divine Officials in the Celestial Sect! Officially, only one Divine Official is said to be responsible for collecting martial arts secret manuals and rare treasures for Emperor Shitian! But that’s not true; there are actually five Divine Officials collecting martial arts secret manuals and rare treasures. They wear the same attire, wear masks, and their manner of speaking and martial arts are identical, which is why people in the Celestial Sect mistakenly think there’s only one Divine Official."
"How do you know there are five?"
Mingyue asked curiously.
"I met the Great Divine Official."
Divine Calculator’s expression was momentarily dazed but quickly regained focus as he said:

"The Great Divine Official is the strongest among the five. Only Emperor Shitian can hold her down. But she doesn’t show off or reveal herself and is extremely low-key. Only through my proficiency in divination skills, risking celestial punishment, was I able to discern her details in close proximity. Once she knew she couldn’t hide from me, we became friends.
Thus, I learned that the five Divine Officials are all orphans and were nurtured by Emperor Shitian since a very young age as ’tools’!
Each of them is prodigiously talented.

The Great Divine Official has lived the longest, over two hundred years. But she must follow Emperor Shitian’s orders because without being infused with his Holy Heart True Qi and given Longevity Pills, she wouldn’t live long.
She desperately wants to change this situation, as she doesn’t want to be a tool, but unfortunately, she struggled to succeed.
And now, she might have seen that Emperor Shitian’s days are numbered and chose to take a risky gamble. It seemed that one of the people I saw just now was her."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling glanced sideways:
"If Emperor Shitian left, how could he not take the five Divine Officials with him?"
"Mythical beasts also need someone to control them. And perhaps Emperor Shitian has passed on the technique to control the beasts to the Divine Official, letting her stop you, my lord."
Divine Calculator said:
"Yet Emperor Shitian could never have imagined that even the six top mythical beasts he painstakingly trained couldn’t withstand a single casual strike from you!
To know, after six Grandmasters consumed beast medicine, they all had Shattering Level combat power. Even one casually dispatched could sweep the entire Jianghu!
A full six, plus five Divine Officials assisting from behind, should have been able to hold you back at least somewhat. Alas, even the six top mythical beasts were not up to the task!
The Great Divine Official apparently realized this too, which is why she opted to enter this Void Sacred Realm to seize some treasures and secret manuals."

sentences.text: In an instant, Iron Refining Hand reached full level.
Ding Ling mastered all the esoteric truths and essence of Iron Refining Hand.
This form of martial arts is indeed extraordinary.
It is divided into five layers: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.
When cultivated to the final layer, one can meld metal and iron with bare hands into different weapons, truly a top-tier ’skill’!

For ordinary people to cultivate this martial art, they must endure the pain of blazing fire burning their heart, and must first forge their heart; only by forging the heart can they avoid the torment of being destroyed by flames!
Yet Ding Ling instantly reached full level in this skill.
He directly bypassed this painful cultivation process and achieved the most perfect Ruyi Realm.
With open hands, he could emit an extremely scorching temperature, so high that melting metal and iron was as easy as pie!
It was this high-temperature flame that allowed the metal and iron to be melted into different weapons.
After watching Iron Refining Hand.
Ding Ling began to look at other martial arts.
These martial arts were extraordinary.
Almost all were first-class or higher secret manuals!
It was obvious.
Emperor Shitian didn’t bother with those below first-class secret manuals and didn’t collect them in this Void Sacred Realm.
Ding Ling read quickly.
One martial art after another reached full level in his hands.
There weren’t many secret manuals here, just a few hundred.
Ding Ling read swiftly, completing them quickly.
All reached full level.
Because Ding Ling’s power had reached the Middle Stage of Shattering Realm, his body refining cultivation was increasingly terrifying.
Making even first-class secret manuals that could only be cultivated to the Innate Realm useless to him; they could only enhance his foundation.
Only secret manuals cultivated to Grandmaster, Great Grandmaster, or even Shattering Levels could significantly boost his attribute points.
As for such secret manuals.
There were only a few dozen.
Because secret manuals cultivated to Grandmaster level had very small growth increments, the final attribute point increase was:
[Strength +3.5]
[Agility +3.9]
[Endurance +3.8]
After reading all the secret manuals and consuming all the great medicine here.
Ding Ling walked to the next room.
It contained some medicinal wine.
Ding Ling opened and drank a bottle, it was highly toxic.
But he was not afraid.
He was immune to all poisons.
How could mere poison harm him?
He drank hundreds of jars of medicinal wine in one go.
The hunger caused by the greatly increased attribute points disappeared once more.
After drinking, Ding Ling left the room and chose to continue onward.
The internal space of this Void Sacred Realm was intricate and complex.
Resembling a small maze.
The secret manuals, medicinal wine, and great medicine placed at the entrance could only be considered appetizers.
The deeper he went.
The higher the treasures and great medicine he saw.
"Emperor Shitian doesn’t seem to be here."
Wuming watched the secret manual of Iron Refining Hand, and after reading it, he couldn’t help but gasp.
Such a secret manual was too hard to cultivate, requiring too much suffering; it was not suitable for him to train.
Yet Ding Ling could reach Great Perfection in such a secret manual instantly; it was unfathomable to Wuming.
Didn’t he need to forge his heart either?!
Although waves were surging in his heart, after following Ding Ling for a while and not finding the key figure here, he couldn’t help but say:
"It seems the Great Demon has escaped."
He looked toward Mingyue.
Mingyue looked confused:
"After taking the beast medicine you mentioned, my mind was dazed, seemingly completely out of self-control.
Memories of that time seem to not exist as well."

She lacked keen insight and didn’t notice Ding Ling instantly mastering various divine skill secret manuals, but the fact that Ding Ling took medicine and drank medicinal wine without batting an eyelid, consuming so much without any issue, left her in awe of him as a celestial being.
She thought to herself, worthy of being the Venerable Lord!
Truly too powerful!
Bang, bang!
Just as Ding Ling and his group reached a room’s entrance, two figures suddenly sprang out one after another and crashed into the stone wall beside them.
With a clanging sound that passed everyone’s ears, upon looking again, the two figures vanished into thin air.
"Who are they?!"
Bai Suzhen couldn’t help but shout.

From their aura, it could be judged that the person must be extremely magnificent and domineering!

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 655: Hidden Realm
paragraphs: The five divine officials gathered secret manuals and rare treasures from all over the world to fill the library and treasure vault of the Void Sacred Realm!
No one knew better than them how many treasures were in this Void Sacred Realm!
Therefore.
After Emperor Shitian disappeared, they madly and recklessly explored the Void Sacred Realm for a while.
They naturally managed to scout the general ’geography’ of this place before Ding Ling.
Then took away the treasures.
Escaping a step ahead of Ding Ling!
Ding Ling thought clearly, took a deep breath, and then said:
"Forget it. If the divine officials don’t oppose me, I’ll let it go. Otherwise, I definitely won’t spare them."
"Don’t worry, my lord."
Divine Calculator solemnly said:
"I don’t know about the other four divine officials, but I will definitely persuade the Great Divine Official to side with you, my lord!"
Ding Ling smiled noncommittally.
He didn’t care whether the Great Divine Official would join him or not.
What he cared about was how many treasures and books these divine officials took away!
His previous guess was correct.
The medicine he took and the wine he drank at the entrance were things these divine officials didn’t care for.
After all, the Great Medicine was just ordinary medicine of two or three hundred years, not to mention, these divine officials had already developed a resistance to it.
Taking this Great Medicine probably wouldn’t work!
And the wine was poisonous!
As for the secret manuals.

Besides the strongest Iron Refining Hand, other secret manuals, though good, were not easy to learn. They were all difficult and painstaking techniques, and many might not master a single one in their lifetime!
The divine officials naturally had no reason not to practice the Holy Heart Technique and opt for Iron Refining Hand, a martial art that takes half a life.
"Who is the other person with the Great Divine Official?"
"This... I don’t know either."
"In that case. Let’s first check out the situation here in the Earth Realm before discussing anything else."
Ding Ling used the Free-Will Ascension Step, pulling Little Zhao as he darted ahead.
He wanted to take a tour around this place first.
After gauging the general situation here, he would look up books and search for secret treasures.
To avoid the hidden treasures being snagged by others again!
Having suffered a hidden loss once.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t let it happen again.
Emperor Shitian was frightened away by him.
He had broken through the Celestial Sect.
How could he let others feast on crab while he himself ate leftovers?

Previously, it was understandable as he didn’t notice or consider this point, having slain his way through from the Unmoving Human Realm, with the Divine Mother Luo Xian dead, and even the Divine Calculator had surrendered.
Besides Mingyue, all the beasts were dead!
Who else could stop him?
Or act as the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind?
Even if there were.

With his side having Celestial Sword Nameless, Demon Lord Bai Suzhen, Divine Judgment Divine Calculator, along with a surging demon power-imbued Mingyue, such a top-notch lineup, who would Ding Ling need to fear?!
It was precisely this mindset that allowed the Great Divine Official and that overbearing person to seize the lead.
However, even though they seized it, Ding Ling was not angry.
As long as they didn’t provoke him and weren’t from Emperor Shitian’s side.
Ding Ling didn’t care to bother them.
Especially since Divine Calculator claimed to be friends with the Great Divine Official.
For the sake of Divine Calculator, being one of his own, he naturally had to give him some face.
Whoosh! Whoosh!

Ding Ling’s speed was extremely fast. After reaching the Middle Tier of Shattering, with the enhancements from Divine Form, Breathing Technique, and Infinite Crossing, his speed was like a lightning bolt in the void.
He mastered Mechanical Skill, Stargazing Skill, and such, carefully studying the detailed situation of this realm.
He discovered that indeed, the Void Sacred Realm was full of mysteries and secret tunnels!
Just like the secret tunnel where the Great Divine Official and the overbearing person disappeared.
There one second.
Gone the next.
This was the work of a magical mechanism.
Those unfamiliar with this place find it difficult to navigate such mechanisms freely.
It’s clear.
After hundreds of years, the Great Divine Official must have grasped some of the secrets of the Void Sacred Realm.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling showed the power of Stargazing Skill, Mechanical Skill, etc., finding the key mechanism. What couldn’t be broken open temporarily, he directly struck with a palm, boom! The mechanism instantly shattered.
Ding Ling could then see passages revealing themselves.
Of course.
Some mechanisms, when destroyed, would reveal dead ends!
Therefore, Ding Ling’s strikes had to be precise.
Only by finding a true path could he seek the core area of the Void Sacred Realm.
Sprinting all the way.
Some time later.
Ding Ling had smashed through countless mechanisms and extinguished numerous hidden weapons, treading along a river condensed from poisonous water, to arrive at a secret land.
It was a small ice sculpture palace.
Only one level.
A world entirely of ice chambers.
Even the stools, chairs, and tables were sculpted from ice.
A glance over.
Ding Ling saw clearly:
There were only a few secret manuals placed on the table.
Scarce Great Medicines too.

But every single one shimmered with radiant brilliance, and Ding Ling knew at a glance that these Great Medicines must be thousands of years in age. Each one, enough to match the spiritual vitality of hundreds of ordinary two or three hundred-year-old Great Medicines!
Because the spiritual mechanism and primordial qi inside these Great Medicines had been automatically refined thousands of times over the thousands of years!
In terms of quality, they had reached a very high realm!
If given more years.
They might even become refined spirits!
Ding Ling snatched a Great Medicine out of thin air and consumed it directly.
Sure enough.
The power of this Great Medicine was exceedingly surging!

The spiritual mechanism and primordial qi inside must have been refined tens of thousands of times, far more elegant than the crude spiritual mechanism and primordial qi in ordinary two or three hundred-year-old Great Medicines, and was clearly most suitable for a Shatterer to consume!
Ordinary Great Medicines were ineffective for a Shatterer.
Only this kind of Great Medicine was effective!
"Emperor Shitian scared people away. Yet, these Great Medicines were all left behind. It seems he was genuinely frightened, and perhaps the eagle watching in secret earlier was him."
Ding Ling thought of the eagle circling in the void, which Bai Suzhen shot down!
To Emperor Shitian,
These were all external possessions.
As long as he was alive, everything would naturally be there, choosing to preserve himself first was indeed normal.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling sensed that after this Great Medicine entered his belly,
The level of the War God Technique was also skyrocketing!
The spiritual mechanism and primordial qi level in this Great Medicine were too high and abundant!
Equivalent to hundreds of two or three hundred-year-old Great Medicines, the medicinal power can be imagined.
Even with Ding Ling’s extraordinary Divine Skill, it took tenfold amplification to refine this medicinal power over time.
He didn’t linger, grabbing one Great Medicine after another in mid-air, putting them into the Storage Pouch.
While conveniently grabbing the secret manuals out of the air.

Just as he emptied all the Great Medicines and secret manuals, utilizing Stargazing Skill, Mechanical Skill, etc., he activated a mechanism on the stone wall of the dome, and was deploying the Dragon Capturing Skill to seize a box embedded high up on the stone wall when.
Boom!
A stream of light flashed through the void and disappeared.
The next moment.
The box vanished entirely!
"Who!"
Ding Ling looked toward where the light vanished, put down Little Zhao, and without hesitation, chased after it!
With Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, Divine Form Power, Infinite Crossing’s Infinite Power, and Ten Directions Invincible’s power.
Under fourfold increase.
Ding Ling’s speed reached a terribly terrifying realm, akin to a thunderbolt, so swift that even the term Shrinking Inches was insufficient to describe his speed!

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 656: Divine Guardian of the Bu Divine Race
paragraphs: Like a fierce wind and lightning.
Whoosh! A sound of breaking through the air reverberated in the sky, and Ding Ling’s figure had already vanished within this secret place.
Wuming, Bai Suzhen, Mingyue, and others exchanged glances, clearly seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
"We already knew Ding Ling’s speed was fast. But who was that person just now!"
"It’s like they’ve taken the bear’s heart and leopard’s gall, daring to snatch Ding Ling’s achievements!"
"The aura looks familiar, it should be that mysterious person previously with the Great Divine Official!"
Even someone Bai Suzhen didn’t recognize, showing the considerable mystery of this person.
Wuming sighed longly, feeling increasingly unable to be complacent. This Shenzhou Land, masters of various kinds emerged one after another, truly causing him great unease.
"I seem to have seen this person somewhere."
Bai Suzhen looked quietly at the direction Ding Ling ran off and suddenly said:
"This feeling, more and more familiar. Must have met a long time ago."
"Senior, who do you think it might be?"
Mingyue glanced sideways.
"I’ve seen too many people. Can’t recall for a moment."
Bai Suzhen frowned:
"But maybe if I think carefully, I might remember."
The Divine Calculator spoke:
"This place should be the last stop of this Void Sacred Realm. Let’s help gather some secret manuals and treasures, then when the master returns, he can take them directly."
Little Zhao agreed very much.
At once, the group began to retrace their steps and collect secret manuals, treasures, and Great Medicine hidden in other realms.
This Void Sacred Realm is full of hidden treasures.
Countless!
To say the Celestial Sect is as wealthy as a country is to belittle it!
It’s entirely as wealthy as half the world!
Besides Jiuzhou, almost all secret manuals and treasures from other regions have been collected by the five Great Divine Officials using the power of the Celestial Sect.
This generation of Divine Officials alone has been collecting for hundreds of years.
Previous Divine Officials.
And Emperor Shitian himself, it’s hard to say how many they have collected.

Mingyue, Little Zhao, Wuming and the group, despite their considerable experience, could not help clicking their tongues watching the pile of treasures like trash stacking up in one icy corner room after another.
Too affluent!
Bai Suzhen instinctively guided the group towards the direction Ding Ling was heading.
She hoped to assist Ding Ling should he encounter obstacles.
Wuming noticed and indicated that she could go and see, he and the Divine Calculator would keep an eye on things here, there shouldn’t be much problem.
Bai Suzhen thought for a moment, then nodded, turning into light and disappearing, went after Ding Ling.
Swish, swish!

Two figures, one in front and one behind, dashed rapidly through the maze realms and mechanical passageways of the Void Sacred Realm, sometimes soaring up the Ninefold Heaven like a stream of light, sometimes diving toward the Lower Realm like a meteorite, sometimes drifting lightly like a leaf, seeming frivolous yet ethereal like a cloud, disappearing at every turn!
Both were extremely fast!
But clearly, the latter was faster.
Constantly closing the gap between them.
The person in front evidently noticed, couldn’t help but glance back at Ding Ling, revealing a trace of shock in the eyes.
"Bu Jingyun!"

Ding Ling’s Free-Will Ascension Step at forty times amplification, stepping in the void, like an immortal’s leisurely pace, each step spanning hundreds of meters, astoundingly fast beyond compare, catching the mysterious figure’s turned glance and instantly capturing his face.
Unexpectedly identical to the Immortal God, Bu Jingyun!
Couldn’t help but be amazed, instinctively called out.
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s shout, the figure snorted, loudly declaring:

"Kid. Since you know Bu Jingyun, you must be aware of the extraordinary nature of my Bu Divine Race. Your talent in cultivation is exceptional. I’m very interested in you! If you’re willing to follow me, I will appoint you as my first Divine General!"
"Indeed, someone from the Bu Divine Race."
Ding Ling relaxed, chuckled softly:
"I wonder what you are called."
"The world calls me the Divine Guardian!"
Divine Guardian?
Ding Ling remembered.

This fellow is also from the Bu Divine Race, a person born after the Immortal God, of the Bu Divine Race, gifted with exceptional talent, and because the Immortal God wanted to switch heads, imprisoned the Divine Guardian intending to take his body for himself.
But now look at this.
The Divine Guardian clearly had escaped from imprisonment, and judging by the situation had obtained an extraordinary fortune, his power uncommon, slightly weaker than the Immortal God.
But in terms of speed, surpassing the Immortal God is beyond measure, extremely fast!
Clearly.
Players intruding, plots leaked extensively.
Someone with intent clearly rescued the Divine Guardian from his hiding place!
"Who rescued you!"
Ding Ling directly asked.
He had a hunch.
The one who rescued the Divine Guardian might have a very close connection with the person who killed everyone in the World Association!
This mastermind must be uncovered and eliminated.
It made Ding Ling very uncomfortable!
"My Divine Skill is unrivaled, destined to be the master of Jiuzhou. Such a divine being like me, needing rescue? Who has the qualification to rescue me?"

Divine Guardian’s face darkened, his figure transformed into a stream of light disappearing around a corner in the realm ahead, crashing into a rock wall, vanishing instantly without a trace, only his voice resonating through this world:
"Kid. If you make up your mind, send me a signal. I will surely accept you! Hahaha... This world’s Jianghu is destined to be in my grasp!"
"Arrogant!"
Ding Ling’s Stargazing Skill and Mechanical Skill continuously manifest, puncturing the rock wall immediately after Divine Guardian entered, following closely through.
Barely brushing by the dead end of the rock wall.
If slightly slower.
With the dead end locked, even if Ding Ling shattered this mechanism, it would be difficult to catch up to Divine Guardian.
Now that Ding Ling passed through this rock wall.
Ding Ling indeed wanted to see where Divine Guardian could run.
Swish, swish!

Divine Guardian was also surprised, not expecting Ding Ling could keep up, but he wasn’t afraid, instead, laughed loudly three times, his figure rapidly transitioning, already exiting the Void Sacred Realm, arriving at the entrance of a palace in the Free Earth Realm.
Here.
Two others stood.
One with white hair and purple robes, full of domineering air, yet a continual flicker of sinister intent in the eyes, giving the entire person an aura of an Evil God.
The other wearing a mask, dressed in black, graceful figure, transcendent disposition, with almond-shaped eyes, and as the gaze swept across, the room shone with radiant light.
Both noticed Divine Guardian’s appearance, feeling a tightness in their hearts.
Upon seeing Ding Ling closely chasing behind Divine Guardian, they were even more moved.

The black-clothed woman rolled her eyes quickly, wasting no time, her figure instantly transformed into misty smoke, first disappearing into the grand hall, without greeting Divine Guardian, slipping away to safety.
"Great Divine Official!"
Divine Guardian was stunned:
"Why are you fleeing?! Can we three possibly not defeat Ding Ling alone!"

Whoosh!
A sound of breaking through the air reverberated in the sky, and Ding Ling’s figure had already vanished within this secret place.
Wuming, Bai Suzhen, Mingyue, and others exchanged glances, clearly seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
"We already knew Ding Ling’s speed was fast.
But who was that person just now!"
"It’s like they’ve taken the bear’s heart and leopard’s gall, daring to snatch Ding Ling’s achievements!"
"The aura looks familiar, it should be that mysterious person previously with the Great Divine Official!"
Even someone Bai Suzhen didn’t recognize, showing the considerable mystery of this person.
Wuming sighed longly, feeling increasingly unable to be complacent.
This Shenzhou Land, masters of various kinds emerged one after another, truly causing him great unease.
"I seem to have seen this person somewhere."
Bai Suzhen looked quietly at the direction Ding Ling ran off and suddenly said:
"This feeling, more and more familiar.
Must have met a long time ago."
"Senior, who do you think it might be?"
Mingyue glanced sideways.
"I’ve seen too many people.
Can’t recall for a moment."
Bai Suzhen frowned:
"But maybe if I think carefully, I might remember."
The Divine Calculator spoke:
"This place should be the last stop of this Void Sacred Realm.
Let’s help gather some secret manuals and treasures, then when the master returns, he can take them directly."
Little Zhao agreed very much.
At once, the group began to retrace their steps and collect secret manuals, treasures, and Great Medicine hidden in other realms.
This Void Sacred Realm is full of hidden treasures.
Countless!
To say the Celestial Sect is as wealthy as a country is to belittle it!
It’s entirely as wealthy as half the world!
Besides Jiuzhou, almost all secret manuals and treasures from other regions have been collected by the five Great Divine Officials using the power of the Celestial Sect.
This generation of Divine Officials alone has been collecting for hundreds of years.
Previous Divine Officials.
And Emperor Shitian himself, it’s hard to say how many they have collected.

Mingyue, Little Zhao, Wuming and the group, despite their considerable experience, could not help clicking their tongues watching the pile of treasures like trash stacking up in one icy corner room after another.
Too affluent!
Bai Suzhen instinctively guided the group towards the direction Ding Ling was heading.
She hoped to assist Ding Ling should he encounter obstacles.
Wuming noticed and indicated that she could go and see, he and the Divine Calculator would keep an eye on things here, there shouldn’t be much problem.
Bai Suzhen thought for a moment, then nodded, turning into light and disappearing, went after Ding Ling.
Swish, swish!

Both were extremely fast!
But clearly, the latter was faster.
Constantly closing the gap between them.
The person in front evidently noticed, couldn’t help but glance back at Ding Ling, revealing a trace of shock in the eyes.

Ding Ling’s Free-Will Ascension Step at forty times amplification, stepping in the void, like an immortal’s leisurely pace, each step spanning hundreds of meters, astoundingly fast beyond compare, catching the mysterious figure’s turned glance and instantly capturing his face.
Unexpectedly identical to the Immortal God, Bu Jingyun!
Couldn’t help but be amazed, instinctively called out.

Your talent in cultivation is exceptional.
I’m very interested in you!
If you’re willing to follow me, I will appoint you as my first Divine General!"
"Indeed, someone from the Bu Divine Race."

"I wonder what you are called."

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 657: Xiong Ba’s Father
paragraphs: From the tone of the Divine Guardian, it was evident.
He knew Ding Ling.
He knew, yet dared to steal Ding Ling’s achievements.
Clearly, he had full confidence in their side.
However, the sudden escape of the Great Divine Official still left the Divine Guardian as if struck by lightning, his confidence shaken!
"Purple-clothed Boss, can this seat join hands with you to defeat Ding Ling?"
The Divine Guardian looked at the white-haired man in purple beside him.
"Hehe."
The Purple-clothed Boss smiled slightly, chuckling:
"Divine Guardian, weren’t you the one so confident about ruling over Jiuzhou? Just a mere Ding Ling, and you’re already scared? With your current state, how do you expect to rule Jiuzhou?"
The Divine Guardian’s expression changed slightly, his brows furrowing like blades, just as he was about to speak.
Ding Ling had already lightly landed in front of the two of them, having overheard the conversation between the Purple-clothed Boss and the Divine Guardian.
He glanced at the Purple-clothed Boss:
"Are you Xiong Ba’s father?"
"I didn’t expect that after so many years of staying out of worldly affairs, Ding Ling, you would still recognize someone like me."
The Purple-clothed Boss was slightly surprised, then lightly laughed:
"Since you know of my reputation, you should be aware of my temper. Ding Ling, I warn you. Do not oppose us. Otherwise, you will die a miserable death."
"You all?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"As expected, you are part of an organization. Who is leading you?"
The Purple-clothed Boss did not answer, but the Divine Guardian coldly stared at Ding Ling:
"I told you before, no one in this world can command me, the Divine Guardian! If you don’t want to die, step back a hundred yards. Do not oppose us anymore."
"Give me back the box, and I will leave."
Ding Ling extended his hand, glancing expressionlessly at the Divine Guardian:
"The box was discovered by me, there’s no reason for you to benefit from it."
"This box belongs to Emperor Shitian."
The Divine Guardian laughed heartily:
"How did it become yours, Ding Ling? I simply won’t give it to you. What will you do then?"
"Heh."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, no longer willing to exchange more words with the Divine Guardian, and suddenly attacked!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
The Vigorous Qi, Divine Form Power, Wind and Cloud Divine Power, and Ten Directions Invincible within him continually operated without pause, now enhancing the Supreme Sword Dao!
Bang!
A surge of overwhelming Sword Intent transformed into countless Spirit Killing Swords and rushed towards the Divine Guardian!
The two joined forces, by first killing one, the other naturally became no threat!
Peng!

The Spirit Killing Swords were swift as lightning, unseen and traceless. Although the Divine Guardian was extremely vigilant, he initially did not notice at all, until he sensed himself enveloped by a massive amount of Spirit Killing Swords, he widened his eyes, shouted, operated the Divine Skill, stepped on the stream of light, just about to escape, but it was already too late.

Dong dong! The Divine Guardian only heard the sound of drums beating past his ears, as if heavy hammers were madly pounding in his mind. In just a breath’s time, his Spiritual Defense Secret Technique was penetrated, and then his Consciousness Body was shattered.
His racing body, due to inertia, unconsciously ran forward a hundred yards, crashing heavily against the palace gate, clatter!
He flipped over on the ground, eyes vacant, face pale, breathing normal, but he was already a living dead man.
Ding Ling moved his foot, Shrinking Inches.

Came to the side of the Divine Guardian, activated Dragon Capturing Skill, waved his hand to retrieve the box from him, placing it into the Storage Pouch, then leisurely looked towards the Purple-clothed Boss:
"Who is the mastermind behind you?"
The Purple-clothed Boss was stunned.
From Ding Ling’s strike to the Divine Guardian’s death.
It happened in a flash.
The Purple-clothed Boss hadn’t even had a chance to react before the battle was over.
He was shocked, horror-stricken, instinctively stepped back a few paces, eyed Ding Ling cautiously, and said awkwardly:

"Truly worthy of the new emperor of Jiuzhou! Worthy of the one who can easily kill through the Unmoving Human Realm, Free Earth Realm, and Void Sacred Realm, Hero Ding Ling! I am not your equal. How about we shake hands and make peace? Become friends from now on, what do you say?"
His current demeanor and behavior.
Were completely different from just a moment ago!
This showed he must be a scheming, adaptable, ambitious hero-type figure!
Xiong Ba is an ambitious hero.
Perhaps his personality and traits are inherited from his father.

Ding Ling thought of the life of the Purple-clothed Boss and knew this person to be cunning and deceitful. Now upon their first encounter, the drastic contrast in the Purple-clothed Boss’s demeanor further confirmed this point, so he did not respond to the Purple-clothed Boss but said:
"I’ll ask one last time. Who is the mastermind behind you?"
A murderous gleam shone in Ding Ling’s eyes!
The Purple-clothed Boss saw this and felt a chill in his heart, knowing that if he didn’t speak, Ding Ling would surely attack. He dared not hesitate and quickly said:
"I don’t know either. But he’s right outside waiting for us!"
At that moment.
The Purple-clothed Boss greatly admired the actions of the Great Divine Official!
Running away at the first opportunity truly is the wisest choice! Since he didn’t escape, he ended up in this dilemma!
"Oh?"
Ding Ling looked thoughtful:
"Where outside?"
"Right at the gate of the Celestial Sect."
"What cultivation technique do you practice?"
Ding Ling suddenly asked, and the Purple-clothed Boss, not reacting immediately, still instinctively replied:
"Returning Essence Blood Hand!"
Indeed, it’s this martial art!
"Recite the heart technique mantra of this martial art!"
The Returning Essence Blood Hand is an extremely powerful martial art, and Ding Ling vaguely remembers that it is far more powerful than even the North Nether Divine Skill!
What the factual situation is.
Ding Ling needed to see for himself to know.
"This is my foundation, I must refuse!"
The Purple-clothed Boss’s expression changed, solemnly saying:
"Ding Ling, let bygones be bygones. I’ve admitted defeat and conceded today. I hope you can let this go for the sake of my granddaughter Youruo."
"Youruo is Youruo. You are you!"
Ding Ling stared directly at the Purple-clothed Boss, coldly saying:
"If you don’t want to say, then forget it."
The Purple-clothed Boss had blatantly stood with the Divine Guardian from the start, clearly intending to oppose Ding Ling!
And speaking arrogantly, looking down on Ding Ling, showing his ambitious hero nature.
Such a person.
How could Ding Ling let him go?
Letting him go now would be like letting a tiger return to the mountain!

Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was at full level, penetrating the Purple-clothed Boss’s thoughts with a glance. This man intended not to fight if he could avoid it now, and once he was out of the Celestial Gate Earth Realm, naturally, someone else would take care of Ding Ling, and then he could seize the opportunity to attack Ding Ling mercilessly!
It’s not gentlemanly not to seek revenge!
Ding Ling considered himself not a gentleman, but knowing this person intended to kill him, how could Ding Ling spare him?
"What do you want?"
The Purple-clothed Boss retreated two more steps, warning:
"The person you are looking for has arrived. And I am his most valued person! If you take action against me now, you’re on your own for the consequences!"
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling didn’t even blink, suddenly attacking again.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Under forty times amplification.
The power of the Heartless Dao was too strong.
Invisible, traceless, indeed the top-tier secret skill of slaughter!
