chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 658: Fist Dao God
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt that using the Heartless Dao to kill was very convenient.
Just like a lion uses its full strength to hunt a rabbit!
Therefore.
When he killed, especially against a martial arts expert of the same realm, he always used his killer moves directly!
No bluff!
Boom!
The Spirit Killing Sword, as vast as the sky and covering the sun, instantly enveloped the Purple-clothed Boss.
He had nowhere to escape, nowhere to hide, and could only take it head-on.
Whoosh!

At the moment of the Divine Guardian’s death, the Purple-clothed Boss was already prepared to take Ding Ling’s attack head-on, and now Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword surged forward like an endless tide. The Purple-clothed Boss immediately activated his supreme skill ’Returning Essence Blood Hand’ to its maximum power!
The Returning Essence Blood Hand had been operating throughout his body.
Now fully activated, it unleashed its unparalleled might.
Small black holes began to form and condense around the Sea of Consciousness.
They started continuously devouring and destroying the incoming Spirit Killing Sword.
The Purple-clothed Boss’s cultivation in Soul Power and Sword Intent began to rise.
The overbearing nature of Returning Essence Blood Hand was vividly demonstrated at this moment!
Ding Ling noticed it immediately, and was taken aback. He instantly severed the Heartless Dao and simultaneously employed the No-Self Dao!
Boom!
Clang, clang, clang!
In an instant, he seemed to transform into twenty-one figures, moving so fast that the naked eye could hardly detect, and he launched palm strike after palm strike towards the Purple-clothed Boss.
Ten Strong Martial Dao!
Black Tortoise Divine Palm!
In just an instant, Ding Ling unleashed twenty-one palm strikes simultaneously!
Each palm was different!
Sometimes the left palm pressed down, the palm wind surging, creating sounds of roaring waves!
Sometimes the right hand turned, palm shadows swirling, the palm momentum extremely fierce, as if directly attacking Yellow Dragon, palm shattering Heaven and Earth!
Sometimes one palm strike seemed like it was striking town-like stone monuments, capable of shattering the Earth Realm of Guan Mountain!
Though it was one person.
In a breath, he unleashed the power of twenty-one people!
With a forty times amplification, the power was even more earth-shattering!
Before the palm wind even arrived!
The Purple-clothed Boss was already struggling to breathe, originally overjoyed to have absorbed Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword, thinking Ding Ling was nothing much, now his legs were trembling.
He knew.
He definitely couldn’t take this move.
Boom!

Luckily, he was well-prepared, having secretly learned the Divine Movement skill of the unsuspecting Divine Guardian. At this moment, he moved his legs and transformed into a streak of light shooting towards Heaven’s Edge.
To run faster.

He spared no cost, expending his own True Qi and even recklessly activating Returning Essence Blood Hand, consuming his own Essence Qi, to bring out the full power of ’Divine Wind Skill’, his entire being like a whirlwind, traversing hundreds of yards in a breath, disappearing in another breath.
There was no one who understood how strong the Divine Guardian was more than he did, and Ding Ling killed the Divine Guardian in an instant!
He had long been terrified, preferring not to fight, so he had tried to persuade Ding Ling with words. However, his vicious intent was seen through by Ding Ling, forcing his hand.
Now realizing he was no match for Ding Ling, naturally he could only retreat.
Returning Essence Blood Hand, though strong.
He couldn’t absorb such pure power!
Especially with Ding Ling at a higher realm.
The crushing pressure of dozens of palm strikes.
Like mountains collapsing, if he used Returning Essence Blood Hand to absorb these forces, he would explode, leading to annihilation!
He had no desire to die!
If Ding Ling were weaker, he wouldn’t be afraid, but Ding Ling’s dozens of palm strikes were like a python devouring dozens of elephants at once! How could it be possible?!
Ding Ling’s own Eternal Youth Technique was an evolved version of the North Nether Divine Skill, naturally understanding both its power and its weaknesses clearly.
As long as you’re strong enough!
The opponent’s body would be overwhelmed.

The previous failure of the Heartless Dao was ultimately due to the dense Sword Intent only partly targeting the opponent’s Sea of Consciousness, as the Heartless Dao’s killing was broad! Besides, perhaps the opponent’s Sea of Consciousness was special!
Now seeing the Purple-clothed Boss fleeing.

Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, immediately giving chase, and as he passed by the Divine Guardian, he grabbed his body from mid-air, employing Eternal Youth Technique, Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Whoosh!
Rolling True Qi flowed into his body.
[Inner Power Value +612]
Soon, two drops of Longevity True Water appeared in the Dantian.
[True Power Value: 73 points]
He had become stronger again.
And the Divine Guardian was indeed a strong Shattering-level expert.
Even though Ding Ling had now reached the Middle Tier of Shattering, with his Shattering True Qi growing stronger, the True Qi of ordinary Innate Experts brought him little benefit.
But the Divine Guardian still provided a whopping 612 points.
Which shows the abundance and purity of his True Qi.
Generally, even a Grandmaster only adds about 90 points.
Ding Ling’s strength had increased yet again.

With a forty times amplification, his speed was even faster, one Void Stepping covered hundreds of yards, and in just a few blinks, Ding Ling caught up with the Purple-clothed Boss again, without hesitation, launching a palm strike towards his back!
Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Dark Clouds Without Rain!
Roar!

A dragon roar resounded, and dense dragon-shaped Qi crashed towards the Purple-clothed Boss! As Ding Ling’s strength reached the Middle Tier of Shattering, the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms in his hands unleashed earth-shattering power.
With one move, the dragon-shaped Qi condensed in the void like a real dragon, whether a Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, or a dragon devouring the world, instantly engulfing the Purple-clothed Boss.
"Ah!"
"I’ll fight you to the death!"
The Purple-clothed Boss frantically operated Returning Essence Blood Hand, continually absorbing the incoming dragon-shaped Qi!
However, each absorption caused his body to tremble involuntarily.

After absorbing a few, he felt as though his organs were going to tear apart, knowing this was Ding Ling’s unique fused Qi force at play, and if he forcibly absorbed more, he might immediately shatter and die! So, he dared not absorb more, only frantically generating a protective shield to guard his vital points!
Bam, bam, bam!

The dragon-shaped Qi struck him, and the next moment, the Purple-clothed Boss, like a tattered bag, was sent flying a hundred yards away, bang! Crashing at the entrance of the palace of the Unmoving Human Realm!
Unknowingly.
In pursuit, they had reached the palace of the Unmoving Human Realm.
As the Purple-clothed Boss crashed at the entrance, a person suddenly stepped into the palace.
He was tall and commanding, his face fierce and his eyes sharp like a knife glancing at Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"Is that Ding Ling ahead?"
"It is."
Ding Ling descended from the sky, his toes lightly touching the ground, one hand behind his back, indifferently looking at the newcomer:
"Who are you again? What is your purpose in stopping me?"
"Heh heh."
The newcomer grinned, his smile vicious:
"My name is Fist Dao God. I am ordered to invite you, Ding Ling, to meet with the patriarch."
"Fist Dao God?"
Ding Ling glanced at the newcomer, noticing his strangely muscular body and slightly twisted face.

sentences.text: Ding Ling felt that using the Heartless Dao to kill was very convenient.
Just like a lion uses its full strength to hunt a rabbit!
Therefore.
When he killed, especially against a martial arts expert of the same realm, he always used his killer moves directly!
No bluff!
Boom!
The Spirit Killing Sword, as vast as the sky and covering the sun, instantly enveloped the Purple-clothed Boss.
He had nowhere to escape, nowhere to hide, and could only take it head-on.
Whoosh!

At the moment of the Divine Guardian’s death, the Purple-clothed Boss was already prepared to take Ding Ling’s attack head-on, and now Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword surged forward like an endless tide.
The Purple-clothed Boss immediately activated his supreme skill ’Returning Essence Blood Hand’ to its maximum power!
The Returning Essence Blood Hand had been operating throughout his body.
Now fully activated, it unleashed its unparalleled might.
Small black holes began to form and condense around the Sea of Consciousness.
They started continuously devouring and destroying the incoming Spirit Killing Sword.
The Purple-clothed Boss’s cultivation in Soul Power and Sword Intent began to rise.
The overbearing nature of Returning Essence Blood Hand was vividly demonstrated at this moment!
Ding Ling noticed it immediately, and was taken aback.
He instantly severed the Heartless Dao and simultaneously employed the No-Self Dao!
Boom!
Clang, clang, clang!
In an instant, he seemed to transform into twenty-one figures, moving so fast that the naked eye could hardly detect, and he launched palm strike after palm strike towards the Purple-clothed Boss.
Ten Strong Martial Dao!
Black Tortoise Divine Palm!
In just an instant, Ding Ling unleashed twenty-one palm strikes simultaneously!
Each palm was different!
Sometimes the left palm pressed down, the palm wind surging, creating sounds of roaring waves!
Sometimes the right hand turned, palm shadows swirling, the palm momentum extremely fierce, as if directly attacking Yellow Dragon, palm shattering Heaven and Earth!
Sometimes one palm strike seemed like it was striking town-like stone monuments, capable of shattering the Earth Realm of Guan Mountain!
Though it was one person.
In a breath, he unleashed the power of twenty-one people!
With a forty times amplification, the power was even more earth-shattering!
Before the palm wind even arrived!
The Purple-clothed Boss was already struggling to breathe, originally overjoyed to have absorbed Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword, thinking Ding Ling was nothing much, now his legs were trembling.
He knew.
He definitely couldn’t take this move.
Boom!
Luckily, he was well-prepared, having secretly learned the Divine Movement skill of the unsuspecting Divine Guardian.
At this moment, he moved his legs and transformed into a streak of light shooting towards Heaven’s Edge.
To run faster.

He spared no cost, expending his own True Qi and even recklessly activating Returning Essence Blood Hand, consuming his own Essence Qi, to bring out the full power of ’Divine Wind Skill’, his entire being like a whirlwind, traversing hundreds of yards in a breath, disappearing in another breath.
There was no one who understood how strong the Divine Guardian was more than he did, and Ding Ling killed the Divine Guardian in an instant!
He had long been terrified, preferring not to fight, so he had tried to persuade Ding Ling with words.
However, his vicious intent was seen through by Ding Ling, forcing his hand.
Now realizing he was no match for Ding Ling, naturally he could only retreat.
Returning Essence Blood Hand, though strong.
He couldn’t absorb such pure power!
Especially with Ding Ling at a higher realm.
The crushing pressure of dozens of palm strikes.
Like mountains collapsing, if he used Returning Essence Blood Hand to absorb these forces, he would explode, leading to annihilation!
He had no desire to die!
If Ding Ling were weaker, he wouldn’t be afraid, but Ding Ling’s dozens of palm strikes were like a python devouring dozens of elephants at once!
How could it be possible?!
Ding Ling’s own Eternal Youth Technique was an evolved version of the North Nether Divine Skill, naturally understanding both its power and its weaknesses clearly.
As long as you’re strong enough!
The opponent’s body would be overwhelmed.
The previous failure of the Heartless Dao was ultimately due to the dense Sword Intent only partly targeting the opponent’s Sea of Consciousness, as the Heartless Dao’s killing was broad!
Besides, perhaps the opponent’s Sea of Consciousness was special!
Now seeing the Purple-clothed Boss fleeing.

Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, immediately giving chase, and as he passed by the Divine Guardian, he grabbed his body from mid-air, employing Eternal Youth Technique, Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Whoosh!
Rolling True Qi flowed into his body.
[Inner Power Value +612]
Soon, two drops of Longevity True Water appeared in the Dantian.
[True Power Value: 73 points]
He had become stronger again.
And the Divine Guardian was indeed a strong Shattering-level expert.
Even though Ding Ling had now reached the Middle Tier of Shattering, with his Shattering True Qi growing stronger, the True Qi of ordinary Innate Experts brought him little benefit.
But the Divine Guardian still provided a whopping 612 points.
Which shows the abundance and purity of his True Qi.
Generally, even a Grandmaster only adds about 90 points.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 659: Shattering the Opponent with a Palm
paragraphs: Thinking about the stories concerning Fist Dao God.
Ding Ling was relieved, but his resolve to kill Purple-clothed Boss did not waver in the slightest as he said:
"Going to meet your Patriarch, just as I wish."
To be called the Patriarch by Fist Dao God.
This so-called Patriarch.
It’s no doubt the mastermind behind Japan’s curtains, undoubtedly a presence whose Combat Power crushes that of Fist Dao God!
Such a high figure.
Could well be the puppet master Purple-clothed Boss spoke of.
Ding Ling had been wanting to meet him.
Now that the person was delivered to him directly, Ding Ling couldn’t be happier, how could he refuse:
"But I want to kill Purple-clothed Boss first, then I will go with you."
"He cannot be killed."
Fist Dao God said:
"He is someone esteemed by the Patriarch."
"You want to stop me?"
"I must stop you."
Fist Dao God stared unwaveringly at Ding Ling, grinning with a particularly sinister smile:
"I can’t defy the Patriarch’s orders."
"Hmph."

Ding Ling wasn’t about to indulge Fist Dao God, he immediately snorted coldly, the Lion Roar Skill, Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, Roar God Manual, three major Sound Wave Skill powerfully displayed their might, under a forty-fold amplification, a snort transformed into a turbulent sound wave as if into an ocean of roaring sound waves, this ocean aggressively condensed into a vertical line, and with a lightning bolt momentum, whoosh! It drilled straight into the ear of Fist Dao God!
Boom!

It seemed there was a lion’s roar, as well as a piercing shriek, an angry dog howl in his mind, Fist Dao God’s head buzzed, yet in that instant, as if struck by lightning, his whole body uncontrollably screamed miserably, clutching his head and falling to the ground, Ding Ling seized the opportunity to stomp down, Pong!
Right on Fist Dao God’s waist, kicking him uncontrollably to fly dozens of meters diagonally, rolling several times on the ground before coming to a halt.
And Ding Ling didn’t bother with Fist Dao God anymore, directly delivering several slaps to Purple-clothed Boss.
Pap! Pap!
Clean and crisp four palms imprinted on Purple-clothed Boss’s limbs like lightning, followed by several crack sounds!
"Ow!"
Purple-clothed Boss, who had already been knocked unconscious before, woke up directly in pain!
"You!"
Purple-clothed Boss immediately sensed the condition of his own body, feeling utterly despondent, hopeless, furious, and sad to the extreme!
Limbs crippled.
Unless practicing miraculous martial arts like Holy Heart Technique, he would be handicapped for life!
"Whoosh!"
Ding Ling grabbed in mid-air, catching pieces of Ice Shards, and then casually flinging them, Ice Shards fell on Purple-clothed Boss like raindrops.
Ding Ling then activated Life and Death Talisman and swiftly sealed Purple-clothed Boss’s mute acupoint.
Purple-clothed Boss’s previously resentful face quickly turned into one of pain, horrific, twisted.
His limbs were severed, yet his entire True Qi surged painfully, his whole person was uncontrollably flying up, rolling incessantly in the void.
Ding Ling, seeing the situation, continuously pointed out One Yang Finger.
The key acupoints on Purple-clothed Boss’s body were targeted, subsequently crashing like a zombie from mid-air, his whole body twitching, evidently in extreme pain.
"Sure enough, the power of Life and Death Talisman has strengthened as well."
Ding Ling’s Shattering True Qi empowered Life and Death Talisman, with enormous power, far surpassing the past.
Such a strong person as Purple-clothed Boss couldn’t withstand it.
After a while.

Ding Ling delivered a Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm strike, temporarily relieving Purple-clothed Boss’s pain, then pointed out One Yang Finger, unlocking Purple-clothed Boss’s mute acupoint, finally speaking:
"Heart Method Mantra of Returning Essence Blood Hand?"
"I spit!"
Purple-clothed Boss, full of anger, spat at Ding Ling, but Ding Ling was surrounded by Vigorous Qi from Qiankun Great Shift, causing the spit to rebound faster onto Purple-clothed Boss’s face.
He stared wide-eyed like Luoo Xian, the disgust and revulsion on his face almost overflowing.
Ding Ling wouldn’t indulge him.
Delivered another palm strike.
Smashed the Palm Power of Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm. Pointed down, targeting his mute acupoint.
Purple-clothed Boss once again painfully erupted.

He wanted to scream, yet couldn’t even shout, his whole body seemed as though countless ants were gnawing at him, more like someone was aggressively drilling into his skull with a sharp sword tip, wanting to bore through his brain.
He was in unbearable pain.
For a moment, he had thoughts only seeking a quick death.

Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was at Full Level, discerning the situation, just as he was about to temporarily alleviate the pain, suddenly a roar came from behind him, followed by a fierce fist wind crashing heavily towards his position.
Ding Ling without even turning back slapped it away.
Pap!
A figure was smacked flying a hundred meters away.
The whole person crashed against the palace stone wall, then fell down like a pile of mud.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Shocking Fist God.]
[Note: As Jue Wushen’s senior disciple, Fist Dao God possesses astonishing talent in martial arts, his training aptitude can rival Wuming! Truly a genius unseen for hundreds of years!
Once released, he was like a tiger unleashed, fierce, terrifying to the extreme, once emerging, hard to find opponents!
He was full of challenge towards you!

Even wanted to beat you to death alive! To prove that by relying solely on himself, he could sweep through the Central Plains without a rival! But unexpectedly, he was severely injured by a single sound wave skill, a kick, a slap from you! He found it unbelievable! Nearly collapsed!]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound.
Slightly turned his head to glance at Fist Dao God.
Turned around, walking towards him.
He actually had instances of being short-sighted!

Despite his Observing People Skill constantly operating, he didn’t see Fist Dao God wanted to kill him. All it could be said was Fist Dao God looked too fierce and sinister, seeing Purple-clothed Boss’s expression, he seemed wanting to kill him too.
Ding Ling hadn’t been paying enough attention to Fist Dao God, not closely observing, hence overlooked him.
But now with Fist Dao God having this thought, how could Ding Ling not resolve him first?
"Expert at Initial Tier of Shattering."
Ding Ling’s Free-Will Ascension Step seemed slow yet fast, Shrinking Inches, at one moment he was still a hundred meters away, the next second, had already arrived in front of Fist Dao God.
He looked down at Fist Dao God, quietly said:
"With Creation Power indeed exceptional. Seems after you were released, you acquired your Patriarch’s teachings?"
Ding Ling cared not how Fist Dao God would answer.

A fist strike went down, Pong! Shattering Fist Dao God’s shoulder bone, ignoring his furious roar, Pap! Pap! Two more slaps went down, swelling his cheeks, causing dizziness, taking advantage of the situation, he went forward, placed his hand on Fist Dao God’s shoulder, operated Eternal Youth Technique!
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
Rolling True Qi streamed into the Dantian.
Under forty-fold amplification.
Instantly, this True Qi was refined.
[Inner Power Value +610]
The Dantian contained two drops of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 75 points]
This was a peerless expert not inferior to Divine Guardian!
Perhaps because he transitioned to another miraculous Technique.
His True Qi Quality was indeed quite extraordinary, remarkable.
This was the root cause enabling him to rival the Divine Race of Bu Divine Race like the Divine Guardian.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 660: Clash of Spirit Killing Swords
paragraphs: Ding Ling speculated.
This incomplete technique.
It might have been taught by the Patriarch to the Fist Dao God.
The reason for knowing it’s incomplete is naturally because Ding Ling’s insight is extraordinary, and since he himself has practiced many incomplete techniques, he can discern them at a glance.
For this kind of incomplete technique, Ding Ling is not very interested.
Of course, more importantly, this Fist Dao God is like a ferocious beast, a complete brute, extremely ruthless!
Reasoning with him is futile.
Furthermore, he’s been locked with Fist Lock by Jue Wushen, trapped in the Fist Tomb for years, his mind is as resilient as iron; trying to subdue such a person is very difficult.
Ding Ling doesn’t know how the Patriarch managed to subdue the Fist Dao God.
Nor does he have any interest to find out.

He merely tormented the Fist Dao God three times using the Life and Death Talisman, determining there’s no useful information or Secret Manual Skill to extract, then struck his palm down, smashing his skull!
And at that moment.
The Demon Lord Bai Suzhen also arrived.
He saw the fallen Fist Dao God on the ground, slightly surprised:
"Didn’t expect this person was also released. Who let him out?"
"He said it was the Patriarch?"
"The Patriarch?"
Bai Suzhen looked towards the door, seeing the twitching Purple-clothed Boss, his pupils shrunk, he said:
"Another peerless expert!"
"He is Xiong Ba’s father, once the leader of the Righteous Martial Dao’s ’Seven Demon Hunters’, the Purple-clothed Boss."
Ding Ling knew this so clearly. Naturally, it was because he also earned an Achievement Medal from the Purple-clothed Boss.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal; Intimidated Purple-clothed Boss.]

[Note: Decades ago, the leader of the Righteous Martial Dao’s ’Seven Demon Hunters’, the Purple-clothed Boss. He was strongly recruited and re-emerged in Jianghu! Thinking he was backed by a mountain, with limitless prospects. Given time, he would surely become an Immortal God, overlooking the Mortal World, dominating all beings! Yet unexpectedly, he fell at your hands!]
Adding to the previous D-level Achievement Medal earned from the Divine Guardian.
Ding Ling quickly earned three D-level Achievement Medals in a short period.
"Purple-clothed Boss."
Bai Suzhen’s memory recurred, realizing:

"I remember now. This person is ferociously savage. Acting in the name of righteousness, yet conducts the deeds of Demon Dao! Decades ago, he almost annihilated the entire Black Pupil family. If I hadn’t arrived in time, Black Pupil would have been killed by him. By the way."
He glanced at the Purple-clothed Boss:
"I distinctly remember destroying one of his arms. Why does he now appear?"
"He must have had it reattached by an expert."
Ding Ling also understands such medical skills.
Not just reattaching hands.
Easily swapping eyes, he can do it effortlessly!
This is the terrifying aspect of a Divine Doctor versed in Exotic Profound Skill.
Ding Ling approached, striking with the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, temporarily alleviating the Purple-clothed Boss’s suffering, inquiring about the ’Returning Essence Blood Hand’ technique.
The Purple-clothed Boss, however, did not respond.
Upon determining he couldn’t extract anything, Ding Ling raised his palm, intending to seize the Purple-clothed Boss in mid-air, absorbing his strength.
Whoosh! A stream of Sword Intent suddenly coursed over! It’s formless, invisible, traceless! The naked eye cannot see it clearly, yet it’s felt unmistakably!
Ding Ling acted instinctively, without thinking much, amplifying Heartless Dao by forty times!
The densely packed Spirit Killing Swords gathered into a Sword Sea, amidst swift whooshing sounds, flowed in reverse to kill.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
It felt like a Mars collision! Two major Spirit Killing Swords fiercely clashed, collided in the void, invisible to the naked eye! A mental storm stirred violently!
"Ah!"
The Purple-clothed Boss bore the brunt.

The defenses of his Sea of Consciousness were torn apart! The densely packed two major Spirit Killing Swords used his Sea of Consciousness as their battlefield! Instantly destroying his Consciousness Body!
The Purple-clothed Boss let out a miserable scream, his once spiritually bright eyes instantly grew dim and lifeless, becoming a living dead!
"What?!"
A shout echoed from afar!
Instantly, this person seemed to be filled with anger:
"How dare you! Ding Ling, I want you dead!"
"Hmph!"
Without waiting for the person to attack again, Ding Ling directly amplified the three Sound Wave Skills by forty times.
Whoosh! A sound wave, seemingly forming a thread-like ribbon, in a thunderous burst, swiftly shot towards the distance, the next moment, a muffled grunt was faintly heard.
It seemed the person suffered a hidden loss.
Ding Ling seized the opportunity, moved forward to grab the Purple-clothed Boss.
Executing the Eternal Youth Technique!
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Surging True Qi was absorbed into the body.
Quickly refined.
[Inner Power Value +600]
[True Power Value: 77 points]
He grew stronger again!

Ding Ling let out a long howl, his voice splitting the Nine Heavens, with a step, amplifying Free-Will Ascension Step by forty times, turning Ding Ling entirely into a light within the Unmoving Human Realm.
In a swift blink, he already stepped outside the Unmoving Human Realm, standing before a group of people.
This group, led by a person dressed in a blue full-body suit, the back of the suit tied with eight strips of fabric. The clothes were printed with Eight Trigrams symbols.
His face round and dignified, extremely remarkable, appearing neither tall nor large, yet standing before others, he was prominently outstanding!
Blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth, seemingly sustaining an injury.
The dozen people behind him also appeared pallid and unpleasant.
Upon seeing Ding Ling.
The dozen faces drastically changed, as if seeing a ghost:
"Such speed!"
"Is he Ding Ling?!"

"Looks so young! How can he be this terrifyingly strong?! Starting training from the womb couldn’t be this monstrous! Could it be he’s similar to Emperor Shitian, an ancient thousand-year-old monster?!"

Yet thinking of what the Alien spoke, they could not help but be more startled, moved, puzzled, feeling today they have truly encountered a unique sight! Indeed witnessed an extraordinary genius of the ages!
What could those like Wuming and Fist Dao God be considered before one like Ding Ling?!
"Are you the Patriarch?"
Ding Ling looked at the leading man.
The man straightened his spine, furrowing his brow while looking at Ding Ling:
"Indeed."
"Was it you who exterminated the World Association’s people?"
’No!’
"Then was it you who killed the Imperial City’s people?"
"That’s indeed correct."
The Patriarch did not deny, letting out a cold laugh:

"Though not by my hand personally, it was under my command. So what? You want revenge for the Imperial City’s people?! I didn’t think, New Emperor of Jiuzhou, Hero Ding, would also be a soft-hearted person."
He seemed to mock Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was indifferent, casually asking:
"Most of the Imperial City’s people are innocent civilians. As a peerless expert, is it necessary for you to order the killing of these unarmed civilians?"
"For me, it was merely a move in the game."
The Patriarch stared intently at Ding Ling, saying:

"The Fist Dao God I painstakingly rescued and nurtured was killed by you. As well as the Immortal God, Purple-clothed Boss, Divine Guardian were all slain by you. My plans, because of you, are almost a total failure. Alas."
He sighed deeply:
"I now offer you two choices. Either align with me, or be killed by me."
He stared at Ding Ling, saying with expectant admiration:
"Though opponents, I must say, you are indeed very talented, very powerful."

sentences.text: Ding Ling speculated.
This incomplete technique.
It might have been taught by the Patriarch to the Fist Dao God.
The reason for knowing it’s incomplete is naturally because Ding Ling’s insight is extraordinary, and since he himself has practiced many incomplete techniques, he can discern them at a glance.
For this kind of incomplete technique, Ding Ling is not very interested.
Of course, more importantly, this Fist Dao God is like a ferocious beast, a complete brute, extremely ruthless!
Reasoning with him is futile.
Furthermore, he’s been locked with Fist Lock by Jue Wushen, trapped in the Fist Tomb for years, his mind is as resilient as iron; trying to subdue such a person is very difficult.
Ding Ling doesn’t know how the Patriarch managed to subdue the Fist Dao God.
Nor does he have any interest to find out.

He merely tormented the Fist Dao God three times using the Life and Death Talisman, determining there’s no useful information or Secret Manual Skill to extract, then struck his palm down, smashing his skull!
And at that moment.
The Demon Lord Bai Suzhen also arrived.
He saw the fallen Fist Dao God on the ground, slightly surprised:
"Didn’t expect this person was also released.
Who let him out?"
"He said it was the Patriarch?"
"The Patriarch?"
Bai Suzhen looked towards the door, seeing the twitching Purple-clothed Boss, his pupils shrunk, he said:
"Another peerless expert!"
"He is Xiong Ba’s father, once the leader of the Righteous Martial Dao’s ’Seven Demon Hunters’, the Purple-clothed Boss."
Ding Ling knew this so clearly.
Naturally, it was because he also earned an Achievement Medal from the Purple-clothed Boss.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal; Intimidated Purple-clothed Boss.]
[Note: Decades ago, the leader of the Righteous Martial Dao’s ’Seven Demon Hunters’, the Purple-clothed Boss.
He was strongly recruited and re-emerged in Jianghu!
Thinking he was backed by a mountain, with limitless prospects.
Given time, he would surely become an Immortal God, overlooking the Mortal World, dominating all beings!
Yet unexpectedly, he fell at your hands!]
Adding to the previous D-level Achievement Medal earned from the Divine Guardian.
Ding Ling quickly earned three D-level Achievement Medals in a short period.
"Purple-clothed Boss."
Bai Suzhen’s memory recurred, realizing:
"I remember now.
This person is ferociously savage.
Acting in the name of righteousness, yet conducts the deeds of Demon Dao!
Decades ago, he almost annihilated the entire Black Pupil family.
If I hadn’t arrived in time, Black Pupil would have been killed by him.
By the way."
He glanced at the Purple-clothed Boss:
"I distinctly remember destroying one of his arms.
Why does he now appear?"
"He must have had it reattached by an expert."
Ding Ling also understands such medical skills.
Not just reattaching hands.
Easily swapping eyes, he can do it effortlessly!
This is the terrifying aspect of a Divine Doctor versed in Exotic Profound Skill.
Ding Ling approached, striking with the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, temporarily alleviating the Purple-clothed Boss’s suffering, inquiring about the ’Returning Essence Blood Hand’ technique.
The Purple-clothed Boss, however, did not respond.
Upon determining he couldn’t extract anything, Ding Ling raised his palm, intending to seize the Purple-clothed Boss in mid-air, absorbing his strength.
Whoosh!
A stream of Sword Intent suddenly coursed over!
It’s formless, invisible, traceless!
The naked eye cannot see it clearly, yet it’s felt unmistakably!
Ding Ling acted instinctively, without thinking much, amplifying Heartless Dao by forty times!
The densely packed Spirit Killing Swords gathered into a Sword Sea, amidst swift whooshing sounds, flowed in reverse to kill.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
It felt like a Mars collision!
Two major Spirit Killing Swords fiercely clashed, collided in the void, invisible to the naked eye!
A mental storm stirred violently!
"Ah!"
The Purple-clothed Boss bore the brunt.
The defenses of his Sea of Consciousness were torn apart!
The densely packed two major Spirit Killing Swords used his Sea of Consciousness as their battlefield!
Instantly destroying his Consciousness Body!
The Purple-clothed Boss let out a miserable scream, his once spiritually bright eyes instantly grew dim and lifeless, becoming a living dead!
"What?!"
A shout echoed from afar!
Instantly, this person seemed to be filled with anger:
"How dare you!
Ding Ling, I want you dead!"
"Hmph!"
Without waiting for the person to attack again, Ding Ling directly amplified the three Sound Wave Skills by forty times.
Whoosh!
A sound wave, seemingly forming a thread-like ribbon, in a thunderous burst, swiftly shot towards the distance, the next moment, a muffled grunt was faintly heard.
It seemed the person suffered a hidden loss.
Ding Ling seized the opportunity, moved forward to grab the Purple-clothed Boss.
Executing the Eternal Youth Technique!
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Surging True Qi was absorbed into the body.
Quickly refined.
[Inner Power Value +600]

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 661: Xiaao Aoshi
paragraphs: "...I truly admire you! I need a genius like you to lend me a hand. Trust me, as long as you cooperate with me, immortality, even becoming a god of this world, is not out of reach."
The Patriarch’s words were imbued with the power of enchantment, which surged forth with his speech, forming illusions around Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, I am the Patriarch who stands by my word! As long as you heed my command, not only can the grudges between us be erased, but I will also grant you immense benefits!"
His voice was emotionally rich, fluctuating, causing the illusions to change continuously with his tone and emotions, as if trying to lead Ding Ling into them, inescapably!
"Compared to you, Purple-clothed Boss, Divine Guardian, and Fist Dao God are insignificant. Having you is like commanding millions, hundreds of thousands of troops.

I have even made use of Fist Dao God. How could I not utilize a great general like you? So, rest assured. Trash like Fist Dao God, it’s no matter if they die. Just listen to me. Everything will be peaceful, tranquil, and smooth!"
Ding Ling seemed to be lost in a daze.
Intoxicated and immersed in one illusion after another, unable to extricate himself.

As the Patriarch felt pleased, ready to take advantage of the situation to completely ensnare Ding Ling under his control, a surge of powerful Sword Intent suddenly erupted from Ding Ling’s body and crashed down towards the Patriarch like a mountain-shifting and sea-overturning wave.
"What?!"
The Patriarch was shocked.
But his instinctive movements were not slow!
A shout!
Only Mind Sword Intent!
Heart Sword!
The dense Sword Intent gathered into countless invisible Heart Swords, rushing towards Ding Ling’s giant wave of Sword Intent!
Boom!

The two waves of Sword Intent clashed once more, colliding in a realm beyond ordinary perception, transforming into streaks of light clashing with each other, crackling fiercely! The tides of Sword Intent dissipated amidst the intense impact!
Between them, in the void realm, arose a spiritual storm that swept the heavens and the earth!
Those who were closer could not help but have their heart and spirit swayed, their consciousness bodies rocked, each frightened out of their wits, retreating in frenzy.

"Unexpectedly, besides Purple-clothed Boss’s Returning Essence Blood Hand being able to withstand the Patriarch’s Only Mind Sword Intent, there is actually someone who can contend with the Patriarch’s Only Mind Sword Intent without falling behind! So strong!"

"No wonder the Alien speaks so highly of Ding Ling, boasting everywhere that among them there is such a figure as Ding Ling! To show off the power of the Alien. In reality, aside from Ding Ling’s unimaginable strength, the other aliens are like ants, unable to withstand a blow!"
The Patriarch’s followers, numbering more than ten.
All were figures above the Grandmaster Tier.
Each with formidable cultivation, unmatched!
At their level, annihilating a nation was merely a matter of time! How would they put the Alien into their eyes?
But Ding Ling, this alien, was indeed the most special one.
They understood why the other aliens always mentioned Ding Ling.
A tribe, always suppressed, scorned, and despised, inevitably brings forward the strongest among them, showcasing their genius and strength to the outside world.
Whoosh!
Bai Suzhen landed not far behind Ding Ling, she saw the Patriarch, initially stunned, then couldn’t help but say:
"Ding Ling, be careful, he’s Xiaao Aoshi!"
"Xiaao Aoshi?"
Ding Ling had already regained clarity.
When the Patriarch attacked him with illusions, he was briefly confused but quickly regained clarity.

With Vast Righteous Qi, Buddha Qi, Full Level Ice Heart Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Human Emperor Breathing Technique, Tathagata Divine Palm protecting him, Ding Ling’s resistance to illusions was unimaginably strong!

Thus, though the Patriarch’s illusion attack could ensnare anyone of the same realm, directing them to follow his will, Ding Ling was not an ordinary expert, breaking free from the illusion, he was filled with rage, decisively launching his strongest move against the Patriarch.
Yet, the Patriarch’s methods were indeed extraordinary, managing to block it.
But as Ding Ling unleashed the Fortyfold Amplification Power.
The Patriarch began to falter.
And at this moment, Bai Suzhen’s voice came.
Ding Ling understood.
It was indeed Xiaao Aoshi.

Xiaao Aoshi appeared in the third part of the Wind and Cloud Comics, the second son of Divine Being Xiao Sanxiao, the hidden master of the Hidden Sword Style, the culprit secretly advancing the Thousand-Year Tribulation!
Realizing the person ahead was Xiaao Aoshi, Ding Ling knew he and Xiaao Aoshi were destined to be like fire and water, irreconcilable.
Xiaao Aoshi wanted to propel the Thousand-Year Tribulation, aiming to destroy the peace of the Jiuzhou people.
This equated to challenging the authority of Ding Ling, the New Emperor of Jiuzhou, which Ding Ling could never tolerate.
This was secondary.
The main point was now apparent, as Xiaao Aoshi was determined to control him, revealing Xiaao Aoshi’s desire for domination!
Once captured by such a person, seeking absolute freedom.
It would indeed be an uphill battle.
How could Ding Ling possibly become Xiaao Aoshi’s pawn?
"The Demon Lord is here too."

Xiaao Aoshi saw Ding Ling’s Sword Intent suddenly intensifying, he struggled to withstand it, shouted, then retreated several hundred yards, avoiding Ding Ling’s Sword Intent attack, lightly stood in mid-air, coldly watched as Ding Ling’s Sword Intent surged like a tide, instantly obliterating all his subordinates.
Thud!
Thud!
More than ten Grandmasters, each could establish a sect, renowned worldwide, invincible, yet could not resist a casual strike of Sword Intent from Ding Ling.
In merely the span of a breath, their consciousness bodies were all destroyed, thud, thud—they fell to the ground, becoming living dead with normal breath but dull-eyed!
"Cold-blooded!"
Bai Suzhen witnessed this scene, she cried sharply:
"Xiaao Aoshi, you are as heartless as your brother!"
"I did not kill them. Yet you rebuke me."
Xiaao Aoshi looked with curious eyes at Bai Suzhen:

"Demon Lord, you are renowned as a demon, yet you often do acts of compassion that even gods wouldn’t do. You pity all creatures, you help those suffering in all directions. You, such a person, are unqualified to be the Demon Lord!"
"Whether I am qualified is not for you to decide."
Bai Suzhen stood beside Ding Ling, saying:

"Ding Ling, be cautious, the sword behind him gives me a chillingly familiar feeling. If my guess is correct, that sword should be from the Sword Sect. Because before, within an internal space of the Sword Sect, I felt this unique Sword Qi."
"Hahaha..."
Xiaao Aoshi laughed aloud as he swiftly drew the sword from his back, revealing a jade green crystal sword:
"Bai Suzhen, your insight is impressive, this sword indeed comes from the Sword Sect. In order to acquire it, I combed through the entire Sword Sect. I never expected to finally find it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 662: Emperor’s Sword
paragraphs: "So it’s you who made the bodies of the Sword Sect Leader and others disappear!"
Bai Suzhen exclaimed.
"They were dead anyway. Their bodies helped me extract the Emperor’s Sword, they died with purpose!"
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer suddenly lunged at Ding Ling with his sword:
"Ding Ling, I warned you kindly, but you wouldn’t listen! Now, die!"
Boom!

The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s entire Sword Intent and Sword Qi surged into the Emperor’s Sword, instantly amplified dozens of times, immeasurably powerful, manifesting a giant thousand-foot sword in the void!
This giant sword was purely formed from concentrated Sword Intent and Sword Qi!
As soon as it manifested!
It thundered towards Ding Ling at lightning speed, like a meteor, reaching Ding Ling in an instant.
Without hesitation, Ding Ling swiftly drew the Xuanyuan Sword, amplifying the Celestial Destiny Sword Dao forty times! Clang, clang, clang!
Amidst the earth-shattering clangor, the sword light was dazzling, and in a blink, a Sword River flowed northward!
The Sword River collided heavily with the giant sword in the next moment!
Boom!
Boom, boom, boom!

Like two great Sword Mountains colliding, as soon as they touched, the heavens and earth trembled! Amidst the rumbling, the point where they met was visibly swept clean, everything dispersed and destroyed!
Outside the Unmoving Human Realm, at the Celestial Gate Earth Realm where they clashed, ice sculptures and pavilions collapsed instantly!
The energy storm from their collision seemed capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Bai Suzhen watched, horrified:

"Truly the Emperor’s Sword! Although The Smiling, Proud Wanderer has cultivation on par with Ding Ling, Ding Ling has the power of amplification; no matter how remarkable The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s divine might and skills, he fundamentally cannot match Ding Ling. But with the Emperor’s Sword, it’s different! Unexpectedly, the Emperor’s Sword can amplify Sword Intent and Sword Qi dozens of times!"
Boom!
Clang!
As soon as Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer started fighting, the battle immediately reached a fever pitch, with no sign of stopping!
In Bai Suzhen’s eyes.
Their speed was at the absolute limit, invisible to the naked eye, only two meteor-like figures colliding in the void!
Each clash was powerful enough to make the heavens tremble!
Clearly visible, each touch of the sword tips split the void into cracks!
Xuanyuan Sword, Emperor’s Sword!
The two divine swords in the world showcased their most unparalleled power at this moment!
Both swords refused to yield, each clash seemingly ready to cut or pierce the opponent!
Boom, boom, boom!
Both were immensely strong!

One stepped on Infinite Power, surrounded by Divine Form, amplified by Wind and Cloud Divine Power, each move perfected to the extreme! One stepped on black clouds, surrounded by countless unpredictabilities, wielding a sword with vast strength;
At times, they fought high in the sky, dispersing clouds, occasionally splitting the blue sky.
At other times, they battled on the ground! The sword Qi from both swords swept and collided wildly! Wherever they passed, everything was destroyed!
Boom!
The palace in the Unmoving Human Realm was half demolished by the aftermath of the two divine swords’ clash! The deafening din was terrifying to the extreme, as if the end of the world.
Wuming and others rushed out at this moment.
Each carried a large bag.
Having gathered numerous secret manuals, treasures, and great medicine from the Void Sacred Realm.
They raced out, gazing at the sky, witnessing two dragon whirlwind storms intertwined with two Sword Rivers colliding in the void, horrified:
"Is this the battle of immortals?!"
Mingyue was bewildered, incredulous.
In her worldview.
Besides the legendary Guan Yu, who could destroy a city with one move of City-Overturning Love, it seemed there was no other divine being worthy of note.
And Guan Yu, this Martial Saint, was merely a figure of legend!
But now Mingyue witnessed a legendary battle firsthand, how could she not be utterly shocked?
"I now understand why Emperor Shitian ran away."
Divine Calculator looked up at the Celestial Palace direction, relieved:
"Although Emperor Shitian is formidable, seemingly incomparable to any of them!"
"Not so."
The Great Divine Official appeared beside Divine Calculator somehow, saying mysteriously:
"The Smiling, Proud Wanderer is incredibly powerful, but his true strength lies in the Emperor’s Sword. Without it, he stands no chance against Hero Ding."
"It’s best you think that way, then.
Divine Calculator smiled subtly:
"I told you earlier. Perhaps siding with the lord is the best choice. You didn’t listen. Now, with your timely realization, it’s not too late. I’m sure the lord will welcome you!"
Mingyue and others kept their eyes fixed on Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s battle.
Exclaiming, sighing, scalp tingling, tongue-tied.
Bai Suzhen fell beside Wuming, a bit despondent; as an esteemed elder, she no longer had the qualification to intervene in such a battle!
But soon, she revived, hoping Ding Ling’s strength to the utmost, because Ding Ling represents hope for humans against the God and Demon War!
Boom!
Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s battle seemed to reach its peak, with no clear winner, both suddenly thrust their swords at each other like lightning!

Clang! Their sword tips clashed, producing earth-shattering clangor, forming rolling sound waves, spreading with energy fluctuations created by their sword collision across all directions, bursting eardrums and skulls of flying birds and beasts!
Sound waves were already like this.
The explosion’s energy fluctuation directly ripped apart the void.
A massive rift emerged horizontally in the void!
A huge suction suddenly appeared from the rift.
Like a black hole, seemingly absorbing everything!
Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, closest to the rift, were unexpectedly sucked inside, disappearing instantly.
"Ding Ling!"
Bai Suzhen, startled, instinctively flew forward to investigate, yet was caught by suction herself, unable to escape, with a sound, she too was drawn into the light stream.
The remaining Wuming and others exchanged glances, for a moment unsure what to do.
However, the rift’s suction grew stronger.
Little Zhao, with weaker skills, couldn’t withstand and was instantly drawn inside.
"Little Zhao."
Wuming, shocked, realizing his momentary distraction with Little Zhao, regretted not noticing her due to her connection with Ding Ling, resolved to rescue her, leapt into the rift himself.
"What to do?"
The Great Divine Official and Divine Calculator were somewhat lost.

sentences.text: "So it’s you who made the bodies of the Sword Sect Leader and others disappear!"
Bai Suzhen exclaimed.
"They were dead anyway.
Their bodies helped me extract the Emperor’s Sword, they died with purpose!"
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer suddenly lunged at Ding Ling with his sword:
"Ding Ling, I warned you kindly, but you wouldn’t listen!
Now, die!"
Boom!

The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s entire Sword Intent and Sword Qi surged into the Emperor’s Sword, instantly amplified dozens of times, immeasurably powerful, manifesting a giant thousand-foot sword in the void!
This giant sword was purely formed from concentrated Sword Intent and Sword Qi!
As soon as it manifested!
It thundered towards Ding Ling at lightning speed, like a meteor, reaching Ding Ling in an instant.
Without hesitation, Ding Ling swiftly drew the Xuanyuan Sword, amplifying the Celestial Destiny Sword Dao forty times!
Clang, clang, clang!
Amidst the earth-shattering clangor, the sword light was dazzling, and in a blink, a Sword River flowed northward!
The Sword River collided heavily with the giant sword in the next moment!
Boom!
Boom, boom, boom!
Like two great Sword Mountains colliding, as soon as they touched, the heavens and earth trembled!
Amidst the rumbling, the point where they met was visibly swept clean, everything dispersed and destroyed!
Outside the Unmoving Human Realm, at the Celestial Gate Earth Realm where they clashed, ice sculptures and pavilions collapsed instantly!
The energy storm from their collision seemed capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Bai Suzhen watched, horrified:
"Truly the Emperor’s Sword!

Although The Smiling, Proud Wanderer has cultivation on par with Ding Ling, Ding Ling has the power of amplification; no matter how remarkable The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s divine might and skills, he fundamentally cannot match Ding Ling.
But with the Emperor’s Sword, it’s different!
Unexpectedly, the Emperor’s Sword can amplify Sword Intent and Sword Qi dozens of times!"
Boom!
Clang!
As soon as Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer started fighting, the battle immediately reached a fever pitch, with no sign of stopping!
In Bai Suzhen’s eyes.
Their speed was at the absolute limit, invisible to the naked eye, only two meteor-like figures colliding in the void!
Each clash was powerful enough to make the heavens tremble!
Clearly visible, each touch of the sword tips split the void into cracks!
Xuanyuan Sword, Emperor’s Sword!
The two divine swords in the world showcased their most unparalleled power at this moment!
Both swords refused to yield, each clash seemingly ready to cut or pierce the opponent!
Boom, boom, boom!
Both were immensely strong!
One stepped on Infinite Power, surrounded by Divine Form, amplified by Wind and Cloud Divine Power, each move perfected to the extreme!
One stepped on black clouds, surrounded by countless unpredictabilities, wielding a sword with vast strength;
At times, they fought high in the sky, dispersing clouds, occasionally splitting the blue sky.
At other times, they battled on the ground!
The sword Qi from both swords swept and collided wildly!
Wherever they passed, everything was destroyed!
Boom!
The palace in the Unmoving Human Realm was half demolished by the aftermath of the two divine swords’ clash!
The deafening din was terrifying to the extreme, as if the end of the world.
Wuming and others rushed out at this moment.
Each carried a large bag.
Having gathered numerous secret manuals, treasures, and great medicine from the Void Sacred Realm.
They raced out, gazing at the sky, witnessing two dragon whirlwind storms intertwined with two Sword Rivers colliding in the void, horrified:
"Is this the battle of immortals?!"
Mingyue was bewildered, incredulous.
In her worldview.
Besides the legendary Guan Yu, who could destroy a city with one move of City-Overturning Love, it seemed there was no other divine being worthy of note.
And Guan Yu, this Martial Saint, was merely a figure of legend!
But now Mingyue witnessed a legendary battle firsthand, how could she not be utterly shocked?
"I now understand why Emperor Shitian ran away."
Divine Calculator looked up at the Celestial Palace direction, relieved:
"Although Emperor Shitian is formidable, seemingly incomparable to any of them!"
"Not so."
The Great Divine Official appeared beside Divine Calculator somehow, saying mysteriously:
"The Smiling, Proud Wanderer is incredibly powerful, but his true strength lies in the Emperor’s Sword.
Without it, he stands no chance against Hero Ding."
"It’s best you think that way, then.
Divine Calculator smiled subtly:
"I told you earlier.
Perhaps siding with the lord is the best choice.
You didn’t listen.
Now, with your timely realization, it’s not too late.
I’m sure the lord will welcome you!"
Mingyue and others kept their eyes fixed on Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s battle.
Exclaiming, sighing, scalp tingling, tongue-tied.
Bai Suzhen fell beside Wuming, a bit despondent; as an esteemed elder, she no longer had the qualification to intervene in such a battle!
But soon, she revived, hoping Ding Ling’s strength to the utmost, because Ding Ling represents hope for humans against the God and Demon War!
Boom!
Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s battle seemed to reach its peak, with no clear winner, both suddenly thrust their swords at each other like lightning!
Clang!

Their sword tips clashed, producing earth-shattering clangor, forming rolling sound waves, spreading with energy fluctuations created by their sword collision across all directions, bursting eardrums and skulls of flying birds and beasts!
Sound waves were already like this.
The explosion’s energy fluctuation directly ripped apart the void.
A massive rift emerged horizontally in the void!
A huge suction suddenly appeared from the rift.
Like a black hole, seemingly absorbing everything!
Ding Ling and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, closest to the rift, were unexpectedly sucked inside, disappearing instantly.
"Ding Ling!"
Bai Suzhen, startled, instinctively flew forward to investigate, yet was caught by suction herself, unable to escape, with a sound, she too was drawn into the light stream.
The remaining Wuming and others exchanged glances, for a moment unsure what to do.
However, the rift’s suction grew stronger.
Little Zhao, with weaker skills, couldn’t withstand and was instantly drawn inside.
"Little Zhao."
Wuming, shocked, realizing his momentary distraction with Little Zhao, regretted not noticing her due to her connection with Ding Ling, resolved to rescue her, leapt into the rift himself.
"What to do?"
The Great Divine Official and Divine Calculator were somewhat lost.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 663: Sword Realm
paragraphs: The Great Divine Official and the Divine Calculator were also shocked, bewildered, and puzzled by the sudden appearance of the Void World, and thus, they didn’t notice Little Zhao, who had the weakest abilities, in a dire situation.
By the time they realized it, it was already too late.
So, when they noticed Mingyue was also showing signs of exhaustion, they hurriedly protected Mingyue, retreating hundreds of feet away from that area.

When the suction from that opening reached its peak, it was like a vortex, sucking in all the flying sand, shattered wood, and withered branches nearby. Suddenly, it closed into a straight line and vanished without a trace.
"How could this happen?!"
Mingyue looked up at the direction of the Celestial Palace:
"Have our benefactors disappeared just like that?!"
"They must have entered some unknown little world within a Grotto Heaven."
The Great Divine Official pondered for a while, then said:
"I thought of something."
The Divine Calculator glanced sideways.
The Great Divine Official continued on his own:

"Years ago, Emperor Shitian mysteriously brought back something. The region where that object was located naturally emanated a powerful fire Qi. Emperor Shitian told me it was a treasure he acquired from a Grotto Heaven World."
"What exactly was the treasure?"
"I don’t know."
The Great Divine Official shook his head and said:

"But since then, I’ve been paying attention to traces of so-called Grotto Heaven Worlds. I hope to discover the secrets that surpass Emperor Shitian or perhaps even immortality from such worlds. Finally, fifty years ago, I discovered a suspicious place."
He seemed to be reminiscing:

"That place was dry for miles, covered with withered grass and decaying wood. Only a handful of families lived there. I asked the homeowners. They said that a thousand years ago, it was a prosperous and affluent area. But later, everything started changing for unknown reasons.
Not only did the Ancient Kingdoms vanish one by one, but even their ancestors were forced to retreat from their ancestral lands."
"Could you be talking about the ruins of the Ancient Loulan Kingdom?"
"That’s exactly it."
"Is there a Grotto Heaven World there?!"
"There is!"

The Great Divine Official confirmed with certainty: "When I went there forty years ago, I accidentally fell into a mysterious space, but soon, I was transported back by a strange power. I thought it was an illusion, but in retrospect, it felt off. Seeing the place Hero Ding ventured into now, I am certain these two locations are similar! Both are Grotto Heaven Worlds!"
The Lingshan is filled with charm; the empty space and water converge into an ethereal atmosphere.
Ding Ling suddenly thought of these words as he gazed at the beautiful scenery before him.
He has been here for a while.
He didn’t see Xiaao Aoshi, presumably because that person landed elsewhere.
As he wandered through this picturesque landscape, his heart filled with increasing surprise.
It was because the mountain range in this realm was guarded by a single peak one moment, and the next, it was an expanse of overlapping ridges, seemingly endless, something beyond his sight.
The speed of changes in these mountains was consistent in some areas, yet abrupt and rapid in others, making Ding Ling somewhat dizzy and confused.
"What kind of ghostly place is this?"
Ding Ling leapt across a mountain range and arrived at the Langyuan Qiong Pavilion.

Wandering within, one could see the richly ornamental, beautifully ancient Phoenix Pavilion and Dragon Tower dotting the Eight Directions Territory in an orderly manner, appearing incredibly exquisite and aesthetic.
Logically, there should be people living in such a place, but Ding Ling didn’t see a soul. Yet, when he touched these painting era towers with his hand, an odd sensation surged within him.
"This is definitely not a real world, but a world made of swords!"
"You guessed correctly."
A voice suddenly slid past Ding Ling’s ear.
It was so abrupt!
Ding Ling hadn’t sensed anything beforehand, he turned around alarmed, but saw no one.
"Your speed is too slow. If you wish to find me, you’re still lacking a bit."

This person’s voice seemed ubiquitous, all-encompassing, ethereal like mist in the sky, as if an immortal were whispering. But it fell harshly upon Ding Ling’s ears, prompting him to activate the Fortyfold Amplification Power, with a Divine Form Surrounding Body, the Wind and Cloud Divine Power pinpointed underfoot, swoosh!
Instantly, he seemed to transform into a beam of light and, in no time, reached a pavilion a hundred feet away, and captured a silhouette.
It was an unusually looking, strangely clad man in green.
"Oh!"
The man exclaimed in surprise, but instead of fear, he was delighted:

"Hahaha, I didn’t expect not only your Sword Intent to be as vast as the sea, but your physical abilities to have reached such a terrifying level, it’s truly perfect! Good, very good. In that case, young man, lend me a hand!"
With those words.
His whole body suddenly transformed into a stream of light, rushing toward Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling furrowed his brows, his Xuanyuan Sword in his hands twirled and shook!
Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Who Carries Out the King’s Will!
With one swing, a majestic and boundless golden Sword Qi shot out, like a king inspecting the world, carrying an air of dominance!
But halfway through, the man’s body suddenly dispersed, turning into countless starlights, shuttling back and forth through the Sword Qi, getting closer and closer to Ding Ling.
"What?"
Ding Ling was startled.
Yet the man only laughed more happily:
"Young man, don’t resist. It’s your fortune that I have my eyes on you!"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling gave a cold humph.
With a thought.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
A dense, Spirit Killing Sword converged into a Sea of Swords, rushing toward the man’s position.
The man was stunned:
"What a strong Spiritual Killing Technique."
With a spin, he retreated a thousand feet away in an instant like a stream of light.
Powerful Sword Qi shot out from his body, his sharp eyes watching Ding Ling closely:
"The reason I don’t want to fight you is that I fear damaging your body. That would be such a pity. Young man, don’t be ungrateful!"
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling saw that this person’s speed was extraordinary, as if perfectly harmonious with this world, able to retreat a thousand feet away in an instant, such speed appearing almost ghost-like.
What was most peculiar was that this man, like the mountains, waters, and pavilions here, gave Ding Ling an elusive, unreal feeling.
He wasn’t confident he could kill this man.
At least in this world, it seemed difficult to kill him.
Because in this world, the man seemed to be like a god here, omnipotent, omnipresent! Even capable of dispersing his body, making him hard to capture, how could one kill him?
"Who am I?"
The man’s lips curved slightly:
"It wouldn’t hurt to tell you. You can call me Jian Yue! Believe me, our upcoming time together will be very pleasant."
Jian Yue?
Jian Yue from the Wind and Cloud World?
Ding Ling inexplicably felt a sense of familiarity, then suddenly realized:
"This is the Sword Realm?!"
"Hahaha..."
Jian Yue laughed loudly:
"Correct. This is the world of swordsmen! It’s a Sword Realm constructed from Sword Intent Spirit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 664: Jian Yue
paragraphs: Sword Realm!
Ding Ling felt slightly dazed.
He hadn’t expected that a great battle would lead him into the Sword Realm!
Regarding his understanding of the Sword Realm.
Ding Ling only had some vague impressions:
It’s rumored that the peak of the Sword Dao holds the Sword Realm.
And this Sword Realm is a fissured space left behind by the shattered time-space continuum. It bears a resemblance to the Mountain and Sea Realm.
It’s a world composed of the Sword Intent and spirit of martial artists.
The mountains, rivers, and buildings Ding Ling saw along the way were all transformed from Sword Intent and Sword Thought!
And it’s said that there are many powerful figures within this Sword Realm!
Mo Kui in the Sword Pool and others.
And Jian Yue from the lineage of Sword Mountain!
"Rumor has it that proper Sword Thought can transform into Sword Mountain. Jian Yue, since you’re in the land of Sword Mountain, why do you want to harm me?"
Ding Ling shouted.
"Hahaha..."
Jian Yue was taken aback, then his face changed dramatically as he said:

"Young man, you don’t understand, you simply don’t understand. Put yourself in my shoes, being trapped in a godforsaken place for hundreds of years! You would also lose it and be unable to bear it! That’s exactly how I am now. Although I’m strong here, I still want to get out. Because here, I’m not happy!"
His eyes looked at Ding Ling as if holding a blade, and his body suddenly leapt into the void, transforming once more into points of scattered starlight.
These points of starlight, each one is a pure and profound Sword Intent and Sword Thought, extremely powerful!
Each point seems to represent Jian Yue.
Jian Yue’s voice resounded throughout the Ten Directions Realm, omnipresent and booming like a war drum in Ding Ling’s ears:

"Young man, can’t you cooperate with me a little, I have waited so long for a living person, for a powerful young man! Why do you resist? Cooperate with me, and together we will be invincible across the world!"
Ding Ling did not agree to Jian Yue’s proposal.
There is no free lunch.
Besides, Jian Yue has been trapped for too long.
His physical form has long been worn away.
What remains is only this pure ’spirit’!
But his spirit, after hundreds of years of honing and forging in the Sword Realm, has become as refined as a True Person, appearing as human to a common observer.

But with full levels of Stargazing Skill, Observing People Skill, Geomancy Skill, Spirit Communication Skill, combined with his supreme cultivation and a fortyfold amplification, Ding Ling saw at a glance that Jian Yue was not human!
But rather a ghost-like spirit similar to the Ghost King!
To put it plainly.
The Jian Yue now should be a sword spirit without a body, craving freedom, impulsive, and selfish!
The consequences of being possessed by such a person are predictable!
Especially within this Sword Realm, where the sword spirit’s abilities are infinitely magnified, Ding Ling dared not attempt it rashly.
"That’s not for you to decide!"
Jian Yue roared in anger:
"It’s hard to persuade a ghost who deserves to die! Young man, in that case, don’t blame me for being discourteous!"
Boom!

The star points from all directions suddenly burst out with sharp and pure Sword Intent, these Sword Intent condensed into swords, crisscrossing in the void, and in an instant, transformed into a cage made of Sword Intent.
Ding Ling was trapped in the cage, unable to free himself for the moment.
He was amazed in his heart.
Jian Yue’s strength exceeded his expectations.
Judging from the comics, Jian Yue didn’t seem this strong, but now he was. Without a doubt, the influx of players and increase in swordsmen made the Sword Realm stronger and stronger.
And Jian Yue’s high affinity with the Sword Realm leads naturally to a rising tide; also, it’s likely Jian Yue has some other fortuitous encounter or transformation that renders him so terrifying!
In less than a second, a lightning-formed sword array cage, trapping the fortyfold amplified Ding Ling!
In this state, Ding Ling was already in his strongest form!
Still being trapped.
One can imagine how fast and fierce Jian Yue’s move was just now.
"Young man, meet your end!"

Having succeeded in his first strike, Jian Yue pressed the attack fiercely, bursting once more with star points at a speed that even ghosts and gods couldn’t perceive, roaring directly towards Ding Ling’s body.

Ding Ling let out an angry roar, unleashing the Lion Roar Skill, Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, and Roar God Manual; waves of sound surged out from Ding Ling, exploding in all directions, shattering the void and raising waves without wind! The pavilions and walkways transformed by Sword Thought crumbled under this roar, countless were smashed!
But Jian Yue remained unscathed, not frightened but delighted:

"Good, good! Young man, you please me more and more. I didn’t expect you to know so many techniques. After possessing you, I will definitely preserve your soul body’s memory, strip down all your learning, and enrich myself. I believe that obtaining your fortunes and creations, I will surely become the world’s most free and unrestrained god!"
The more Jian Yue thought about it, the more exhilarating it got, bursting into a hearty laugh.
Boom!
The next moment.
Seeing that Jian Yue was about to rush into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling activated Supreme Sword Dao, Heartless Dao!

The densely packed Spirit Killing Swords surrounded him, forming layers of defense zones, while the tips of the Spirit Killing Swords pointed outward, ready to pierce and shatter anyone rashly charging in!
"Haha, I’ve already thought of a method to crack your move, young man, surrender and accept your fate!"
Swish, Swish!

Jian Yue’s body became more blurred and fragmented, traversing over the sword tips, and in the blink of an eye, crossed the defensive zone formed by the Spirit Killing Swords, lunging into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling’s body trembled uncontrollably.
The next moment.
Jian Yue began to charge towards Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness!
"Good, good, good!"
Jian Yue’s voice grew even louder, overflowing with nearly uncontainable elation:
"Your body is truly perfect. Is this Divine Form Power? One Dragon and One Thunder Elephant! You’ve actually cultivated them to the Great Perfection of the Realm of Nature!"
It seemed he saw something else, his voice quivering:

"This is Wind and Cloud Divine Power! Could this be the Infinite Power that Master Bodhidharma realized from the power of the wind and clouds across the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths?! It’s too strong! You have as many as ten root powers of this Wind and Cloud Divine Power! How is this possible? How did you cultivate this, huh?"
It seemed he noticed something else, surprised:

"In your Dantian, your meridians, they’re full of all sorts of Marvelous Skill Secret Manual’s Divine Power, and yet you haven’t succumbed to inner demons?! No, no, no, the most unbelievable thing is, you, a young man of barely twenty-something years of bone age! How did you cultivate so many Divine Skills, and it seems they’ve all reached Great Perfection.
Even if you started cultivating from birth, you could never reach this level. Could it be... that you are also an old monster who possessed this young man’s body?!"
The more Jian Yue thought about it, the more sense it made, he couldn’t help but let out a long laugh:
"This is cause and effect, the retribution is inevitable! Old monster, you possessed this young man early on, today it’s your fate to fall into Eternal Hell! Let me avenge this young man!"
