Besides, Jian Yue has been trapped for too long.
His physical form has long been worn away.
What remains is only this pure ’spirit’!
But his spirit, after hundreds of years of honing and forging in the Sword Realm, has become as refined as a True Person, appearing as human to a common observer.

But with full levels of Stargazing Skill, Observing People Skill, Geomancy Skill, Spirit Communication Skill, combined with his supreme cultivation and a fortyfold amplification, Ding Ling saw at a glance that Jian Yue was not human!
But rather a ghost-like spirit similar to the Ghost King!
To put it plainly.
The Jian Yue now should be a sword spirit without a body, craving freedom, impulsive, and selfish!
The consequences of being possessed by such a person are predictable!
Especially within this Sword Realm, where the sword spirit’s abilities are infinitely magnified, Ding Ling dared not attempt it rashly.
"That’s not for you to decide!"
Jian Yue roared in anger:
"It’s hard to persuade a ghost who deserves to die!
Young man, in that case, don’t blame me for being discourteous!"
Boom!

The star points from all directions suddenly burst out with sharp and pure Sword Intent, these Sword Intent condensed into swords, crisscrossing in the void, and in an instant, transformed into a cage made of Sword Intent.
Ding Ling was trapped in the cage, unable to free himself for the moment.
He was amazed in his heart.
Jian Yue’s strength exceeded his expectations.
Judging from the comics, Jian Yue didn’t seem this strong, but now he was.
Without a doubt, the influx of players and increase in swordsmen made the Sword Realm stronger and stronger.
And Jian Yue’s high affinity with the Sword Realm leads naturally to a rising tide; also, it’s likely Jian Yue has some other fortuitous encounter or transformation that renders him so terrifying!
In less than a second, a lightning-formed sword array cage, trapping the fortyfold amplified Ding Ling!
In this state, Ding Ling was already in his strongest form!
Still being trapped.
One can imagine how fast and fierce Jian Yue’s move was just now.
"Young man, meet your end!"

Having succeeded in his first strike, Jian Yue pressed the attack fiercely, bursting once more with star points at a speed that even ghosts and gods couldn’t perceive, roaring directly towards Ding Ling’s body.

Ding Ling let out an angry roar, unleashing the Lion Roar Skill, Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, and Roar God Manual; waves of sound surged out from Ding Ling, exploding in all directions, shattering the void and raising waves without wind!
The pavilions and walkways transformed by Sword Thought crumbled under this roar, countless were smashed!
But Jian Yue remained unscathed, not frightened but delighted:
"Good, good!
Young man, you please me more and more.
I didn’t expect you to know so many techniques.
After possessing you, I will definitely preserve your soul body’s memory, strip down all your learning, and enrich myself.
I believe that obtaining your fortunes and creations, I will surely become the world’s most free and unrestrained god!"
The more Jian Yue thought about it, the more exhilarating it got, bursting into a hearty laugh.
Boom!
The next moment.
Seeing that Jian Yue was about to rush into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling activated Supreme Sword Dao, Heartless Dao!

The densely packed Spirit Killing Swords surrounded him, forming layers of defense zones, while the tips of the Spirit Killing Swords pointed outward, ready to pierce and shatter anyone rashly charging in!
"Haha, I’ve already thought of a method to crack your move, young man, surrender and accept your fate!"
Swish, Swish!

Jian Yue’s body became more blurred and fragmented, traversing over the sword tips, and in the blink of an eye, crossed the defensive zone formed by the Spirit Killing Swords, lunging into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling’s body trembled uncontrollably.
The next moment.
Jian Yue began to charge towards Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness!
"Good, good, good!"
Jian Yue’s voice grew even louder, overflowing with nearly uncontainable elation:
"Your body is truly perfect.
Is this Divine Form Power?
One Dragon and One Thunder Elephant!
You’ve actually cultivated them to the Great Perfection of the Realm of Nature!"
It seemed he saw something else, his voice quivering:
"This is Wind and Cloud Divine Power!
Could this be the Infinite Power that Master Bodhidharma realized from the power of the wind and clouds across the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths?!
It’s too strong!
You have as many as ten root powers of this Wind and Cloud Divine Power!
How is this possible?
How did you cultivate this, huh?"
It seemed he noticed something else, surprised:
"In your Dantian, your meridians, they’re full of all sorts of Marvelous Skill Secret Manual’s Divine Power, and yet you haven’t succumbed to inner demons?!
No, no, no, the most unbelievable thing is, you, a young man of barely twenty-something years of bone age!
How did you cultivate so many Divine Skills, and it seems they’ve all reached Great Perfection.
Even if you started cultivating from birth, you could never reach this level.
Could it be... that you are also an old monster who possessed this young man’s body?!"
The more Jian Yue thought about it, the more sense it made, he couldn’t help but let out a long laugh:
"This is cause and effect, the retribution is inevitable!
Old monster, you possessed this young man early on, today it’s your fate to fall into Eternal Hell!
Let me avenge this young man!"

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 665: Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique
paragraphs: Jian Yue’s voice seemed filled with righteousness and sternness.
Yet the madness and joy in his words were completely unabashed!
He laughed louder and louder, increasingly satisfied:
"Truly the heavens have eyes! To deliver such a fortune to me. It seems the hundreds of years of agony and suffering were not endured for nothing! Old monster, let me put an end to you!"
Whoosh!
Jian Yue no longer hesitated, accelerating as he charged towards Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling was anxious, increasing the Heartless Dao by forty times!
Whoosh, whoosh!
The Spirit Killing Sword surged into the Sea of Consciousness, once again densely surrounding it, forming a defense formation.
At the same time, the amplification of the Godslaying Tribulation from the Holy Heart Technique condensed into a massive human face mask, blocking the entrance and exit of the Sea of Consciousness.

Just as Ding Ling completed the defenses, Jian Yue rushed over. He saw that face radiating an icy chill as if it could shatter human spirits, confirming all the more that Ding Ling was indeed the old monster:
"Such skillful, inscrutable techniques and divine powers. Thankfully, we’re in the Sword Realm. If we were outside, I might have been taken down by you!"
With a secret sigh of relief, Jian Yue thought of the immense future achievement if he could possess such a perfect body! Feeling invigorated again, he laughed heartily and said:
"It’s like a pie from heaven! I’ve been unlucky all my life, but I’m finally going to have some luck!"
If he were outside.
The Sword Thought would weaken.
He definitely wouldn’t be able to possess.
But now, in the Sword Realm! In this Sword Mountain! His abilities were vastly amplified, and the Sword Thought was bolstered by the Sword Realm, making him the strongest.
If there’s an opportunity here and one does not possess, it would be too foolish!
With this thought, Jian Yue increased his speed even further, as if riding the Nine Heavens Profound Wind, swiftly entering through the mouth of that massive human face.
His body scattered, dispersing into points of light. Even though some light points were shattered by the cold, more raced through small crack openings, reaching the Sea of Consciousness.
Neither the Godslaying Tribulation nor the Spirit Killing Sword could stop his advance!
"Hahaha..."
Upon reaching Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness, Jian Yue laughed joyfully three times:
"It’s finally the critical moment. Old monster, let’s see where you can run now!"
He charged towards the core area of Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness, his speed incredible, a pursuit matched only by lightning.
Within a breath, he crossed an unknown amount of distance.
Upon traversing through layer upon layer of mist to reach the core area, Jian Yue saw a boundless, vast library!
"What’s that?!"
His pupils contracted.
Just as he was about to speak.
Boom!

The library slightly trembled, and a profound force rushed forth, instantly enveloping Jian Yue’s ’Spirit Body.’ In the roar, more than half of Jian Yue’s body was shattered, and the remaining portion was suppressed by this mysterious power within the Sea of Consciousness, unable to move.
"What is this?! Ah!!"
Jian Yue screamed in agony.
Lost half his Spirit Body.
For him, the damage was severe, requiring decades to recover!
"How is this possible?! This kind of power! Could you truly be a reincarnation of a deity?!"
Jian Yue vaguely saw Ding Ling’s consciousness body, identical to Ding Ling, suggesting Ding Ling wasn’t possessed by the old monster; there was only one possibility!
Thinking about it, Jian Yue couldn’t help but have his Spirit Body tremble, his face full of incredulity.
He wanted to struggle.
Yet felt as if suppressed by ten thousand mountains, unable to move an inch:
"I surrender. Great God, please let me out!"

After more than half of Jian Yue’s Spirit Body shattered, he felt as if his consciousness would sink along with it, unable to help but tremble in shock. Thinking about the consequences of completely vanishing, he felt a bit fearful; no one wants to die, and he’s no exception, especially since he suffered for hundreds of years without experiencing a day of good life outside. If he were to die like this, he’d be resentful.
His current behavior contrasted hugely with before! As if he were two different people!
Earlier he was as arrogant and mad, now he’s as humble and pitiable.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Jian Yue.]

[Note: Jian Yue, a top expert in the Sword Realm! After the heavenly rules changed, he was selected and empowered by Sword Mountain, boosting his abilities by countless times! In Sword Mountain, he was nearly invincible and immortal. Yet you heavily injured him. Nearly killed him!

Jian Yue’s Spirit Body has mostly shattered, and his mind began to turn chaotic. The instinctive will to survive took the upper hand, raising his awe for you to an unprecedented level at this moment!]
Upon hearing the notification sound.
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief, wiping the sweat from his forehead, realizing how close he was to life and death.
Thankfully, the library had absorbed ’nutritional resources’ during this time. It was able to unleash a mighty attack once more.

The library and Martial Arts Melting Furnace had previously shattered Chiyou’s Soul Division and a trace of Emperor Shitian’s Primordial Spirit, becoming extremely dim, yet still capable of unleashing one attack.
Afterward, Ding Ling continuously absorbed various ’resources,’ making the library and Martial Arts Melting Furnace much brighter, essentially capable of launching two attacks.

Considering the subsequent infusion of Supreme Sword Dao, Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, Six Great Demonic Crossings, Iron Refining Hand, and other magic and skill, all of which were of high quality, each comparable to countless Third-class Techniques.
But...
Jian Yue’s Spirit Body was far stronger than a trace of Emperor Shitian’s Primordial Spirit.
Just now’s attack.
Seemed to have consumed the power of two strikes from the library and Martial Arts Melting Furnace, making them both fade completely, unable to launch passive defense attacks again!
If Ding Ling encounters similar attacks next, he’ll have to rely on himself.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but focus on the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
As expected.
As streams of light flew out from the Martial Arts Melting Furnace, streams of spiritual light condensed into Secret Manuals, placed on the library’s bookshelves.
In an instant.
[Qiankun Sword Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
This is clearly a Shattering Level Skill.
Once at full level.
Using the leg as a sword, controlling the sword with Qi, a kick releases a swirling storm, Sword Qi overflowing!
This is a technique that, when trained to the utmost, allows a single leg to unleash the explosive effect of a sword leaving its sheath!
Apart from the leg.
Qiankun Qi Sword also brings a Defense Shield, forming a Qi Sword that can attack and defend.
[Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique Full Level]
[Wisdom +0.6]
This is an extremely terrifying skill.
Once at full level.
Ding Ling’s Sword Intent containing Sword Thought instantly permeates, basking in the Sword Realm’s spiritual light.
Rushing spiritual light floods from all directions, submerging Ding Ling’s Sword Thought.
In merely an instant.
The previously frail Sword Thought, detectable only through spiritual perception, suddenly filled out to visible levels, glowing vividly in the void, with a form identical to Ding Ling!

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 666: The Limit of Strength
paragraphs: This is Ding Ling’s Sword Thought!
It can also be said to be Ding Ling’s Sword Intent, which has self-generated into a Sword Spirit after being baptized by the infinite Spiritual Light of the Sword Realm!
A Sword Spirit that carries Ding Ling’s consciousness.
"Return!"
With a movement of Ding Ling’s thought, the Sword Spirit immediately returned to its body.
"This feeling..."

With another thought of Ding Ling, the Spirit Killing Sword appeared again, and this time, different from before, the Spirit Killing Sword was imbued with Sword Thought, that is, Sword Spirit, making it extremely agile and able to perform various transformations freely in the void, making its agility and power significantly stronger than before!

"This seems to be only the initial form of the Sword Spirit, if the Sword Spirit becomes as solid as Jian Yue, akin to a True Person, it would be formidable indeed, able to dominate the Sword Realm with few rivals!"
Nonetheless.
This Sword Spirit seems to be able to receive the support of Sword Mountain in this Sword Realm.
Ding Ling felt, waves of Spiritual Light from the Sword Realm rushed over, being madly absorbed and refined by the Sword Spirit.
This is the Sword Spirit operating the Full Level of Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique for self-cultivation.
Only when the Fundamental Technique reaches Full Level.
Can a certain amount of Spiritual Vitality be absorbed, condensing it into special air streams.
And this Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique, relative to the Sword Spirit, is a kind of Fundamental Technique too.
However, it does not absorb Spiritual Vitality.
But rather the unique Spiritual Light of the Sword Realm.
This Spiritual Light was initially absorbed frantically by the Sword Thought, thus creating a Sword Spirit!
But this Sword Spirit is only in its initial form, to progress it needs to absorb more Spiritual Light. Fortunately, in the Sword Realm, this Spiritual Light is abundant.
Therefore.
The Sword Spirit of Ding Ling is constantly progressing, evolving.
Apart from these two Full Level Skills and Techniques, there are many other secret skills and martial arts that have reached Full Level.
Though compared to the two mentioned, they are much weaker.
"How is this possible?!"
At the moment Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit took form, Jian Yue felt it clearly through the instinctive reaction of repulsion, and was shocked beyond words:

"I spent hundreds of years comprehending the Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique! And this guy achieved Great Perfection in an instant?! How exactly did he do it?! Could it be he studied similar methods before? But isn’t this method only comprehensible by Sword Thought, Sword Soul who’ve stayed in the Sword Realm for over a hundred years? Could this guy be a reincarnation of a Sword Realm master?!"
Jian Yue was full of uncertainty.
He realized.
The more he interacts with Ding Ling.
The more confused he becomes, the more unable to see through him.
Initially, he simply thought Ding Ling was an exceptionally talented young man, he greatly admired Ding Ling and was thrilled to have met him, hence wanting to usurp Ding Ling’s body;
Later entering Ding Ling’s body, discovering various ’treasures’ and ’secrets,’ he presumed Ding Ling was an ancient monster reborn;
After being half-shattered by the library, faintly sensing Ding Ling’s soul body form, he concluded Ding Ling was a deity reincarnated.
But now Ding Ling instantly trained the Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique to Great Perfection, making him suspect Ding Ling might be a major figure reincarnated from the Sword Realm!
The more he looks, the more he thinks.
Jian Yue becomes increasingly bewildered, and the wariness and fear towards Ding Ling grow even deeper!
He couldn’t have imagined, in hundreds of years, finally meeting someone, and they turned out to be so ridiculously powerful and uncanny!
"Who exactly are you?!"
Jian Yue couldn’t help but tremble in asking.
Ding Ling ignored Jian Yue and instead began to eat the hundreds-year-old Great Medicine he got from his Storage Pouch.
A plant of Great Medicine was swallowed.
The slight hunger induced by the increase in Attribute Points instantly vanished.
The War God Technique activated, beginning to madly devour Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi.
Ding Ling’s physique, defense, and strength began to grow again.
[Strength +0.2]
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
[Physique +0.2]
A plant of several thousand years of Great Medicine equals hundreds of plants of two or three hundred years.
After digesting it, amplifies forty times upon refining.
Quickly.
[Strength +3]
[Defense +3]
[Physique +3]
Eating one plant is equivalent to consuming hundreds.
Its efficiency is evident.
Ding Ling didn’t delay.
He took out other Great Medicines, with still six left.
Each plant can increase 3 points in each of the three attributes.
Also, because it only provides Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi for the War God Technique, there’s no concept of resistance.
Thus.
After eating a bit over another plant.
Ding Ling noticed his strength had already reached its limit.
He glanced at the character panel:
[Bone Structure 6, Intelligence 10.2, Strength 160, Agility 105.6, Physique 160, Defense 149.4, Charm 13.1. True Power Value: 77 points]
Strength and Physique both reached the limit!
Now, Ding Ling’s strength is vast, with tenfold amplification, a single punch can easily shatter a small mountain;
With high Physique, Ding Ling’s endurance, vitality, self-healing ability, resistance, etc., are elevated to a level unattainable by ordinary people.
"Strength and Physique have reached the world’s limit."
"It seems 160 points is the world’s limit."
Ding Ling was relieved.
Continued eating Great Medicine.
There’s slightly more than five plants left.
Each plant can increase 9 Attribute Points! Plus, the War God Technique only needs Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi, no resistance exists.
Thus a little over one plant entered his belly.
[Defense: 160]
Strength, Physique, Defense all reached the limit.
Ding Ling’s War God Technique hasn’t yet achieved Great Perfection regarding Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi intake.
But the subsequent consumption of these Great Medicines didn’t increase Attribute Points.
Simply provided massive amounts of Spiritual Vitality, Primordial Qi to the War God Technique!
When all Great Medicines were consumed.
Ding Ling felt the War God Technique’s requirement for Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi was almost filled by fifty to sixty percent.

"The Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi required by the War God Technique are vast indeed. Ordinary people probably cannot train it to Chiyou’s Immortal level because the Great Medicine might not suffice!"
’Perhaps only an Overlord like Chiyou can cultivate the War God Technique to Great Perfection, the Immortal realm.’
Because only an Overlord can integrate a world’s resources! To satisfy oneself!
Like Ding Ling.
Having consumed so much Great Medicine and obtained various opportunities.
The War God Technique only achieved about five to sixty percent of its potential.
This shows the difficulty level of cultivating the War God Technique.
Though just five to sixty percent.
Even if Ding Ling was dismembered, he could still instantly regenerate.
Such is the dominance of five to sixty percent of the War God Technique.
If the War God Technique were trained to its full potential, the result would be unimaginable!
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Ignoring the shouts and screams of Jian Yue in his Sea of Consciousness, he began to examine the previously obtained Secret Manual.
These Secret Manuals were placed in the deepest area of the Void Sacred Realm, indicating their exceptional nature!
"Currently, I have no means to kill Jian Yue, so I’ll strengthen myself first, perhaps eventually discovering the secret and method to kill Jian Yue."
Ding Ling had always progressed this way.

After being half-shattered by the library, faintly sensing Ding Ling’s soul body form, he concluded Ding Ling was a deity reincarnated.
But now Ding Ling instantly trained the Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique to Great Perfection, making him suspect Ding Ling might be a major figure reincarnated from the Sword Realm!
The more he looks, the more he thinks.
Jian Yue becomes increasingly bewildered, and the wariness and fear towards Ding Ling grow even deeper!
He couldn’t have imagined, in hundreds of years, finally meeting someone, and they turned out to be so ridiculously powerful and uncanny!
"Who exactly are you?!"
Jian Yue couldn’t help but tremble in asking.
Ding Ling ignored Jian Yue and instead began to eat the hundreds-year-old Great Medicine he got from his Storage Pouch.
A plant of Great Medicine was swallowed.
The slight hunger induced by the increase in Attribute Points instantly vanished.
The War God Technique activated, beginning to madly devour Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi.
Ding Ling’s physique, defense, and strength began to grow again.
[Strength +0.2]
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
[Physique +0.2]
A plant of several thousand years of Great Medicine equals hundreds of plants of two or three hundred years.
After digesting it, amplifies forty times upon refining.
Quickly.
[Strength +3]
[Defense +3]
[Physique +3]
Eating one plant is equivalent to consuming hundreds.
Its efficiency is evident.
Ding Ling didn’t delay.
He took out other Great Medicines, with still six left.
Each plant can increase 3 points in each of the three attributes.
Also, because it only provides Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi for the War God Technique, there’s no concept of resistance.
Thus.
After eating a bit over another plant.
Ding Ling noticed his strength had already reached its limit.
He glanced at the character panel:
[Bone Structure 6, Intelligence 10.2, Strength 160, Agility 105.6, Physique 160, Defense 149.4, Charm 13.1.
True Power Value: 77 points]
Strength and Physique both reached the limit!
Now, Ding Ling’s strength is vast, with tenfold amplification, a single punch can easily shatter a small mountain;
With high Physique, Ding Ling’s endurance, vitality, self-healing ability, resistance, etc., are elevated to a level unattainable by ordinary people.
"Strength and Physique have reached the world’s limit."
"It seems 160 points is the world’s limit."
Ding Ling was relieved.
Continued eating Great Medicine.
There’s slightly more than five plants left.
Each plant can increase 9 Attribute Points!
Plus, the War God Technique only needs Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi, no resistance exists.
Thus a little over one plant entered his belly.
[Defense: 160]
Strength, Physique, Defense all reached the limit.
Ding Ling’s War God Technique hasn’t yet achieved Great Perfection regarding Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi intake.
But the subsequent consumption of these Great Medicines didn’t increase Attribute Points.
Simply provided massive amounts of Spiritual Vitality, Primordial Qi to the War God Technique!
When all Great Medicines were consumed.
Ding Ling felt the War God Technique’s requirement for Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi was almost filled by fifty to sixty percent.
"The Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi required by the War God Technique are vast indeed.
Ordinary people probably cannot train it to Chiyou’s Immortal level because the Great Medicine might not suffice!"
’Perhaps only an Overlord like Chiyou can cultivate the War God Technique to Great Perfection, the Immortal realm.’
Because only an Overlord can integrate a world’s resources!
To satisfy oneself!
Like Ding Ling.
Having consumed so much Great Medicine and obtained various opportunities.
The War God Technique only achieved about five to sixty percent of its potential.
This shows the difficulty level of cultivating the War God Technique.
Though just five to sixty percent.
Even if Ding Ling was dismembered, he could still instantly regenerate.
Such is the dominance of five to sixty percent of the War God Technique.
If the War God Technique were trained to its full potential, the result would be unimaginable!
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Ignoring the shouts and screams of Jian Yue in his Sea of Consciousness, he began to examine the previously obtained Secret Manual.
These Secret Manuals were placed in the deepest area of the Void Sacred Realm, indicating their exceptional nature!
"Currently, I have no means to kill Jian Yue, so I’ll strengthen myself first, perhaps eventually discovering the secret and method to kill Jian Yue."
Ding Ling had always progressed this way.

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 667: Five Thunders Transcendent Hand Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling had always believed that.
He couldn’t solve the problem, it must be due to insufficient cultivation.
As long as he was strong enough, any difficulty would melt away like ice, unable to withstand a single blow.
And the facts prove.
Indeed so.
The once powerful and domineering dynasties, after he increased his cultivation, were easily shattered by his own strength!
This is the absolute dominance of the strong.
There is no problem that can’t be solved.
If there is, it’s only because weakness is the original sin!
Rustle!
Ding Ling began browsing the first secret manual.
Quickly finished reading.
[Snow Blood Claw Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Snow Blood Claw External Skill Heart Method Full Level]
[Agility +0.7]
This surprisingly is a technique and law of Shattering Level that cultivates both internally and externally.
It is a divine skill that, when cultivated to the extreme, can use Snow Blood Claw to easily freeze others.
It’s the supreme skill cultivated by the Ice Emperor.
The Ice Emperor relied on this martial art to ascend to the ranks of unparalleled masters!
Now Ding Ling instantly reaches full level.

Rushing Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi madly surrounded him from all directions, submerging him. Ding Ling operated the Eternal Youth Technique, refining these Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi in an instant.
With an extra drop of Longevity True Water appearing in his Dantian.
[True Power Value: 78 points.]
Strength became stronger once more.

Yet Ding Ling felt the thinness of Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi in this Ten Directions Realm, fearing that with this single practice of Snow Blood Claw, he had absorbed all the Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi within a kilometer radius.

"This Sword Realm is indeed the Sword Realm; only true swordsmen can go far and live long here. For ordinary people, the deeper they go into the Sword Realm, the more they are attacked and suppressed by various Sword Thoughts and Sword Spirits!"
Strength was elevated once again.
Moreover, because the Sword Spirit was continuously accumulating and refining the spiritual light of the Sword Realm, Ding Ling’s understanding and knowledge of the Sword Realm kept enhancing.
He found that if the Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi were exhausted in this Sword Realm, anyone entering this world, if their True Qi was consumed entirely, might only passively await death!
Unless luck brings them right to the Sword Realm’s exit; or their strength is sufficient to tear apart the Void World of the Sword Realm.
Otherwise, they might be trapped and perish.
"Previously I didn’t feel it. Just now while practicing Snow Blood Claw, I realized this world’s Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi seems insufficient.
Ding Ling wandered along the winding corridors beside the Dragon Phoenix Pavilion, walking over a thousand meters away before sensing the existence of Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi again.
And this Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi mixed with the spiritual light and Sword Thought of the Sword Realm.
Even experts of Ding Ling’s Middle Tier of Shattering initially did not perceive any abnormality, let alone those grandmasters or people at the Initial Tier of Shattering.
When they finally reacted, having consumed a large amount of True Qi and sought to absorb Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi to restore themselves, it would be already too late!
By that time.
Decades or maybe even hundreds of years later, the Sword Realm might have additional Sword Spirits similar to Jian Yue.
Jian Yue might have been trapped here due to this?
The specific reason, Ding Ling did not know, nor did he ask Jian Yue. Just walking far away, he hadn’t seen anyone, and without further delay, he started flipping through the next secret manual.
Soon.
[Snow-breaking Heaven-opening Full Level]
[Agility +0.5]
This is a skill close to Shattering Level.
When cultivated to the extreme, it can instantly melt ice and snow with intense palm force.
Though not as good as Iron Refining Hand.
Yet it is still very extraordinary.
It seems that Divine Mother Luo Xian excels at this method.
"Agility increased again."
As strength and other attributes reach their peak.
The excess energy in these attributes will channel into agility, albeit with considerable loss.
Despite that, it increased by 0.5.
This shows the extraordinary nature of Snow-breaking Heaven-opening.
Next.
[Vast Righteous Qi Zither Sound Full Level]
[Agility +0.4]
This is a Sound Wave Skill using zither sound as an attack method.
Rich in Vast Righteous Qi!
Once at full level, it can intimidate evil spirits and ward off heart demons!
[Five Thunders Transcendent Hand Full Level!]
[Agility +0.8]
This is a technique of the Middle Tier of Shattering!
Extremely formidable.
Upon reaching full level, it can transform Divine Weapons and Inner Power!
Common divine weapons that encounter this technique will be turned into molten iron and smoke! Extremely terrifying!
Besides, this technique is incredibly challenging to cultivate, and without the Power of Five Elements within one’s body, mastering this technique is as difficult as climbing the heavens.
Emperor Shitian couldn’t accomplish this technique because the Power of Five Elements produced by the technique clashed and collided with the powers in his body!
Yet Ding Ling managed to master it?
Because of the library’s defying capabilities, ignoring all adversity and difficulty, reaching full level directly!
Even now, the difficulty of cultivating Five Thunders Transcendent Hand exceeds a few points compared to Iron Refining Hand, yet Ding Ling still reached full level in an instant.
After reaching full level.
He realized the power of this technique.
"Unless it’s a divine weapon like the Unparalleled Sword or Xuanyuan Sword, other divine weapons will be dissolved by my Five Thunders Transcendent Hand!"
This feeling is very strong.
Ding Ling understood it wasn’t an illusion.

"Five Thunders Transcendent Hand was created by Nu Fenglei with ten years of painstaking effort; regarding its application, Nu Fenglei naturally reached the Transformation Realm, yet even so, he was crushed by Emperor Shitian. This shows that no matter how strong a technique is, it is ultimately just a technique meant for auxiliary use; fundamentally, cultivation is the most important. If the cultivation is sufficient, only then can such techniques exhibit their powerful efficacy."
The rationale is straightforward.
The Emperor’s Sword is very powerful. But even if it enhances its Sword Intent and Sword Qi by several times in the hands of an ordinary person, Ding Ling can kill the opponent with a casual gesture.
Yet in Xiaao Aoshi’s hands, the result is entirely different.
It’s the same with techniques; it depends on who uses them.
Ding Ling proceeded to read several secret manuals consecutively, all reaching full level, yet didn’t find the Holy Heart Technique, feeling somewhat regretful.
"Doesn’t Emperor Shitian leave a secret manual for Holy Heart Technique?"
Ding Ling thought of the box, his heart stirred, reaching into his Storage Pouch to grab a box and closely examining it.
Seeing that the box was blood-red all over and quite warm to hold.
"This box seems to be made from millennia-old Cold Jade."
Ding Ling was surprised:
"Moreover, the quality of this Cold Jade is much higher than the Cold Jade Bed of the Divine Condor and His Companion. Such Cold Jade should be extremely cold, why is it warm when held?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
His heart and spirit tensed.
Instinctively, he felt that the contents of this box were unusual.
After pondering, he placed the box on the ground, three spans away, surrounded by Defensive Gang Qi Shield, and the Qiankun Great Shift’s Vigorous Qi constantly circulated around him.
His left hand gathered Vigorous Qi, with the fire energy of Iron Refining Hand surging continuously.
With such thorough preparations.
Ding Ling then applied the Dragon Capturing Skill, snapping the chain and lifting the box lid.
In the next moment.
Boom!
A surge of overwhelming Fire Qi spread from the box to all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 668: One Finger
paragraphs: Boom!
Where the Fire Qi passed.
Everything seemed to be incinerated!

Phoenix Pavilion and Dragon Loft, winding corridors, high eaves and corner teeth, exquisite rockeries, flowing green water... Everything within a hundred meters was instantly destroyed by this surge of Fire Qi!
Even Ding Ling was pushed back three steps by this Fire Qi.
Fortunately, he was prepared, continuously exerting skillful force, shifting Vigorous Qi, and dispelling this overwhelming rising Fire Qi.
"What is this thing?"
After the Fire Qi dissipated, Ding Ling stood several feet away, looking on with bright eyes, seeing very clearly.
It was a flame the size of a palm!
But if you looked closely.
You would discover.
A little finger hidden within the flame.
The finger was slender, pale, cleaner than ivory, like a piece of art.
"A finger?"
Ding Ling was surprised, somewhat confused.
He quickly stepped forward, employing the Iron Refining Hand, his hand emanating a scorching temperature enough to melt gold and iron, he extended his hand towards the flame.
Very hot.
But the temperature was similar to that of the Iron Refining Hand.
"Phew."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed there was no issue using the Iron Refining Hand to grab this finger.
Indeed, it was so.
As Ding Ling’s hand delved into the flame, he easily pinched the little finger in his hand.
Whoosh!
The flame on the little finger burned with a dazzling blaze.

"It seems the sudden outburst when opening the box was very likely because this flame automatically absorbed boundless Spiritual Vitality and Spiritual Light from the world, which then erupted all at once when the box was opened."
After this surge of Fire Qi erupted completely.
The threat from this finger actually reduced significantly.
"Emperor Shitian cultivating the Iron Refining Hand, it seems the real purpose was for this finger."
Emperor Shitian cultivated many Fire Attribute skills.
But he was most proficient in Ice Attribute skills.
Ice and Fire are incompatible.
Yet he cultivated some Fire Attribute skills to Great Perfection, Ding Ling hadn’t understood before, but now, seeing this finger, he realized:
"Without Fire Attribute skill at Great Perfection, one simply can’t hold this finger. But who does this finger belong to? Just a single finger is this powerful?!"
Ding Ling was extremely strong now.
But looking at this finger, it still gave him a soul-stirring, eerie feeling.
It was evident that, if the owner of this finger was alive, they must be an incredibly terrifying powerhouse.
"Are there still such powerhouses in the Wind and Cloud World?!"
Ding Ling suddenly thought of the Celestial Realm mentioned by Chiyou, and the Gods and Demons mentioned by Bai Suzhen:
"Could this finger belong to some God or Demon?"
Ding Ling couldn’t figure it out, but suddenly something in his heart moved, he had an idea, because he discovered that the things scorched by this finger’s Fire Qi hadn’t restored?!
"Coincidence?"
"It shouldn’t be."
Previously when Ding Ling shouted, the shocked sound wave caused pieces of pavilions and corridors to collapse and shatter, but after a while, they returned to their original appearance.
Because they weren’t real objects; they were manifestations constructed from the martial artist’s Spirit Sword Thought Sword Intent!
Such pavilions and corridors would reconstruct after countless collapses, though it might be slower if they were massively broken.
But it wouldn’t be to the point of showing no signs of recovery at all.
"Could it be that..."
Ding Ling tried to cast a Spirit Killing Sword toward the finger, and indeed, with a sizzle, the spirit sword was incinerated by the flame.
However, after burning the Spirit Killing Sword, the flame dimmed slightly.
Ding Ling instantly came up with an idea.
"The flame on this finger can extinguish Sword Intent, so using it to suppress Sword Mountain should be no problem at all."
Thinking this.

Ding Ling moved his mind, activating the Iron Refining Hand to the fullest extent, pinching the Fire Finger with two fingers, then with a thought, the Sword Spirit transformed into streaming light and entered the Sea of Consciousness.
This Sword Spirit smoothly arrived before Jian Yue, and Ding Ling, through the Sword Spirit, said:
"Jian Yue, do you want to die or live?"
"Naturally, I want to live."
Jian Yue replied with a distressed and tearless face:
"Who would want to die for no reason?"
His Consciousness Body was increasingly in chaos.
But half of his Spirit Body was missing.
The other half was suppressed into immobility, and the Spiritual Light was not replenished in time, making his entire Spirit Body show signs of scattering and collapsing.
He became increasingly terrified, knowing that if his Spirit Body scattered, he would be doomed.
"I give you two options. Either continue to be suppressed here until death, or become the Sword Spirit of the sword in my hand."
Ding Ling didn’t use Xuanyuan Divine Sword for an experiment.
Instead, he took out the Giant Que Sword from his Storage Pouch!

This sword had followed him from the Three Kingdoms World through several worlds, a genuine Divine Weapon, but as Ding Ling obtained increasingly powerful and supreme weaponry, this Divine Weapon from the Three Kingdoms World was no longer considered worthy.
To put it plainly.
The Xuanyuan Divine Sword is comparable to a Shattering Level Divine Weapon, whereas the Giant Que Sword is only an Innate Level Divine Weapon.
The difference in class is too great!
It’s entirely incomparable.
If the two Divine Weapons clashed directly, the Giant Que Sword would likely be easily severed!
Therefore, Ding Ling hadn’t used this sword in a long time, not for lack of desire, but because once used, it would be cut apart by weapons like the Emperor’s Sword!
"Alright!"
Jian Yue agreed decisively:
"I agree to be the Sword Spirit of the sword in your hand!"
The current Jian Yue was an entirely different person from before, when he displayed "senior demeanor" and looked down on Ding Ling as a superior expert!
The times have changed! He couldn’t imagine he would ever be so humble and submit!
"Very well."
Ding Ling, using full-level acting skills, said with satisfaction:
"I will soon release you, cooperate with me properly and immediately enter the interior of the sword I’m holding in my left hand!"
Ding Ling knew that the suppressive power of the library and the Martial Arts Melting Furnace couldn’t last long.
At most, another half incense stick of time.
The suppressive force would completely collapse then.
If Jian Yue caused chaos in the Sea of Consciousness at that time, it would be even more troublesome!
Therefore, Ding Ling chose to use his acting skills to persuade Jian Yue into entering the interior of the Giant Que Sword, becoming its Sword Spirit!
Ding Ling’s own Sword Thought now was also a Sword Spirit.
Thus, he fully understood the terror of Sword Spirits, capable of easily amplifying a sword’s Sword Intent and Sword Qi! The stronger the Sword Spirit, the more terrifying the power of the sword!
Ding Ling even suspected there was an extremely powerful Sword Spirit within the Emperor’s Sword!
And it’s rumored that Jian Yue once, by chance, acquired the Emperor’s Sword in later years, but he voluntarily abandoned it.
Ding Ling hadn’t understood before.
But after his Sword Thought became a Sword Spirit, he was enlightened.

If there was an extremely strong Sword Spirit within the Emperor’s Sword, an ordinary person might manage it, but for someone like Jian Yue, such a Sword Spirit would be sure to initially coexist peacefully; however, over time, Jian Yue’s own Sword Intent, Sword Qi, and Sword Thought would be continuously corroded, absorbed, and refined by the Emperor’s Sword.
This would make Jian Yue grow weaker and weaker, eventually possibly disappearing into thin air!

However, after burning the Spirit Killing Sword, the flame dimmed slightly.
Ding Ling instantly came up with an idea.
"The flame on this finger can extinguish Sword Intent, so using it to suppress Sword Mountain should be no problem at all."
Thinking this.

Ding Ling moved his mind, activating the Iron Refining Hand to the fullest extent, pinching the Fire Finger with two fingers, then with a thought, the Sword Spirit transformed into streaming light and entered the Sea of Consciousness.
This Sword Spirit smoothly arrived before Jian Yue, and Ding Ling, through the Sword Spirit, said:
"Jian Yue, do you want to die or live?"
"Naturally, I want to live."
Jian Yue replied with a distressed and tearless face:
"Who would want to die for no reason?"
His Consciousness Body was increasingly in chaos.
But half of his Spirit Body was missing.
The other half was suppressed into immobility, and the Spiritual Light was not replenished in time, making his entire Spirit Body show signs of scattering and collapsing.
He became increasingly terrified, knowing that if his Spirit Body scattered, he would be doomed.
"I give you two options.
Either continue to be suppressed here until death, or become the Sword Spirit of the sword in my hand."
Ding Ling didn’t use Xuanyuan Divine Sword for an experiment.
Instead, he took out the Giant Que Sword from his Storage Pouch!

This sword had followed him from the Three Kingdoms World through several worlds, a genuine Divine Weapon, but as Ding Ling obtained increasingly powerful and supreme weaponry, this Divine Weapon from the Three Kingdoms World was no longer considered worthy.
To put it plainly.
The Xuanyuan Divine Sword is comparable to a Shattering Level Divine Weapon, whereas the Giant Que Sword is only an Innate Level Divine Weapon.
The difference in class is too great!
It’s entirely incomparable.
If the two Divine Weapons clashed directly, the Giant Que Sword would likely be easily severed!
Therefore, Ding Ling hadn’t used this sword in a long time, not for lack of desire, but because once used, it would be cut apart by weapons like the Emperor’s Sword!
"Alright!"
Jian Yue agreed decisively:
"I agree to be the Sword Spirit of the sword in your hand!"
The current Jian Yue was an entirely different person from before, when he displayed "senior demeanor" and looked down on Ding Ling as a superior expert!
The times have changed!
He couldn’t imagine he would ever be so humble and submit!
"Very well."
Ding Ling, using full-level acting skills, said with satisfaction:
"I will soon release you, cooperate with me properly and immediately enter the interior of the sword I’m holding in my left hand!"
Ding Ling knew that the suppressive power of the library and the Martial Arts Melting Furnace couldn’t last long.
At most, another half incense stick of time.
The suppressive force would completely collapse then.
If Jian Yue caused chaos in the Sea of Consciousness at that time, it would be even more troublesome!
Therefore, Ding Ling chose to use his acting skills to persuade Jian Yue into entering the interior of the Giant Que Sword, becoming its Sword Spirit!
Ding Ling’s own Sword Thought now was also a Sword Spirit.
Thus, he fully understood the terror of Sword Spirits, capable of easily amplifying a sword’s Sword Intent and Sword Qi!
The stronger the Sword Spirit, the more terrifying the power of the sword!
Ding Ling even suspected there was an extremely powerful Sword Spirit within the Emperor’s Sword!
And it’s rumored that Jian Yue once, by chance, acquired the Emperor’s Sword in later years, but he voluntarily abandoned it.
Ding Ling hadn’t understood before.
But after his Sword Thought became a Sword Spirit, he was enlightened.

If there was an extremely strong Sword Spirit within the Emperor’s Sword, an ordinary person might manage it, but for someone like Jian Yue, such a Sword Spirit would be sure to initially coexist peacefully; however, over time, Jian Yue’s own Sword Intent, Sword Qi, and Sword Thought would be continuously corroded, absorbed, and refined by the Emperor’s Sword.
This would make Jian Yue grow weaker and weaker, eventually possibly disappearing into thin air!

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 669: Domain Crystal
paragraphs: This is easy to understand.
Just like they are both water.
The water of a small stream encounters that of a lake.
When the two meet, the greater probability is that the stream’s water merges into the lake, becoming thoroughly fused!
And Sword Spirits born from the Sword Realm have essentially similar natures.
If two Sword Spirits converge.
There’s a high probability that the weaker one will be unconsciously devoured by the stronger one.

Sometimes, the stronger one can’t even control themselves, because this is the natural law of the world, unless the two Sword Spirits are apart, not together day and night, but if they are together day in and day out, over time, strange merging and combining phenomena are sure to occur.
And perhaps for this reason, Jian Yue abandoned the Emperor’s Sword, which was such an unparalleled Divine Weapon.
After all.
Jian Yue is not a person; he is a Sword Spirit.
But Ding Ling is a human; his Sword Thought that transformed into a Sword Spirit is weak, yet it can directly control Divine Weapons that possess Sword Spirits!
Because Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit is sheltered by Ding Ling himself! It can avoid directly confronting and contacting a powerful Sword Spirit.
"Alright, alright, alright!"
Jian Yue hastily agreed:
"As long as you spare me this time, everything will be negotiable!"
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling immediately chose to actively dispel the suppressive force.
This force was passively emitted by the library and Martial Arts Melting Furnace in conjunction.
Not controlled by Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling can actively disperse this force.
He, as a Sword Spirit, directed a thought to the weak point of this force, with a crackling sound, the suppressive force dispersed.
Jian Yue immediately fled as if in desperation from Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness.
In Jian Yue’s view, Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness was too terrifying and strange.
There was actually a library!
This was simply unimaginable! Too hard to believe!
Moreover, his consciousness body and spirit body were mostly shattered; if he didn’t go out and absorb Spiritual Light, he feared he might never recover.
Whew whew!
He fled outside Ding Ling’s body like a stream of light, then turned and headed into the distance without looking back.

On the way, he took a deep breath, whoosh whoosh! Spirals of Spiritual Light gathered, rapidly healing his body; before long, he would be completely healed. Upon this thought, Jian Yue let out a sigh of relief, complex emotions of resentment, envy, awe, and murderous intent intertwined in his mind toward Ding Ling.
"Where are you going!"
Through the eyes of his Sword Spirit, Ding Ling had long determined that Jian Yue was untrustworthy.
Such an old fox, having been trapped in the Sword Realm for hundreds of years, could he truly and willingly become someone’s Sword Spirit?
He let him out because the suppressive force couldn’t last long and he wanted to forcefully restrain him!
Whew!

Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit enhanced himself, making Ding Ling more in tune with the rules of the Sword Realm, with a forty-fold increase, Ding Ling appeared like a fish swimming in the ocean, moving smoothly and freely!

But at the sound of a whoosh breaking the air, the next second Ding Ling was already in front of Jian Yue, then with a thought, the Spirit Killing Sword transformed into dense Sword Rain, mercilessly shooting toward Jian Yue.

Upon meeting again, Ding Ling, using the Observing People Skill, saw that Jian Yue’s mentality had once again changed drastically; this time, he harbored a different kind of jealousy and hatred towards him, intending to kill him!
How could Ding Ling endure this? His intention to restrain Jian Yue as a Sword Spirit immediately faded.
The move was immediately Supreme Sword Dao of Heartless Dao!
Moreover.
As the dense Sword Rain fell upon Jian Yue, blocking his retreat, Ding Ling’s body was like a roaming dragon, holding a Fire Finger, pointing directly at Jian Yue’s head.
"Hahaha..."
Jian Yue, once free, grew arrogant, though still deeply wary of Ding Ling, he realized that Ding Ling’s library must only be passively usable, given this, what was there to fear from Ding Ling?
"I will soon recover! Young man, I don’t want to fight with you! Let’s part ways right here!"
His figure scattered like points of light in an instant, the Spirit Killing Sword hit empty air!
"You broke your promise!"
Ding Ling missed Jian Yue with a finger, acting as furious, shouted loudly:
"Stop!"

"Haha, in life, how can one be someone else’s lackey? To live is to live like a person, I live my life seeking merriment and freedom! Young man, I don’t know your background, but here in the Sword Realm, I need not fear you. Haha, when we meet again, I will surely entertain you well."
"Heh.

With the Sword Spirit’s amplification supporting him, Ding Ling became increasingly in sync with the Sword Realm, moving faster and faster. Though Jian Yue continued to recover and grow stronger, Ding Ling’s increase in speed was no slower.
"Fire Finger, go!"
Ding Ling pointed the Fire Finger at Jian Yue’s direction, using Infinite Power, inflating his entire True Qi, and blowing a breath towards the flame on the Fire Finger.
Whoosh whoosh!

The wind boosted the fire, with a burst of Infinite Power, the flame on the Fire Finger instantly lengthened countless times, spreading in all directions swiftly, like a storm sweeping the ground, in an instant, it engulfed all the star points in the sky!
Ding Ling moved very fast.
With the Sword Spirit fitting into the Sword Realm, forty-fold amplification of Free-Will Ascension Step, his figure moved up and down, left and right, like a deity walking, incredibly swift!
He seemed to become a Spiritual Light in the Sword Realm!
Thus, while Jian Yue fled quickly, Ding Ling could still catch up, with the aid of the Fire Finger, often a single breath could extinguish a large swath of star points.
Several times.

Jian Yue let out a miserable scream, unable to hold his star point form, falling from mid-air, his face turned ashen, his entire spirit body became thin as paper, seemingly about to completely dissipate. Unable to hold on anymore, he decisively said:
"Wait. I surrender. I am willing to become the Sword Spirit of your Treasure Sword!"
"Too late."

Without any hesitation, Ding Ling blew another breath towards Jian Yue’s direction, whoosh whoosh, Power of Wind and Cloud swept the flame of the Fire Finger, like a fire dragon tornado engulfing Jian Yue. Severely weakened, he could not avoid it, with a piercing scream, burned by the flame of the Fire Finger, his Divine Soul was utterly destroyed, leaving only a bright and splendid crystal.
"What is that?"
Ding Ling grabbed the floating crystal in his hand, sensed it, and couldn’t help but show a surprised look:

"Unexpectedly, it’s the Domain Crystal of this thousand-mile Earth Realm! As long as I refine it, my Sword Spirit can absorb the Spiritual Light within a thousand miles at a terrifying speed, growing rapidly!"
Bang bang!

Ding Ling’s heart pounded twice, quickly returning to normal, then without hesitation, he controlled his Sword Spirit to escape his physical form, holding the crystal, and began refining this Domain Crystal!
Once refined.
Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit could become the ’Sword Spirit’ within this thousand-mile radius, essentially becoming a Deity-like existence here! Unrivaled, with boundless powers!
Whether it’s cultivation or recovery, etc., everything would accelerate, progressing rapidly, like it was no matter.
"So, that’s how it is."
Ding Ling suddenly recalled a fragment of a memory.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 670: Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship
paragraphs: This fragment of memory comes from Jian Yue’s half-refined spirit body.
During that refinement, Ding Ling gained many benefits, acquiring the Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique, which turned his sword thought into a sword spirit out of thin air!
Besides that.
Ding Ling also learned many memory fragments from this refined spirit body.
Because the fragments are scattered and unformed.
Ding Ling naturally didn’t observe closely.
But now, thinking about the Domain Crystal, those fragmented memories suddenly emerged with a related memory in his mind.
This deepened Ding Ling’s understanding of the crystal.

"Only sword thoughts and sword souls that have existed in the Sword Realm for over a hundred years can receive the Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique, granted by the Sword Realm in some mysterious way!"

’After the sword thought and sword soul become successful, only those peerless geniuses can refine strands of Light of Dawn from the Sword Realm. These so-called Lights of Dawn are formed from the rays scattered by the Domain crystals within the Sword Realm. As long as enough Light of Dawn is refined, these rays can be reformed into crystals!
And over hundreds of years, Jian Yue, with nothing else to do, refined an unknown amount of Light of Dawn, resulting in this rare Domain Crystal!’
Having obtained this Domain Crystal.
Jian Yue’s spirit body could freely assemble and disperse within a radius of a thousand miles, moving with ghost-like speed.
"But beyond this domain, Jian Yue couldn’t achieve this. Ultimately, it’s all due to the effect of the Domain Crystal. So..."
Ding Ling looked into the distance:
"If there are other similar powers like Jian Yue beyond these thousand miles, wouldn’t it mean they must also possess a Domain Crystal?
If I were to gather all the Domain Crystals in the Sword Realm, what kind of miraculous transformation would occur?"

While Ding Ling was contemplating this, a vague figure suddenly flashed through the void. Like lightning, it charged toward Ding Ling’s sword spirit, spreading open a hand, transforming into wind wings that swept towards the domain crystal.
The attempt was to seize the Domain Crystal.
"Such audacity!"
Ding Ling’s thought activated, and the Spirit Killing Sword increased by forty times shot forth, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
In an instant, an overwhelming sword rain fell upon the figure, followed by a loud explosion, shattering the figure into fragments by Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword.
Leaving only a wisp of spiritual light floating in the void, Ding Ling curiously approached, grabbed it, and the next moment.
Ding Ling’s body slightly trembled.
He realized what the spiritual light was.
It turned out to be a sword technique.
This sword technique entered Ding Ling’s body and meridians, immediately operating automatically, causing Ding Ling’s understanding of this sword technique to instantly reach a perfect state.
But it was still some distance from being fully mastered.
However, as Ding Ling recalled, a secret manual appeared in the library.
The next moment.
[Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.6]
This was impressively a skill at the shattering level!
When cultivated to the extreme, sword qi can transform into wind wings and feathers! It aids in flying and earth escape and can be both offensive and defensive, extremely powerful.
Once this sword technique reached full level.
Ding Ling instantly activated it, clang! Wings immediately appeared behind him!
These wings were formed by the condensed sword qi and sword intent of the Azure Sea Wings!
These wings can disperse into sword rain attacks or flap like a bird’s wings, helping one soar into the sky and can also act as a shield for defense.
Extremely rare.
"Who is this person? Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship? Never heard of it before!"
Ding Ling was filled with doubt and uncertainty.
This person who suddenly appeared was likely a sword spirit. Compared to Jian Yue, they were weaker, lacking a Domain Crystal, indicating they were a wanderer in the Sword Realm without a home.
And without a Domain Crystal, they couldn’t receive the Sword Realm’s infinite support, making it impossible to withstand the Spirit Killing Sword increased by forty times.
Instantly killed!
No time to even cry out before perishing.
Ding Ling, naturally, had no way of knowing who this person was, where they came from, why they were in the Sword Realm, or why they could sense the Domain Crystal and come to rob it?
"Could they be an extremely ancient presence?"

"Perhaps this presence is merely a fragmented sword thought and sword soul that has endured the test of time, thus forming into a sword spirit. Unlike Jian Yue, who became a sword spirit after death, making cultivation smoother. A fragmented sword thought and soul without other memories, trying to cultivate into a sword spirit, its difficulty is imaginable.

And maybe this Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship is merely an imprint within the fragmented sword thought and soul, and only with this imprint could the sword thought and soul persist, slowly becoming a sword spirit?"
That was Ding Ling’s guess.
As for the truth.
He was unaware.
He was merely deducing based on limited knowledge, and the fragmented memory obtained from Jian Yue.
As he was pondering this, suddenly, out of the corner of his eye, he saw another figure rushing in like a tempest, present a second ago hundreds of feet away, the next moment already within reach.
It was a gracefully shaped, indistinctly-featured female sword spirit, who upon appearing, immediately reached for the domain crystal!
Another spirit attempting to seize the crystal!

This time, Ding Ling was prepared; the Spirit Killing Sword roared into action, an overwhelming sword rain descended from all directions, enclosing the female sword spirit in the center of the formation.
Then Ding Ling turned around like the wind, landing in front of her, blocking her view of the domain crystal, asking:
"Who are you?"

With her view of the domain crystal obstructed, the female sword spirit seemed agitated, suddenly let out a roar, and boom! With an ethereal sound, the female sword spirit vanished, next moment forming into a shadow, gripping a sharp sword crafted from sword qi, attempting to stab Ding Ling in the back!

Ding Ling always remained in the forty-time amplification state, since despite his increased understanding and knowledge of the Sword Realm, it wasn’t complete, thus being extra cautious. Now facing this attack from the female sword spirit, he stepped onto the Power of Wind and Cloud, taking a Free-Will Ascension Step, instantly moving to high altitude, evading her strike, then without hesitation deploying the Supreme Sword Dao, Heartless Dao!
To deal with spirit bodies, sword intent, sword thought, sword qi gathered into a sword spirit!
Only the Spirit Killing Sword proves most effective.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The sky was filled with spirit killing swords cascading down like a waterfall, densely packed and endless.

The female sword spirit was evidently skilled, capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with masters at the peak of the initial tier of Shattering, but facing Ding Ling’s move, she was left with no adequate response, soon pierced into a sieve by the Spirit Killing Sword.
Her spirit body slowly disintegrated into smoke and dispersed.
Leaving only a flickering spiritual light in the void.
Ding Ling reached out, grasping the spiritual light in his palm.
Whew!
The spiritual light instantly vanished into his body, and a familiar sensation emerged.

"Who are you?"
With her view of the domain crystal obstructed, the female sword spirit seemed agitated, suddenly let out a roar, and boom!
With an ethereal sound, the female sword spirit vanished, next moment forming into a shadow, gripping a sharp sword crafted from sword qi, attempting to stab Ding Ling in the back!
Ding Ling always remained in the forty-time amplification state, since despite his increased understanding and knowledge of the Sword Realm, it wasn’t complete, thus being extra cautious.

Now facing this attack from the female sword spirit, he stepped onto the Power of Wind and Cloud, taking a Free-Will Ascension Step, instantly moving to high altitude, evading her strike, then without hesitation deploying the Supreme Sword Dao, Heartless Dao!
To deal with spirit bodies, sword intent, sword thought, sword qi gathered into a sword spirit!
Only the Spirit Killing Sword proves most effective.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The sky was filled with spirit killing swords cascading down like a waterfall, densely packed and endless.

The female sword spirit was evidently skilled, capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with masters at the peak of the initial tier of Shattering, but facing Ding Ling’s move, she was left with no adequate response, soon pierced into a sieve by the Spirit Killing Sword.
Her spirit body slowly disintegrated into smoke and dispersed.
Leaving only a flickering spiritual light in the void.
Ding Ling reached out, grasping the spiritual light in his palm.
Whew!
The spiritual light instantly vanished into his body, and a familiar sensation emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 671: The Sword Skill of the Residual Spirit
paragraphs: Ding Ling quickly sensed a strange sword technique taking shape in his Meridian Dantian, and he felt it slightly.
The next moment.
[Shadow Stream Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.6]
This is a ’skill’ not inferior to Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship at all!
If cultivated to the extreme, it can hide the sword in the shadows, turning sword intent into shadows, and suddenly strike from behind!
It is an extremely suitable sword skill for assassins and spirit bodies!
Especially when used by a spirit body, it becomes unpredictable and free, impossible to defend against!

After all, the essence of a spirit body is formed from condensed sword souls, sword intents, sword thoughts, without a real physical body. If a sword spirit uses the Shadow Stream Swordsmanship, it can exert two hundred percent of its power.
"No wonder this female sword spirit could arrive second, she seems to be a powerful expert not weaker than the previous sword spirit."
Ding Ling frowned as he looked towards the Eight Directions Territory, faintly.
He could sense waves of strange spiritual light rushing towards his position rapidly.
As for this spiritual light.
Ding Ling was very familiar.
Because the essence of his sword spirit was precisely this kind of spiritual light gathered together!
"So many sword spirits!"
"It seems they are all here to grab the Domain Crystal. I didn’t expect this Domain Crystal to be so tempting to sword spirits!"
Ding Ling pondered slightly, and immediately understood:

"It seems that quite a few sword spirits are hidden in the Sword Realm. But surely most of them do not have Domain Crystals, and those without Crystals would naturally want to seize one, because with a Crystal, one can dominate a region, gain unlimited support from the Sword Realm, and become extremely powerful, not only difficult to kill, but also with incredibly strong self-healing capabilities!"
This is also what happened to Jian Yue when he encountered Ding Ling.
His spirit body was half shattered by the library.
If it were someone else.
In this Sword Realm, especially the small area where Jian Yue was, killing him would be as difficult as climbing to the sky!
"I absolutely cannot let other sword spirits have this Crystal."
Ding Ling stood before his sword spirit, feeling the Domain Crystal already one-third refined, and he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Not too slow.
If too slow.
The endless sword spirits, sword thoughts, sword souls would be attracted; he wasn’t afraid, but he feared causing turmoil in the Sword Realm, which might trigger other chain reactions.
After all, he didn’t know how big the Sword Realm was, or if there were stronger beings behind this.
Reading comics, the Sword Realm strong have Mo Kui from the Sword Pool, Jian Yue from Sword Mountain, etc.
But who can say for sure whether there are other powerful figures in the Sword Realm comparable to these two?
Especially when players intrude, plot breaks down, various plot characters make an appearance ahead of time; who can guarantee that the Sword Realm won’t experience some subtle changes?
Swish, swish, swish!
Sure enough, Ding Ling had just stood in front of his sword spirit when the sound of whistling wind arose.
The next moment.
Six sword spirits stood before Ding Ling!
The forms of these six sword spirits were even more faded.
Not only were their faces unrecognizable, but even their bodies were difficult to discern as male or female.
Clearly, these six sword spirits were weaker!
But even so, they still came to seize the Domain Crystal, indicating their minds were unclear, with only a vague consciousness!
Ding Ling thought this but still tried asking tentatively:
"May I ask for your names? From which esteemed sect?"
No response.
Their reply to Ding Ling was a lightning-fast attack!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
The six moved in unison, executing a sword array!

As this sword array appeared, accompanied by dragon roars, a pure sword intent and sword qi-formed Cyan Dragon manifested from the array, its Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing sweeping toward Ding Ling’s head.
"They really have no awareness, do they?"

"No wonder I sensed the loneliness from Jian Yue’s broken memories. It seems these sword spirits are all broken, memoryless, cold-blooded, manic pure spirits! Jian Yue couldn’t communicate with these spirits? Or maybe Jian Yue simply didn’t want to communicate too much with other spirits, thinking himself a person, different from spirits?"
The specifics.
Are hard to know.
After all, Jian Yue is already dead.
Ding Ling watched the six spirits attacking him, imitating their moves, fortifying his Spirit Killing Sword forty times, boom!
After a series of bubble-like popping sounds.
A full six streaks of light, like comet tails, floated unsteadily in the void.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill to grab them one by one.
Whish, whish!
In the blink of an eye, these lights all merged into his body’s meridians.
One sword technique after another was mastered by Ding Ling at that moment.
The next moment.
[Cyan Dragon Demon-Slaying Sword Technique Full Level!]
[Agility +0.5]
[Six Harmonies Sword Array Full Level!]
[Agility +0.5]
A total of two skills.
Each close to Shattering Level techniques.
Though lesser than Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship, Shadow Stream Swordsmanship in power.
When combined.
It is still no weaker than the Shadow Stream Swordsmanship level ’skill’!
Once the Cyan Dragon Demon-Slaying Sword Technique reaches full level, it can unleash a Cyan Dragon Sword Qi with one strike!
Coupled with the Six Harmonies Sword Array, the Cyan Dragon Sword Qi’s power is directly magnified six times! The power is imaginable.
But even so.
Facing a forty-fold enhanced Ding Ling, they were still defeated in seconds, with no ability to resist!
"The Six Harmonies Sword Array is both a sword array and a sword technique!"
After reaching full level of the Six Harmonies Sword Array.
Ding Ling thoroughly understood this.
This is an unparalleled six-in-one sword technique! Combining with array maneuvering to form the Six Harmonies Sword Array.

"Now I have two more extremely rare sword skills. And they are sword techniques unknown in the Wind and Cloud World. The Six Harmonies Swordsmanship, Six Harmonies Sword Array exist in the Wind and Cloud World, but their power is far inferior to what I’ve just obtained, obviously just sharing the same name only."
"I’ve read quite a few ancient books in the Wind and Cloud World. But seemingly none record the Cyan Dragon Demon-Slaying Sword Technique, it seems this sword technique has a very ancient history!"
While Ding Ling was deep in thought, another dozen sword spirits arrived!
They were even vaguer and dimmer than the previous six sword spirits who formed the Six Harmonies Sword Array, apparent only as humanoid shapes!
But without exception, they unanimously charged towards the Domain Crystal, showing how immense the Crystal’s allure and fortune were for them.
This confirms: they definitely sensed that this Crystal could quickly transform them, which is why they desperately, manically tried to seize it!
Ding Ling couldn’t possibly hand over such a treasure to some unknown spirit bodies.
Immediately, he activated the Spirit Killing Sword.
Bam, bam!
Like piercing through bubbles, a bam, bam sounded.
Over a dozen streaks of light flickered unsteadily in the void.
Ding Ling used a grabbing technique, securing each one in his palm.
A familiar rush of exhilaration swept over him.
Soon.
Ding Ling mastered one sword skill after another.
[Dustfall Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.5]
[Wind-Beating Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.5]
[Soul-Seeking Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.5]
A full thirteen top-tier sword techniques.
Each no weaker than the Cyan Dragon Demon-Slaying Sword Technique.
All extremely rare skills!

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 672: Residual Thought of the Wudang Disciple
paragraphs: Mastering thirteen almost Shattering Level sword skills in one breath.
Ding Ling’s agility skyrocketed.
His progress had already reached: 116.7 points.
He had made a leap of over a dozen points in a short time.
This speed was extremely terrifying.
It even gave Ding Ling a slight sense of hunger.

Fortunately, with the full mastery of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, the rapid advancement of the War God Technique, and the surge of True Qi, Ding Ling’s ability to resist hunger had undergone a tremendous change.
Even in an extremely hungry state now, he couldn’t possibly pass out from hunger.
After all, if his arms and legs could regenerate instantly when chopped off, what was mere hunger compared to that?
"More and more Sword Spirits are coming."
Ding Ling gazed around and saw more and more spiritual light rushing in from all directions like a tide.
Some of these spiritual lights were no longer human-shaped, containing only a trace of pure Sword Thought!

This Sword Thought perhaps was a person’s obsession transformed after their death, unable to become Sword Spirits, leaving only a bit of Sword Thought. However, even so, it crazily pounced towards the Domain Crystal.
It was evident that Domain Crystals were incomparable Treasures of Heaven and Earth for Sword Thought!
"Come as many as you want, kill as many as you can."
Ding Ling would not show mercy to these more shattered spirits, Sword Souls, or Sword Thoughts, just as he wouldn’t hesitate to kill the humanoid Sword Spirits.
Clang! Clang! Clang!

This time, hundreds of Sword Spirits attacked. They did not form a Sword Array but went about their individual attacks, unleashing killing moves at Ding Ling. For a moment, various Sword Intents and Sword Qi crisscrossed in the void, forming a dense Sword Sea that surged toward Ding Ling like a Mountain Shifting and Sea Overturning force.
Ding Ling activated his Defense Shield, amplifying himself forty times. With a clear shout, the Spirit Killing Sword exploded once more, whoosh whoosh!
Supported by Sword Spirits, the Spirit Killing Sword accelerated, becoming more fierce and flexible, maneuvering with complete freedom in the void!
Amid the whooshing, the Spirit Killing Sword, like a flash of lightning, pierced through the Void Nether, and in the next instant, puffs and puffs!
Various Residual Spirits, Residual Souls, and Residual Thoughts were entirely shattered.
Subsequently, in the void appeared trails of spiritual light like meteor tails!
Some of the spiritual light had already dimmed to the point of being barely visible to the naked eye.
But what kind of person was Ding Ling?
No matter how faint the spiritual light was, supported by Sword Spirits, he could perceive it with absolute clarity.
Especially since the Domain Crystal being devoured and refined by the Sword Spirit was increasing, the power of this support was growing stronger.
Thus, Ding Ling sensed them clearly and captured them more precisely!
His actions were lightning-fast.
Amid the swishing sounds, hundreds of spiritual lights were grasped one by one into his palm, integrated into his meridians, and then sensed by Ding Ling.
Subsequently...
[Coiling Finger Soft Sword Technique Full Level!]
[Yin Yang Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Tai Chi Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.4]
[Thunderbolt Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Agility +0.1]
Even though there were hundreds of spiritual lights.
There were at least dozens of repeated sword techniques.
Therefore, the number of sword techniques Ding Ling finally obtained was only around 50.
But even so, it was quite remarkable.
However, most of these sword techniques only increased points by 0.1.
There were quite a few that didn’t even add points.
The reason was that the levels of these sword techniques weren’t high. They could only be considered Innate Level sword skills.
And Innate Level sword skills no longer had any effect on Ding Ling’s Attribute Points.
Regarding this.

Ding Ling didn’t think much of it. To him, this unexpected battle with the Sword Spirits and Residual Spirits, and the acquisition of so many sword techniques was already a rare opportunity that couldn’t be expected to be perfect in every aspect.

"But Coiling Finger Soft Sword Technique, Yin Yang Swordsmanship, Tai Chi Swordsmanship, aren’t these the sword techniques of the Wudang Sect? Could it be that disciples of the Wudang Sect from other worlds came to the Wind and Cloud World, and after being killed, their Residual Thoughts inadvertently entered this Sword Realm?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he could indeed confirm that among the recently slain group of spirits formed from shattered obsessions, many seemed to have been born not long ago.
The reason he knew this.
Was because as Ding Ling continued to refine the Domain Crystal, his sense of the spirits in the Sword Realm became increasingly acute.
Especially as Ding Ling’s own Sword Spirit was also born not long ago, naturally making his perception of newly born spirits exceptionally vivid.
"It seems that great changes are indeed occurring in the Sword Realm, unbeknownst to us."
More and more Ascenders from other worlds were flooding into the Wind and Cloud World.
And in such a High Martial World.
Grandmaster Level battles occurred frequently.
Shattering Level battles occasionally erupted as well!

First-class Experts and Innate Experts from the Lower Realm, encountering such battles, the shockwaves alone would be enough to kill them. If they were deliberately targeted by people from Japan, it would surely result in large-scale casualties.

Among the hundred Residual Spirits just now, there might have been a group transformed from the Posthumous Will of deceased Wudang Sect Experts who had ascended. It’s just unknown who these Wudang Sect Experts were.
"What a pity."
Ding Ling shook his head, not thinking too much about it.

After the death of these Wudang Sect Experts, the Sword Thought Sword Intent they wielded would fall into the Sword Realm along with their Posthumous Will, and in time, they would certainly become experts similar to Jian Yue. But they recklessly came to snatch his Domain Crystal, so who could they blame for their own deaths?
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Again came a group of spirits so shattered they couldn’t be seen or sensed.
One by one, they roared towards Ding Ling, with an earth-shattering aura, but were extremely weak.

Ding Ling let out a cold snort, not amplifying his Spirit Killing Sword, merely maneuvering the ordinary Spirit Killing Sword freely through the void, puff puff! Hundreds of spirits were pierced and shattered.
The lingering spiritual lights they left behind were so dim that even Shattering Level experts would find it hard to detect!
Only a Sword Spirit gradually attuned to the Domain Crystal could sense them.
And Ding Ling was one with the Sword Spirit.
He naturally could sense them too.
He executed Dragon Capturing Skill, continually grabbing into the void.
He had a strong premonition.
If grabbed too slowly.
These spiritual lights, undetectable by Shattering Level experts, would surely dissipate entirely, merging into the Sword Realm, enhancing its foundational strength.
How could Ding Ling leave such benefits to the Sword Realm?
Whoosh whoosh!
The spiritual lights, invisible to the naked eye and scarcely perceivable, were caught in his palm, then integrated into his body and rapidly perceived by him.
In just an instant.
[Demon-subduing Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Rouyun Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Diancang Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Shangqing Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Agility +0.3]
As many as three hundred sword techniques mastered to Full Level.
The depth of Ding Ling’s Sword Dao foundation grew with astonishing speed.
Not only that.
As various sword techniques mastered to Full Level, various pure Sword Intents emerged on Ding Ling’s body.
Weaker sword techniques, weaker Sword Intent.
But the aggregation of hundreds of extremely weak Sword Intents was already quite remarkable!
Not to mention that among these weaker sword techniques were quite a few extraordinary sword skills.
This not only caused Ding Ling’s Attribute Points to soar considerably.
But his embodiment of Sword Intent was becoming more and more powerful!
