Only a Sword Spirit gradually attuned to the Domain Crystal could sense them.
And Ding Ling was one with the Sword Spirit.
He naturally could sense them too.
He executed Dragon Capturing Skill, continually grabbing into the void.
He had a strong premonition.
If grabbed too slowly.
These spiritual lights, undetectable by Shattering Level experts, would surely dissipate entirely, merging into the Sword Realm, enhancing its foundational strength.
How could Ding Ling leave such benefits to the Sword Realm?
Whoosh whoosh!
The spiritual lights, invisible to the naked eye and scarcely perceivable, were caught in his palm, then integrated into his body and rapidly perceived by him.
In just an instant.
[Demon-subduing Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Rouyun Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Diancang Swordsmanship Full Level!]
[Shangqing Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Agility +0.3]
As many as three hundred sword techniques mastered to Full Level.
The depth of Ding Ling’s Sword Dao foundation grew with astonishing speed.
Not only that.
As various sword techniques mastered to Full Level, various pure Sword Intents emerged on Ding Ling’s body.
Weaker sword techniques, weaker Sword Intent.
But the aggregation of hundreds of extremely weak Sword Intents was already quite remarkable!
Not to mention that among these weaker sword techniques were quite a few extraordinary sword skills.
This not only caused Ding Ling’s Attribute Points to soar considerably.
But his embodiment of Sword Intent was becoming more and more powerful!

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 673: Zhang Sanfeng
paragraphs: And the enhancement of Sword Intent causes the Sword Spirit to become stronger as well.
The speed of absorbing and refining the Domain Crystal also becomes faster.
The more Domain Crystals are refined, the stronger the Sword Spirit becomes, which in turn nourishes Ding Ling, the true self.
This is a positive cycle!
Within this cycle.
Ding Ling is rapidly growing stronger at an extremely terrifying and fearsome speed!
[Agility: 126.9]
Many Sword Skills do not provide Attribute Points, but even so, agility has increased by more than ten points, shooting up to 126.9.
Hoo hoo!
Ding Ling channels all Sword Intent into the Supreme Sword Dao!
Causing the Supreme Sword Intent to transform and elevate continuously upon absorbing these Sword Intents!
Hundreds of different Sword Intents!
The Supreme Sword Intent, having absorbed so many Sword Intents, once again experienced a subtle change mysteriously, becoming increasingly sharp and versatile!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Another wave of Residual Spirits arrives.
Ding Ling unleashes the Heartless Dao within the Supreme Sword Dao mercilessly to eradicate them!
He felt a bit fortunate to have learned such a Spiritual Killing Technique; otherwise, faced with such Sword Spirits, he would be at a loss.
[Silver Ring Swordmanship Full Level]
[Luan Cang Swordmanship Full Level]
[Agility +0.4]
[Moluo Swordmanship Full Level]
[Ruyi Swordmanship Full Level]
This time, thousands of Residual Spirits and Residual Thoughts were eradicated.
He obtained more than two thousand Sword Skills.
Among them was the Luan Cang Sword Skill, a Grandmaster Peak Level skill!
There were also Innate Level Sword Skills like the Moluo Swordmanship.
Yet, the vast majority were First-class, Innate Level Sword Skills that couldn’t provide Attribute Points.
But from the thousands.
Still, there were quite a number of Grandmaster Level and above Sword Skills.
[Agility +8.2]
[Agility: 135.1]
The rapid increase in agility is remarkable.
Ding Ling senses it.
Now, even without using any True Qi, Breathing Technique, Lightweight Skill, etc., he can become a person who chases the wind solely with pure agility!
"Is there finally none left?"
Perhaps they were all wiped out?
Or perhaps these Residual Spirits finally felt fear instinctively, knowing that their self-sacrifice behaviors were all leading to death and thus recoiled?
It’s hard to know the truth.
But Ding Ling truly did not see any Residual Spirits again.
He could no longer sense them.
Ding Ling stood by his own Sword Spirit and did not venture far.
Now is the crucial moment of the Sword Spirit refining the Domain Crystal, naturally, he couldn’t covet for these Sword Skills and leave the Sword Spirit.
"Three-fourths refined."
Ding Ling carefully senses.
’The remaining one-fourth is particularly difficult to refine, it should take about a day and a night.’
Ding Ling patiently waits.
He carefully senses the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body: 100%
Previously, it was 95%.
It’s unknown when the furnace body’s progress reached a pinnacle, condensed as if tangible like the furnace’s lid.
Thinking.

During this time he learned the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root, Iron Refining Hand, Five Thunders Transcendent Hand, Sword Thought Spirit Tempering Technique, Qiankun Qi Sword, Snow Blood Claw Internal and External Skills, Breaking Snow and Opening the Heavens, Vast Righteous Qi Zither Sound, etc., all without exception high-tier secret skills.
And now, within the Sword Realm, he obtained thousands of Sword Skills of various types.
Among them were Shattering Level skills!
And all these turned into nourishment for the Martial Arts Melting Furnace to elevate and manifest!
Making the furnace body condensed as if tangible.
Originally, the Martial Arts Melting Furnace’s three legs also began to manifest towards tangibility.
Current progress is: 5%.

"The entire Martial Arts Melting Furnace is composed of a lid, furnace body, and three legs. Now, both the lid and furnace body have already become tangible, incredibly powerful, if the three legs also successfully condense, then I can fuse all Martial Arts into one."
Ding Ling takes a deep breath.
He knows too many Martial Arts.
The path of Martial Dao is long and arduous.
If he can refine the essence from these Martial Arts and condense into a Secret Manual, it can be imagined how strong this manual would be.
Ding Ling looks at the Character Panel.
As he defeats Jian Yue and other Sword Spirits again.
Task 1 progress leaps forward considerably once more.
Task 2 progress remains at zero.
Evidently, the strongest of the Wind and Cloud Plane has not yet been defeated by him.
"Who exactly is this strongest?"
Ding Ling is puzzled.
But he doesn’t dwell on it, there will always be a way when the time comes.
His immediate priority is to grow stronger in the Sword Realm, allowing the Sword Spirit to transform and elevate to the level of Jian Yue!
Half a day later.
The refining progress of the Domain Crystal reaches 90%.
Besides Ding Ling, there is still not another person in his location.
The mountains, waters, Phoenix Pavilion Dragon Pavilion, flowers, trees, etc., are also fake!
Giving Ding Ling a very empty and lonely feeling.
Especially as the Sword Spirit becomes more in tune with this territory, Ding Ling’s perception and awareness become increasingly heightened.
Through the eyes of the Sword Spirit.
One look.

Where are the mountains and waters? Clearly, all are surging, vast Sword Intent, Sword Thought, spiritual and other invisible, unseeable material raging fiercely! Flowing towards the Ten Directions Realm!
This feeling is very strange.
Looking with human eyes, the mountains and waters seem distinct, magnificent.
Looking with the eyes of the Sword Spirit, there is no mountain, only endless Sword Thought, Sword Intent, swordsman’s spirit, etc.
And within these Sword Intent and spirit, are inscribed various Techniques and Laws!

These are the imprints left after the swordsman’s spirit has fallen, absorbed by the Sword Realm, leaving only imprints, while the true Techniques and Laws have been fully absorbed by the Sword Realm.
"Sword Realm."
Ding Ling raises an eyebrow.
He remembers after the Sword Saint died, the Sword Qi Space he condensed, that is, the Sword Heart Hell, was swallowed by the Sword Realm, acquiring all its creation.
"Thus it’s evident, this Sword Realm is also growing stronger mysteriously!"
’Especially as the Ascenders continuously fall, it’s fearful that these swordsmen among the Ascenders may unknowingly fall into this realm.’
Ding Ling ponders.
"Could this Sword Realm be alive?!"
He feels a chill.
And shakes his head:
"Probably not. If it were alive, falling into its mouth, wouldn’t I be doomed?"
Ding Ling silently waits.
And then a few hours later.
When the refining progress of the Domain Crystal reaches 97%.
A person walks over from Ding Ling’s left side.
He has a head full of white hair, dressed in a robe, strolling casually, resembling an Immortal taking a walk, exuding the ambiance of the Immortal Family.
Approaching closer.

Ding Ling sees more clearly, this person has an extraordinary visage, filled with Righteous Qi, a kindly face, eyes deep like holding stars and sea, embodying the demeanor of Immortal grace, leaving a memorable impression.
"I am Zhang Sanfeng, greetings young hero."
"Zhang Sanfeng?!"
Ding Ling is surprised, turning sideways:
"Are you truly Zhang Sanfeng?"
Zhang Sanfeng, who in the world doesn’t know?
His renowned name is like thunder reverberating in Ding Ling’s ears.
Yet always having no chance to meet.
Todays meeting.
Ding Ling is quite moved, not for any other reason, just because he has heard of this name since childhood. Seeing for the first time, his emotions inevitably fluctuate.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 674: The Enemy Strikes
paragraphs: "Correct."
Zhang Sanfeng nodded, stroked his beard, and said:
"I am indeed Zhang Sanfeng. What? Could it be that there’s another Zhang Sanfeng in this world?"
"There isn’t at the moment."
As soon as Ding Ling said this.
Zhang Sanfeng let out a sigh:
"If another Zhang Sanfeng truly appeared, how could I bear it."
As he spoke, his expression suddenly turned serious, and he said:
"Young Hero, I see a strong aura of life around you; you are not a spirit, right?"
"Correct."
"May I ask how you entered this world?"
"In combat with an opponent, I shattered the void and was drawn in by the endless suction of the Sword Realm into this world."
Zhang Sanfeng was moved:
"To be able to rip the void through combat, it seems the Young Hero’s power has already reached the Transformation Realm."
His spirit lifted slightly:
"I wonder, Young Hero, have you seen any other people?"
"I have only seen some Sword Spirits. I haven’t seen any people."
Ding Ling countered:
"I noticed you have a strong aura of life too, so I’m curious, how did you enter the Sword Realm?"
"I was transported to this world by a mysterious power."
Zhang Sanfeng said with a look of confusion:
"To this day, I find it utterly baffling. Who could possibly, without my slightest awareness, secretly transport me to such a peculiar realm?"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was moved, astounded:
"There’s even such a thing? I wonder how long Master has been in the Sword Realm?"
"The sun and moon of the Sword Realm are fake. I don’t know exactly how long it has been, just a vague feeling as if it might have been ten or so days."
"Ten days?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Could it be that the moment you ascended to this realm, you were transported here?"
"To be precise, I spent less than a day in this new world before being transported here."
Zhang Sanfeng seemed to fall into recollection:
"After coming here, I haven’t seen any living person. But I’ve encountered many spirits.
I tried communicating with these spirits several times, but I found they mostly seemed to have forgotten all matters of their past lives, acting in a confused daze, relying solely on instinct.
The spirits in the Sword Mountain and Sword Tower area are somewhat kinder, but if you offend them, they will still attack me fiercely.
The spirits in places like the Sword Pool and Sword Mud, however, are extremely aggressive!
I didn’t approach them, yet they would actively attack me, trying to possess or seize control of my body!
Fortunately, my Dao heart is resilient. No matter how these spirits coax, threat, or intimidate, they cannot frighten me."
Upon hearing this.

Ding Ling couldn’t help but scrutinize Zhang Sanfeng with the Eye of the Sword Spirit, noticing that his eyes were bright and spirited, his entire being exuding Sword Intent that soared to the sky, forming its own Tai Chi Trigram around him, continuously swirling around the vicinity of his Sea of Consciousness.
Any strange substance trying to get close to him would be naturally deflected by the Tai Chi Trigram!
Seeing this.
Ding Ling understood.
No wonder Zhang Sanfeng could avoid being possessed by spirits.
It turns out he had the Tai Chi Trigram protecting him.
However, that the Tai Chi Trigram has been cultivated to the Supreme Soul-Entering Realm is quite impressive! If not for this, even a legendary hero like Zhang Sanfeng might have met his demise here.
"It was only two days ago that I sensed a Wudang Sect disciple seemed to have fallen into this world, and I followed the vague traces to this place."
Zhang Sanfeng said this, looking towards Ding Ling:
"Young Hero, have you seen any Wudang Sect disciples, or spirits of them?"
Ding Ling was speechless, stunned.
But he still told the truth.
Facing a divine-level figure like Zhang Sanfeng, Ding Ling admired him too much to lie.
Of course, if Zhang Sanfeng had been aggressive or murderous towards him, Ding Ling would no longer respect him.
However.
Just as he thought.

Zhang Sanfeng, true to his reputation as a great Grandmaster of later generations, was understanding, generous, compassionate, and righteous. Upon hearing Ding Ling’s words, his face showed sadness, and he sighed:
"Dust to dust, earth to earth. Perhaps this was their destiny. Since they made the first move, now that they have perished, I have nothing more to say."
He shook his head:
"It’s just a pity for my several disciples. I failed to protect them."
Ding Ling did not ask how many of the dead Wudang disciples were his disciples or who they were.
That would provoke Zhang Sanfeng.
It’s best not to do things that tear open someone’s scars.
After all, Ding Ling had already eradicated many of the Wudang spirits.
Rubbing salt in the wound after that would be excessive.
"I sense my disciples’ spirits not only here but also in another place.
Zhang Sanfeng cupped his hands towards Ding Ling and said, "Young Hero, I will not linger here any longer. If fate allows, we shall meet again."
Ding Ling cupped his hands in return and said:
"We shall meet again if fate allows."
Zhang Sanfeng turned and left.
Came suddenly.
Left decisively.
He was obviously worried the spirits of his other disciples might also be eradicated.
Ding Ling had been curious about where these Wudang disciples’ spirits came from. Now he knew. They all ascended to this world with Zhang Sanfeng.
It goes without saying.
These Wudang disciples, without Zhang Sanfeng’s protection, either offended some expert or, like Little Zhao and the others, encountered unforeseen disasters and were wiped out completely!

Their unresolved obsessions might have caused them to be drawn into the Sword Realm during some kind of transformation that even Ding Ling couldn’t comprehend, becoming residual spirits or residual thoughts.
Tat-tat!
In the faint sound of footsteps, Zhang Sanfeng grew further away.
Ding Ling did not stop him.
The two might never become friends, due to the destruction of the Wudang disciples’ residual spirits.
But Ding Ling did not regret.
Residual spirits attempted to seize the Domain Crystal and attack him; how could Ding Ling show mercy?
Yet, what Ding Ling did not expect was that Zhang Sanfeng would soon return, after being ’swept away’ a thousand feet by a terrible Sword Qi, landing not far from Ding Ling’s side.
"Young Hero, run quickly!"
Zhang Sanfeng, with blood at the corner of his mouth, was full of shock:
"I encountered a Demon Cultivator expert!"
"Hahaha..."
A familiar laugh echoed:
"Want to escape? It’s too late!"
The voice hadn’t even faded!
Bang!
A person, like a meteor falling to earth, drew a graceful arc through the sky, and with a thunderous crash, landed on the ground, both feet heavily stomping down!
The impact created a forceful gust, spreading an immense and vast might in all directions, causing buildings, plants, and trees to collapse in successive crashes wherever it went.
Ding Ling fixed his gaze and saw this person wearing clothes adorned with Eight Trigrams symbols, indeed an old acquaintance:
"Xiaao Aoshi!"
"Haha, Ding Ling. You are truly here. When Sword Scorpion mentioned you were here, I didn’t believe it, but now I’ve found you. You can’t escape death now."
Xiaao Aoshi, holding the Emperor’s Sword, surged with a sinister, toxic, and dark Source Power:
"Ding Ling, try my sword first!"
Xiaao Aoshi seemed to see what Ding Ling was protecting.

A person, like a meteor falling to earth, drew a graceful arc through the sky, and with a thunderous crash, landed on the ground, both feet heavily stomping down!
The impact created a forceful gust, spreading an immense and vast might in all directions, causing buildings, plants, and trees to collapse in successive crashes wherever it went.
Ding Ling fixed his gaze and saw this person wearing clothes adorned with Eight Trigrams symbols, indeed an old acquaintance:
"Xiaao Aoshi!"
"Haha, Ding Ling.
You are truly here.
When Sword Scorpion mentioned you were here, I didn’t believe it, but now I’ve found you.
You can’t escape death now."
Xiaao Aoshi, holding the Emperor’s Sword, surged with a sinister, toxic, and dark Source Power:
"Ding Ling, try my sword first!"
Xiaao Aoshi seemed to see what Ding Ling was protecting.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 675: Battle Again
paragraphs: Especially when he heard Sword Scorpion mention the Domain Crystal, Xiaao Aoshi’s eyes ignited with a burning, yearning light:
"Haha, truly heaven helps me! Ding Ling, prepare to die!"
Without another word, he thrust his sword towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling amplified himself forty-fold, the state of Sword Spirit empowering him, and swiftly drew the Xuanyuan Sword, thrusting it back towards Xiaao Aoshi with equal force.
Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Sword River Snow Surge!
As one sword pierced out, the Sword Qi split in two, one forming a turbulent river rushing north, the other transformed into an avalanche of snowflakes cascading from Tian Mountain!
Boom!
The two swords, pushed to their limits, brought the battle to an immediate white heat upon contact!
The slaughter decimated the mountains, waters, Phoenix Pavilion, and Dragon Lodge of the Ten Directions Realm!
Zhang Sanfeng was astonished, incredulous:
"That Demon Dao practitioner exudes a gloomy, sinister aura, sharing a body with Sword Scorpion, his power is indeed formidable. But this young Ding Ling is equally strong?! How is he doing this?!"
Zhang Sanfeng, though generous and composed like a sage, also had a resilient pride!
For he knew his talent was rarely matched by others!
Until now, only a handful like Zhang Wuji caught his eye.
Yet now Ding Ling’s cultivation was earth-shattering!
His age far less than his own!
How could Zhang Sanfeng not be shocked!
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The battle between Ding Ling and Xiaao Aoshi was indeed a clash of titans, akin to Mars colliding with Earth!
The two moved through the void at the speed of light, each sword moment striking with over a dozen blows towards the other!
Every sword strike was dazzling to an extreme! Each collision of the swords generated a massive energy shockwave, originating from them as the center!
Where the shockwave passed, Sword Mountain cracked, Sword River reversed, and towers and palaces crumbled and vanished amidst thunderous crashes!
The two combatants seemed like deities in a celestial duel!

Even with his divine sight, Zhang Sanfeng struggled to capture the nuances, only roughly tracking their movement trajectories, but unable to discern how Ding Ling and Xiaao Aoshi wielded their swords, nor how many strikes were executed in an instant!
He only saw the swords emitting world-shaking Sword Qi and Sword Intent, raining down like a storm of arrows upon each other!
"So powerful!"
Zhang Sanfeng’s heart trembled, not from fear, but from amazement, excitement, and the joy of glimpsing the path forward:
"Who would have thought there could be such an exalted Martial Arts Realm above that of a Grandmaster! Too terrifying!"
In his eyes, it seemed a Tai Chi diagram spun wildly, capturing the fragments of Shattering True Intent in the void.

"This realm... No wonder that Demon Dao master could nearly cut me down with one sword! Now in the Lower Realm, though unbeatable, here I am pathetically weak! Facing such masters, I truly feel like an ant."
Thinking of addressing Ding Ling, such a Great God, as ’Young Hero’ in an older, esteemed tone!
Zhang Sanfeng couldn’t help but flush with some embarrassment.
In his view.
Ding Ling, with such extraordinary cultivation, might indeed be some ageless Divine Level expert!
Boom boom boom!
The battle grew fiercer still.
The two were like meteors in a rage, each clash capable of demolishing vast stretches of Sword Mountain and Sword River!
Wherever they passed, it resembled a natural disaster sweeping through, everything in ruins!
Terror at its pinnacle!
"Ding Ling, how have you grown so strong in less than a day?!"
A voice roared across Heaven’s Edge.
Zhang Sanfeng heard it clearly, perplexed at heart, more powerful in one day?
I’ve been in the Sword Realm for over ten days, how is it I’ve not gained much strength? To what extent can one grow stronger in a day?
"Humph!"

The roar was met with a cold snort, imbued with the roar of lions, the growl of tigers, and the bark of dogs, as well as an eerie shriek from the underworld permeating it; with a single hum, the sound waves surged, sprawling clouds in the sky, even Zhang Sanfeng, far away, couldn’t help but shiver in his Divine Soul, eardrums painfully throbbing, increasingly shaken:
"Such power, it’s truly mind-boggling! And this isn’t even directed at me—if it was, one hum and I might disintegrate!"
Zhang Sanfeng grew more certain that Ding Ling was indeed an unparalleled master!
As he aged, he gradually delegated matters of the Wudang Sect to his disciples and retreated to the back mountains to nurture his spirit and ponder the principles of Martial Dao and Heavenly Dao!
Thus, he wasn’t very familiar with the rumors in the Jianghu.
Yet he had heard the name Ding Ling, though in every world there were many with the same name, not to mention many Ascenders gathered in this world, making shared names quite normal.
Therefore, Zhang Sanfeng hadn’t thought that this Ding Ling might be the same, yet was still deeply shocked and enthused by the battle between Ding Ling and Xiaao Aoshi.
He diligently watched the battle.
Even with internal injuries.
He wouldn’t miss this epic, world-shattering struggle!
Because he knew witnessing this battle would offer him unspeakable benefits, illuminating the path to his Martial Dao to the heavens!
Boom boom boom!
The battle between Ding Ling and Xiaao Aoshi endured for an entire hour!
The two fought until every tower and mountain for miles around was utterly destroyed.
If not for Ding Ling consciously guiding Xiaao Aoshi to fight elsewhere, Zhang Sanfeng would have been severely injured, possibly killed, by the battle’s aftershocks!
For Xiaao Aoshi’s strength had suddenly surged another level!
Working in tandem with the Emperor’s Sword’s manifold amplification!
The result was a realm beyond comprehension!

Had Ding Ling not been bolstered by the Sword Spirit state, making him extremely attuned with the thousand-mile radius around him, astronomically elevating his combat prowess, he might have truly been physically beaten to death by Xiaao Aoshi!
"Soon."
"The absorption of the Domain Crystal is already at 99%."
Once it reaches 100%.
It will signal the moment of Xiaao Aoshi’s death.

Ding Ling didn’t know what exactly had happened to Xiaao Aoshi, but the Sword Qi surrounding Xiaao Aoshi was imbued with terrifying malice and venomous miasma; fortunately, Ding Ling was Immune to All Poisons, otherwise, even if he wasn’t beaten to death, he would be poisoned.
"You truly have an Immune to All Poisons physique!"
After a fierce clash of swords with Ding Ling, Xiaao Aoshi’s form flew back a hundred meters, a dazzling light streak, and charged at Ding Ling again, his eyes like knives glaring viciously at him:
"But it doesn’t matter! With this next move, you will undoubtedly die!"
Roar!
With a roar from Xiaao Aoshi!
The attached Sword Scorpion emerged from his form, joining in a skyward bellow, and visibly from afar, numerous star points of flowing light were absorbed and drawn in.
Upon closer inspection.
These were peculiar creatures resembling swords and scorpions!

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 676: Twenty-One Swordsman Shadows
paragraphs: After these creatures were devoured by Xiaao Aoshi and the Sword Scorpion on him, the aura of both surged dramatically.
This surge of energy was injected into the Emperor’s Sword and amplified by dozens of times!
Became even more terrifying!
"Die!"
Xiaao Aoshi raised the sword in his hand high, like Pangu opening the heavens and earth, and slashed heavily towards Ding Ling!
As this sword was swung.
It was as if the Celestial River poured into the human realm, and the sword Qi and intent condensed into strips like bridges, stabilizing the four corners and locking down the Ten Directions Realm!
Then, a stronger sword, like the Five Elements Mountain pressing down from the heavens, crashed down towards Ding Ling.
It seemed to want to utterly annihilate Ding Ling right here.

Ding Ling’s pupils contracted tightly, such a sword tore open cracks in the Sword Realm, emitting unbearable creaking, cracking noises, such commotion, this sword probably has already reached the limit of what this Sword Realm can bear!
Too terrifying.
Ding Ling wasn’t confident he could block it unscathed!

Fortunately, he had mastered the War God Technique, and wasn’t afraid of losing an arm or a leg, so he didn’t hesitate to inject all his sword Qi and intent into the Xuanyuan Sword, delivering his strongest strike!
Supreme Sword Dao!
No-Self Dao!

With one sword strike, it was as if twenty-one people simultaneously appeared in the void, Celestial Destiny Sword Dao, Tai Chi Sword, Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root, Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship, Dugu Nine Swords, Holy Spirit Swordsmanship, Thunderbolt Swordsmanship, Shadow Stream Swordsmanship, Cyan Dragon Demon-Slaying Sword Technique, Dustfall Swordsmanship, Wind-Beating Swordsmanship, Soul-Seeking Swordsmanship, Shangqing Swordsmanship...
A full twenty-one top-tier sword skills, exquisitely displayed by Ding Ling, showcasing his legendary, supreme prowess as a swordsman!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
In the void, a figure was seen sometimes dancing a Tai Chi Sword Wheel, clashing with the strips and exploding;

Sometimes seen a person soaring upwards, wielding a sword with a Cyan Dragon, roaring as it collided with the descending Infinite Sword Mountain, entwining but ultimately being overwhelmed by Sword Mountain and suppressed!
Then seen a figure thrust a sword, releasing densely packed infinite sword Qi, flying across the sky, like nets and weaves, razor-sharp and wondrous.
Ding Ling alone, forcibly executed twenty-one kinds of Great Perfection sword skills, each executed with the grace of an antelope’s horns, perfected to the minutest detail!
Xiaao Aoshi got increasingly surprised the more he watched, not expecting in such a short time not seeing Ding Ling, he had practiced so many top-tier sword skills!
He was sure that a day ago, Ding Ling absolutely didn’t know so many sword skills, and didn’t have such overwhelming sword intent!
He had been puzzled by how Ding Ling’s Supreme Sword Intent grew so swiftly until Ding Ling unleashed twenty-one top-tier sword skills in one breath, he suddenly realized.
Ding Ling must have gained some fortune in the Sword Realm, learned numerous divine sword skills!

And Ding Ling, once learned, mastered these martial arts and sword skills to the level of Great Perfection, was causing Xiaao Aoshi to be jealous, envious, and resentful, and naturally, his apprehension and murderous intent towards Ding Ling grew even stronger.
"This fellow and I are already as incompatible as fire and water! If I don’t kill him, once he grows up, he will surely kill me! No matter what I say today, I must kill him here and now!"
Ah!
Xiaao Aoshi roared angrily, infusing his entire True Qi, sword Qi, and sword intent into the Emperor’s Sword, causing the power of the Emperor’s Sword to erupt more magnificently.
The Sword Scorpion on him was also continuously absorbing other Shadow Sword Scorpions coming in from the void!
Causing the power of the Emperor’s Sword to rise steadily!
Crunch!
Boom boom boom!

As the Sword Mountains and Sword Rivers unleashed by the Emperor’s Sword showed their might, Ding Ling’s twenty-one like immortal and saintly Sword God figures began to disintegrate and dissipate one by one.
First, the Thunderbolt Swordsmanship collapsed;
Then the Shangqing Swordsmanship, Dustfall Swordsmanship, Wind-Beating Swordsmanship, Soul-Seeking Swordsmanship, Tai Chi Swordsmanship, Shadow Stream Swordsmanship...
Twenty-one mighty Sword God figures.
Were suppressed and dissipated one after another in an extremely short time.
Zhang Sanfeng watched in amazement, his scalp tingling, murmured:

"Too strong! Whether Ding Ling or that Demon Dao master, both are too strong! Especially Ding Ling, this sword mastery has already reached the domain of Dao! Mysterious and profound, hard to fathom, or see through!"
"Yet such a Sword God-like figure like Ding Ling, is he really going to lose?!"
He watched as Ding Ling was struck by Xiaao Aoshi’s sword and fell from the void, landing heavily on the ground, his heart couldn’t help but shrink.
He was somewhat worried about Ding Ling.
Besides Ding Ling promptly pulling out a sword to fight with Xiaao Aoshi, saving his life;
There was also Ding Ling was seemingly aligned with him as someone of the righteous path, incompatible with the Demon Dao Xiaao Aoshi;
And such a demon giant, if not eliminated, the future of the Sword Realm, even Jiuzhou Territory, was enough to cause Zhang Sanfeng concern!
Zhang Sanfeng wasn’t afraid to die.

He was afraid that if Ding Ling and he died, no one in the Sword Realm or Jiuzhou could stop such a demonic and monstrous figure, then wouldn’t countless innocents, Ascenders, become slaves and puppets of this Demon Dao fiend?
Especially sensing that Ding Ling could also use the Tai Chi Sword, Zhang Sanfeng felt an inexplicable sense of closeness to Ding Ling.
For him to choose a side.
He would definitely choose Ding Ling!
So when he saw Ding Ling fall and lying on the ground, he couldn’t help but step out to confront Xiaao Aoshi!
Knowing full well he would die.
He still went forward without hesitation!

However, before he could shout and berate Xiaao Aoshi, Ding Ling suddenly flipped over and soared back into the sky, using the exact same move again! Instantly transforming into the twenty-one figures and engaged in battle with Xiaao Aoshi.
"Huh!"
Not only was Zhang Sanfeng startled, but Xiaao Aoshi was also shocked and incredulous:
"Your limbs have been shattered by my sword Qi! How come you now appear entirely unharmed?!"
He found it hard to believe.
Just moments ago.
With all his might.
Ding Ling was crushed.
Protective Gang Qi was pierced through!
All his limbs and organs were hit, amid crunching sounds, broken bones, severed hands, and feet became a reality.
Xiaao Aoshi was just about to breathe a sigh of relief, smile slightly, and retrieve the Emperor’s Sword when Ding Ling suddenly launched at him with unpredictably swift speed!
Xiaao Aoshi couldn’t get his sword out in time, caught off guard and struck fiercely!
Protective Gang Qi was pierced through.
His face and body were slashed with countless shocking wounds by the sword Qi.
"Ah!"
Xiaao Aoshi felt extreme pain all over his body, furious, roared, activating the Emperor’s Sword instantly once more, slashing again at Ding Ling:
"Die, die, die!"
Swish!
This time Ding Ling didn’t engage, but executed the Free-Will Ascension Step, like streams of light flexibly maneuvering in the void, dodging ceaselessly.
Just because he sensed that the refining of the Domain Crystal was about to succeed!
Once complete.
He would be the god within a thousand miles of this Sword Realm!
No matter how strong Xiaao Aoshi was, he would be annihilated!

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 677: Sword Spirit Evolution
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s killing intent and murderous desire towards Xiaao Aoshi!
It was unprecedented!
Ding Ling had never wanted to kill a person so much.
For the first time, he was injured like this by someone!
Fortunately, the War God Technique is indeed invincible; as long as the head remains and the True Qi is sufficient, he can instantly repair himself and return to peak condition!

Compared to the previous need for time to heal himself, with the War God Technique continuously devouring Spiritual Vitality, and the progress drastic, now even when heavily injured, Ding Ling can instantly use energy to heal himself!
However, the Spiritual Vitality in this Sword Realm is limited.
If Ding Ling exhausts his True Qi, he might also fall into a passive state, so temporarily evading is the best choice.
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
Xiaao Aoshi’s Emperor’s Sword continuously slashed and thrust, its magnificent and brilliant Sword Qi filling the entire sky.

This time, Ding Ling was prepared, fortifying himself with Sword Spirit status, weaving through the dense Sword Qi with ease, narrowly dodging time and again the Sword Qi that could cleave the Sword Realm.
The Sword Spirit’s refinement of the Domain Crystal had reached 99.9%.
It was becoming increasingly compatible with this domain.
Allowing Ding Ling, by using the Eye of the Sword Spirit, to analyze the tiny flaws in the Emperor’s Sword Qi and then pierce through them without harm.

"As expected of the Domain Crystal. Within this domain, no matter how perfect or powerful the Sword Intent and Sword Qi may be, there will always be flaws, which I can discern and resolve. No wonder no matter how I attack Jian Yue, he quickly comes up with a solution! It turns out it’s all thanks to the Domain Crystal!"
Ding Ling felt relieved.
Xiaao Aoshi, however, was full of disbelief:
"How is that possible?! How did you do it?!"
A moment ago, he had severely injured Ding Ling.
Not much time had passed.
Yet Ding Ling seemed like a wisp of wind, moving freely within the endless Emperor’s Sword Intent and Sword Qi?!
"Argh!"

Xiaao Aoshi roared in fury, wildly stabbing and slashing towards Ding Ling! However, it was in vain. No matter how sharp, fierce, or boundless Xiaao Aoshi’s Emperor’s Sword Qi was, Ding Ling was like a leaf in the storm, drifting with the wind and waves, unharmed!
"Damn it!"
Xiaao Aoshi suddenly bent his body and rushed towards Zhang Sanfeng and the Sword Spirit, aiming to solve them since he couldn’t deal with Ding Ling, and seize the Domain Crystal!
Ding Ling frowned. Helplessly, he could only charge back into confrontation with Xiaao Aoshi!
"Hahaha..."
Xiaao Aoshi laughed heartily:
"Let’s see how you dodge this time!"
Xiaao Aoshi’s understanding of the Domain Crystal was limited.

He only knew from the intermittent consciousness transmitted by the Sword Scorpion that the Domain Crystal could condense a self-sword spirit and multiply one’s Sword Intent and Sword Qi tenfold or a hundredfold!
For him, it was undoubtedly an enticing aspect.
Killing Ding Ling to seize this treasure had naturally become his immediate goal.
Boom!
Boom, boom, boom!

Ding Ling and Xiaao Aoshi clashed again, this time more fiercely. Ding Ling fell heavily from the sky with grave injuries, but then perfectly healed himself, once more transforming into a stream of light that shot upwards to violently collide with Xiaao Aoshi in the void.
Zhang Sanfeng watched, dazzled and overwhelmed, as the tumult in his Heart Lake never ceased from start to finish.
Swish!
When the Domain Crystal was not fully refined, it was a brilliant and magnificent crystal.
Therefore, besides Ding Ling, no one else knew the progress of the Domain Crystal’s refinement. If Xiaao Aoshi knew, he would surely be even more frantic.
And now, after complete refinement, the Domain Crystal turned into a Spiritual Light, swooshing entirely into the Sword Spirit’s Dantian position.
Hoo hoo!
The compatibility between the Sword Spirit and the Domain Crystal instantly reached one hundred percent!
Then, as the Sword Spirit inhaled, Spiritual Light from all directions surged and was absorbed entirely, instantly condensing the Sword Spirit’s initial form more than double!
With one leap, he moved ten miles away, and with another inhalation, the Spiritual Light within a ten-mile radius was absorbed once more.
Like this, repeatedly.
The Sword Spirit had evolved to a Middle Tier Sword Spirit, still far from Jian Yue’s perfect form, but the recent progress occurred in just a few breaths!
In those few breaths.
The Sword Spirit’s form leaped to a higher stage, saving countless years of Kung Fu. What an astounding opportunity!
Zhang Sanfeng was awestruck as it was the first time he witnessed such an evolution of the Sword Spirit!
Xiaao Aoshi was shocked, then jealousy, anger, envy, and restlessness surged together in his heart. Seeing that killing Ding Ling quickly was impossible, he turned to charge towards the Sword Spirit.
He was full of regret.
Had he known the Sword Spirit was close to refining the Domain Crystal, he wouldn’t have been solely focused on killing Ding Ling first.
Alas.
Now it was too late for regret.
At this moment, the Sword Spirit had become a god within a thousand-mile radius!
He could gather and disperse at will, dissipating as desired!
Within this domain, unless there were exceptionally special treasures capable of incinerating ’Spirit’, no one could kill him!
Ding Ling was aware of this.
So he no longer tried to stop Xiaao Aoshi and instead began to unify his Heart and Spirit with the Sword Spirit, controlling the Sword Spirit to kill enemies.
Swish!
The Sword Spirit became a god within this domain! He charged towards Xiaao Aoshi like a beam of light!
Xiaao Aoshi wielded his sword against the Sword Spirit, with Sword Qi surging like a sea and Sword Intent condensed like a mountain, as if to overturn and crush the Sword Spirit!

However, the Sword Spirit’s body transformed into numerous points of light in an instant, and then all the points of light, like stars descending, shot towards Xiaao Aoshi’s body at an even faster speed.
In just a moment, boom! Countless points of light crashed into Xiaao Aoshi’s shell, bursting into his Sea of Consciousness!
The dense points of light gathered and dispersed at will.
They reappeared in the Sea of Consciousness in human form.
With a finger as sword.
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root unleashed!
The sword momentum, like a web like weaving, suppressed a Sword Scorpion with the power of the domain and then broke it down, shattered it into endless Spiritual Light.
The Sword Spirit opened his mouth and swallowed.
After devouring the Sword Scorpion’s Spiritual Light.
The Sword Spirit instantly grew stronger, reaching a High Tier Sword Spirit form.
Not only becoming stronger, but the degree of body condensation had reached the level of a True Person, with skin and eyes shining brilliantly, like azure sky and spiritual jade!
After devouring this Sword Scorpion.
The Sword Spirit instantly mastered all the mysteries of the Sword Scorpion.
Coming to a realization.

This Sword Scorpion was originally the leader of a Sword Scorpion clan in the Sword Realm’s Sword Pool area, commanding millions of ordinary Sword Scorpions, admiring Xiaao Aoshi’s talents and demon nature.
It attached to Xiaao Aoshi, hoping to assist both him and itself, to evolve and transcend once more.
Therefore, the Sword Scorpion utilized Xiaao Aoshi to come to this Sword Mountain area and found the Domain Crystal!
"I see."
The Sword Spirit’s eyes glinted with sudden understanding.
Then.
He pointed towards the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 678: Western Realm
paragraphs: Boom!
In an instant, boundless Vigorous Qi was unleashed, shattering the defense shield of Xiaao Aoshi’s Only Mind Sword Intent.
"How can this be?!"
Xiaao Aoshi felt as if he had been struck by lightning, his mind buzzing as if hammered by a giant sledge. He roared:
"Get out here!"
He activated his Heart Sword!
Using the Emperor’s Sword to amplify his power, he formed defense shields within his Sea of Consciousness.
But it was all in vain.
The Sword Spirit strolled through the Sea of Consciousness, flicked a finger, and with a flash of sword light, the defense shield shattered!
"This feeling?!"
Xiaao Aoshi was terrified, trembling, incredulous:
"Could this be the power of the Domain Crystal?"
At that moment, he seemed to have an epiphany.

It was because he sensed that the Sword Spirit’s Sword Qi seemed to naturally contain a domain, holding boundless, infinite, limitless intent! With one sword, it seemed to bring down the entire Sword Realm, making it completely unavoidable and inescapable, only to be passively attacked!
"Too strong."
Ding Ling, controlling the body of the Sword Spirit, couldn’t help but sigh inwardly as he maneuvered it.
He finally understood.
Jian Yue never intended to truly fight him from the start, his goal might really be as he claimed, to take over Ding Ling! Therefore, he was unwilling to damage Ding Ling’s perfect young body!
"If not for the library, I might already be dead."
Ding Ling felt a lingering fear.
The power of the Domain Crystal was beyond imagination.

Even though Jian Yue had much of his spirit body shattered by the library, and his consciousness became somewhat muddled, once he escaped the Sea of Consciousness and absorbed the Spiritual Light from all directions, his shattered spirit body quickly regenerated visibly.
If Ding Ling hadn’t possessed a Fire Finger capable of burning spirit bodies at that time,
Jian Yue might have regenerated again!
If another battle ensued, it would be hard to tell who would win!
Thinking of this,
Ding Ling commanded the Sword Spirit, pointing another finger toward the depths of the Sea of Consciousness!
Clang!
A Sword River surged forth at the flick of a finger, destroying everything in its path.
The Sea of Consciousness shattered like glass falling to the ground, cracking and breaking into pieces.

Ding Ling saw a consciousness body resembling Xiaao Aoshi emerging from the depths of the Sea of Consciousness, clawing and roaring towards the Sword Spirit, but it was soon pierced into a sieve by the surging Sword River. As the Sea of Consciousness collapsed, it completely perished and vanished.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidating Xiaao Aoshi.]
[Note: Xiaao Aoshi, who obtained the Emperor’s Sword, amplified his Sword Intent and Sword Qi fifty times, becoming incredibly powerful, yet you still managed to block him, fighting to a standstill!
His heart trembled, unable to imagine how someone so young could possess so many earth-shattering techniques.

Upon entering the Sword Realm, all of his Evil and Demonic Thoughts were admired by the Spiritual Objects from the Sword Pool and Sword Mud. Eventually, the Sword Scorpion Leader defeated other competitors and attached itself to Xiaao Aoshi, forming a temporary alliance with him.
With the Sword Scorpion’s help, Xiaao Aoshi’s combat power skyrocketed again! He came this time full of confidence.
Only to suffer a brutal defeat! Even losing his life for it! Before dying, he wondered if his big brother and father would avenge him.]
Would Xiaao Aoshi’s big brother, the Great Demon God, and his father Xiaao Sanxiaao?
Ding Ling thought for a moment but hesitated not in the least, continuing to obliterate Xiaao Aoshi’s Sea of Consciousness.
He wanted Xiaao Aoshi to be utterly destroyed, his form and spirit annihilated, never to reincarnate!
This Sword Realm could absorb Sword Thoughts and Sword Souls to form Sword Spirits.
Ding Ling did not want even a shred of Xiaao Aoshi’s obsession remaining, allowing him to survive and develop in the Sword Realm.
Therefore,
He chose to completely destroy Xiaao Aoshi’s soul and thoughts!
When the Sea of Consciousness crumbled into nothingness,
The Sword Spirit emerged from Xiaao Aoshi’s shell.
Ding Ling casually pointed a finger.
The Sword Spirit immediately darted into Ding Ling’s body like lightning.
The Sword Spirit entered his body.
Enhancing himself.
Boom!

An intense, dazzling astonishing Sword Intent erupted from Ding Ling’s body! This Sword Intent pierced through the Sword Realm and reached Jiuzhou, drawing the attention of the experts across Jiuzhou Land.
"What is that?!"

Xiong Ba, Child Emperor, and co. had established a small force after arriving in the Western Realm. Xiong Ba wouldn’t return to the Central Plains until he mastered the Great Perfection of the Three-in-One Essence Qi. Unexpectedly, they saw an awe-inspiring Sword Qi flash across the northeastern sky even in this remote place!
That Sword Qi was shining at its utmost brilliance!
It even dyed the entire sky in a golden hue!
It was the ultimate, supreme Sword Qi!
It seemed like a Sword God overlooking mortals was drawing a sword, its edge sharp enough to pierce through Jiuzhou Land!
"Unbelievable!"
Xiong Ba was shocked, terrified, trembling:
"I thought encountering the likes of Ding Ling and the Ice Emperor in Lingyun Cave was extreme enough, but now there’s an even more outrageously divine being!"
Though Xiong Ba was in seclusion.
With Child Emperor and others assisting, and having established a small force, he wasn’t completely cut off from the world.
He naturally knew about Youruo, Nie Feng, and the matters of the Ice Emperor and Ding Ling in Lingyun Cave.
After all, after Ding Ling’s battle with Emperor Shitian broke out,
coupled with the chaos spread by players,
various versions circulated in Jianghu.
The one saying Ding Ling killed the Ice Emperor and the Divine General was the most widespread.
As for Ding Ling, Xiong Ba admired him more and more. He even wished to marry Youruo to Ding Ling, hoping with Ding Ling as an ally, the Jiuzhou Jianghu would be under his control?

But since Ding Ling declared himself Emperor of Jiuzhou, Xiong Ba abandoned the idea of marrying off his daughter. He even sent a Pigeon Post to the World Association, asking Youruo to come to the Western Realm, but Youruo ignored him, focusing solely on helping Nie Feng conquer the world for Ding Ling, leaving Xiong Ba trembling with rage. But since she was his daughter, he couldn’t possibly quarrel with Youruo or kill her, could he?
Thus, he blamed all his woes on Ding Ling and swore to master the Three-in-One Essence Qi and take revenge in the Central Plains. He didn’t expect to witness such scenes at this moment.
"The world is becoming less and less understandable."
Xiong Ba murmured in confusion:
"Even if I reach the Great Perfection of the Three-in-One Essence Qi, can I really dominate Jianghu?"
"Gang Leader, if we could invite the former Gang Leader back, I believe there would be very few who could oppose us."
Xiong Ba’s father, the Purple-clothed Boss, was well-known among those interested in Jianghu.
Child Emperor was no exception.
It was precisely because of the Purple-clothed Boss’s presence that Child Emperor treated Xiong Ba with more respect.
"My father..."
Xiong Ba’s expression turned somewhat unnatural, glossing over the issue, simply saying:

"Recently, I seem to have sensed tremors in the Earth Realm here in the Western Realm. Initially, the tremor amplitude was small, but just now, it surged dramatically. I suspect it might be related to that Sword Qi we just witnessed."

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 679: Ten Thousand Dao Forest
paragraphs: Xiong Ba looked towards the direction of the land:
"I want to delve into the depths of the earth to see what’s there! If I can obtain any fortuitous encounters, my rise to power is not far off."
Xiong Ba felt that merely following the usual cultivation path,
would definitely lead to being eliminated by the world.
So he decided to take a different path.
Seize fortuitous encounters!
He had long noticed the unusualness of this Western Realm, and now with the land’s strange tremors resonating with that fleeting sword qi from the Celestial Extreme!
It further confirmed the divinity of this place!
How could Xiong Ba hesitate; he made a decisive decision and immediately went to the source of the tremors to explore.
Throughout Jiuzhou.
The appearance of this astonishing sword qi attracted the attention of many experts, causing them to emerge from seclusion.
As a result, the Jianghu became increasingly unpredictable, with constant conflicts.
Ding Ling knew nothing about this.
After the Sword Spirit possessed him.
The memories of the Sword Scorpion devoured by the Sword Spirit, including parts related to Xiaao Aoshi, transformed into streams of light rushing into his Sea of Consciousness.
In the next instant.
[Ten Thousand Dao Forest Inner Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Ten Thousand Dao Forest External Skill Heart Method Full Level]
[Agility +1.5]
The spiritual vitality within a hundred miles surged.
Transforming into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Soon after, a mysterious drop of True Water appeared within Ding Ling’s Dantian.
This True Water flickered unpredictably, presenting seven colors, seemingly like an ice-fire crystal, extremely divine.
"Is this the Ten Thousand Dao Forest?"
Ding Ling was moved.
With the Ten Thousand Dao Forest reaching full level,
Ding Ling finally realized the power of this cultivation technique.
This method transcends human nature, allowing one to control the human mind, and condense illusions.
Of course, this is just one of its effects.
Most importantly, this method can contain the Power of Heaven and Earth, allowing it to freely absorb various types of martial arts masterpieces, even those that are mutually repellent!
The key comprises eight pathways: Heaven, Earth, Strange, Righteous, Yin, Yang, Life, and Dissipation.
Once all pathways are mastered,
one can freely condense the obtained martial arts into one within the Ten Thousand Dao Forest.
And through Xiaao Aoshi’s partial memories.
Ding Ling mastered five paths in total: the Dao of the Strange and Mysterious, Dao of Guarding, Beast Heart Strong Dao, Emperor Sword Dao, Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao.
The Dao of the Strange and Mysterious allows one to induce illusions in opponents! Can construct many Illusion Realms using the mind!
Dao of Guarding: Able to sense any disturbance within ten feet.
Beast Heart Strong Dao: Stimulates the beast heart.
Emperor Sword Dao: Xiaao Aoshi’s lifelong sword skill, infused with Emperor’s Sword Qi.
Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao: Formed from the essence of Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities Demon Dao, can harness the power of wind, thunder, fire, and rain for one’s use.
In total, five paths.
Xiaao Aoshi’s strongest are the Dao of the Strange and Mysterious, Emperor Sword Dao, Dao of Guarding.

Regarding Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao, Xiaao Aoshi only partially mastered it, thus it couldn’t be genuinely utilized. Once fully mastered, one can naturally mobilize the forces of wind, thunder, fire, and rain from nature.
However, for Ding Ling,
he only needs the mantra; any Dao, technique, or skill reaches full level by just looking once.
Therefore, the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao that Xiaao Aoshi only initially mastered, he mastered to full level in an instant!
"Could the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao possibly be the Great Demon God’s martial art, Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities?"
Ding Ling was thoughtful:

"It seems the parts of the mantra I obtained are most likely from Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities! It’s not surprising that Xiaao Aoshi and the Great Demon God, being brothers, would know each other’s techniques and mantras, but one’s energy is limited, so each of them cultivated one cultivation technique. Now it seems, even if each cultivated one, they couldn’t cultivate to Great Perfection."
Xiaao Aoshi’s Ten Thousand Dao Forest only reached a Perfect Realm.
It’s still a long way from Great Perfection.
The so-called Ten Thousand Dao is more of a misnomer, amounting to only five.
And Ding Ling integrated the heart method mantra of the Ten Thousand Dao Forest.

Summarized his entire learning into a few new pathways, and utilizing the ability of the Ten Thousand Dao Forest to govern myriad martial arts, made his somewhat chaotic Dantian instantly become peaceful and stable.

"As the inner power heart techniques I learn become more numerous and powerful, the harmonizing ability of techniques like Tai Chi Qi Force and Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic’s Qi Force is quickly becoming ineffective. If it truly fails, the future that awaits me could be cultivation deviation!"
"Fortunately, Ten Thousand Dao Forest appeared!"
Ten Thousand Dao Forest could be said to be a timely rain.

With it, there is no longer any need to worry about cultivation deviation, and martial arts heart methods can be learned freely, because once learned, will be governed and categorized as one of the paths within the Ten Thousand Dao Forest!
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[True Power Value: 79 points]
His strength increased once more.

This Ten Thousand Dao Forest is a technique that has reached a High Tier of Shattering, with an extremely high difficulty of cultivation, reaching an astonishing level! For ordinary people, let alone perfection, just reaching entry level could be considered a genius.
"No wonder the Great Demon God, and Xiaao Aoshi, the two brothers, only learned one method each."
Ding Ling was at ease.
He operated the heart method mantra of Ten Thousand Dao Forest, and the chaotic Dantian immediately centered with Ten Thousand Dao Forest, presenting a Tai Chi Bagua pattern.

The True Water, True Qi from the Eternal Youth Technique, Nine Yang Divine Skill, Demon Scripture, Black Tortoise True Skill, and other divine skills, transformed into streams of light, taking root like a great tree in one corner of the Eight Trigrams pattern!
As the Eight Trigrams pattern slowly rotated,
these full-level divine skills would operate automatically, absorbing and exhaling the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi!
"No wonder it’s the Ten Thousand Dao Forest!"
"This Dantian appears so much purer and more peaceful now."
Previously, it always seemed chaotic and unsettling.
Simply because Ding Ling also knew, without an absolute ’Harmonizer.’ This Dantian would explode sooner or later. Now there’s no need to worry about this issue.
"Unexpectedly, after devouring and refining the Domain Crystal, the Sword Spirit can even strip or devour the memory of a ’Spirit’ or a ’Consciousness Body.’ That’s incredibly strong."
Ding Ling recalled what Jian Yue said to him.
Only then did he understand why Jian Yue was so confident.
It turns out he was confident in stripping his memory!
"As long as within the domain of the Sword Spirit, as long as it’s not a divine object that transcends domains, then everything is like its plaything! It can be freely stripped and controlled by it!"
Ding Ling took out the Fire Finger, looking at the extremely dim flame on it, thinking:
"This Fire Finger is so impressive. It can burn the spirit of Jian Yue who held the Domain Crystal, which clearly indicates it’s a leftover from a Divine Being who has transcended domains!
Who knows where Emperor Shitian found it from?

And Emperor Shitian found it but couldn’t use it, instead sealed it with millennium cold jade. Perhaps it’s because the energy on this Fire Finger is too thin, needing to absorb the spirit of millennium cold jade to become perfect again?"
Ding Ling placed the Fire Finger back into the box of millennium cold jade.
Carefully sensed it.
Indeed.
The Fire Finger was truly absorbing a kind of ’spirit’ from the millennium cold jade.
This sort of spirit is hidden within the world, only found on divine objects, and the millennium cold jade, being an absolute spiritual treasure, naturally also possesses this spirit.

"It seems Emperor Shitian escaped too hastily, or perhaps he thought I wouldn’t be able to find this Fire Finger? Or he believes the energy sucked by this Fire Finger is not enough, is not yet perfect? Therefore, this box was left untouched?"

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 680: Breakthrough
paragraphs: No matter the reality.
The Fire Finger now belongs to Ding Ling.
Of course.
The flame on the Fire Finger is now extremely dim and thin, making it unusable again.
Ding Ling can only seal it once more, saving it for the future.
This Fire Finger is a component from a transcendent divine-level figure, extraordinary and sure to be of great use.
Additionally, Ding Ling feels an overwhelming and unusual power emanating from the Fire Finger.
This power is...
"Demon Power!"
"Could it be that this figure is a monster?"
Ding Ling was uncertain and confused.
But he did not delve deeper.
He found this Wind and Cloud World to be far more mysterious and terrifying than he had known.
Clearly.
Comics, novels, movies, and TV shows have not covered everyone, everything, and all items in the Wind and Cloud World.
"Xiaao Aoshi’s strongest is the Ten Thousand Dao Forest technique and the five related ’skills’."
Five Daos.
They are actually skills.
The strongest is the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao.
Ding Ling activated the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao with a wave of his hand, and a Flaming Celestial Flame immediately appeared in the sky.
This is the Mingyi Celestial Flame, a kind of Shadow Flame! It works best when used at night!
Then he swung his fist.
Boom! A bolt of lightning burst forth!
This is the Thunder Strike Fist!
With hands forming seals, not long after, a gust of wind appeared beside him. Ding Ling, his feet stepping on the wind, floated up and down in the void, like a Wind God.
This is the Nine Heavens Profound Wind!
Forming another seal!
A clear shout!
Raindrops made of gathered Spiritual Light fell with a crash.
This is Drizzling Frozen Rain!
"Wind, thunder, fire, and rain, the Power of Heaven and Earth! Truly formidable!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
This Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao has already reached the level of artistry!
Compared to the Daoist skills in the Cultivation World, it’s likely not much different!
Ding Ling did not expect the Sword Spirit to separate Xiaao Aoshi’s memory body from the shattered Sea of Consciousness so quickly.
All that can be said.
There’s no doubt about the Sword Spirit’s control over the Domain Crystal!
It’s really close to being divine!
"Although I didn’t get all of Xiaao Aoshi’s memories, just this small part about Martial Arts is enough."
If I had obtained all the memories.
Ding Ling might not withstand the impact of such memories!
After all, compared to the long-lived Xiaao Aoshi, Ding Ling is genuinely young, and his memories naturally are not as many.
"And what about the Sword Scorpion’s memories? Relatively speaking, they’re much simpler."
The Sword Scorpion is the Scorpion Leader.
It’s a Spiritual Object in the Sword Pool within this vast Sword Realm region.
Proficient in the Five Dao of Evil Poison Power, it can only live by consuming Evil Thoughts, Sword Thought Evils, and Demonic Thoughts.
Thus, it must possess a figure like Xiaao Aoshi; if it possesses someone pure without any Evil Thought, it might not survive.
Through the Sword Scorpion’s memory.
Ding Ling learned part of the secrets of the Sword Pool.
And how to reach the Sword Pool.
"Twelve Sword Stars?"
In the Sword Scorpion’s memory, there are many strong figures in the Sword Pool, including the famous top experts known as the Twelve Sword Stars, each capable of suppressing the Sword Scorpion.
This prevents the Sword Scorpion tribe from daring to approach the core of the Sword Pool, only migrating the tribe to the edge of the Sword Pool.
"The Twelve Sword Stars should be the creators and owners of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords."
One sword represents one Sword Star.
The Twelve Sword Stars.
Though seemingly scattered, they are one.
If the Twelve Sword Stars unite.
Within the Sword Pool, few can match them. It can be said that they are a rather formidable force.
"Within the Sword Realm, it seems there are many forces, large and small."
Like the Sword Scorpions.
There are tribes scattered in places like Sword Mud.

And because Evil Thoughts, Sword Thought Evils, and Demonic Thoughts are strongest in the Sword Pool, ’Spirits’ reside there, growing stronger faster. Thus, the Spirits of ’Sword Thought Evil’ all rush into the Sword Pool because it can quickly empower them!
Only the weak are driven to places like Sword Mud.
And Sword Mud is an endless, lifeless expanse of mud!
It’s filled with creatures like Sword Scorpions, Sword Turtles, Swordfish, and Sword Crocodiles.
Sword Mud and the Sword Pool are naturally opposed to and complementary with the Sword Mountain and Sword River.
Good and evil cannot coexist.
Yet one good and one evil form the indispensable forces of this Sword Realm. Neither can be missing, or the Sword Realm will collapse and be destroyed.
Above.
This is all that Ding Ling gleaned from the Sword Scorpion’s memory. It is little, but it has some value.
Ding Ling stepped forward and looked at Xiaao Aoshi.
With his consciousness body destroyed, he had become a living corpse.
Ding Ling placed his hand on Xiaao Aoshi, activating the Ten Thousand Dao Forest. Whoosh! A stream of immense Inner Power continually surged into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Quickly refined by the Ten Thousand Dao Forest for his own use.
[Inner Power Value +720]
In an instant.
Ding Ling’s Dantian gained two drops of Seven-Colored True Water from the Ten Thousand Dao Forest.
[True Power Value: 81]
Boom!
A more immense aura burst from Ding Ling’s body, seemingly uncontrollably, condensing into a giant Tai Chi Bagua diagram in the void.
The diagram manifested behind Ding Ling, making him appear transcendent, like an Immortal or saint!
Zhang Sanfeng was dumbfounded.
What did he see?!
The Demon Cultivator Expert Xiaao Aoshi, who had repeatedly severely injured Ding Ling!
Suddenly died, and moreover, all his learning seemingly got absorbed and mastered by Ding Ling!
"Ding Ling... How did he do it?! Just now, he wielded the power of wind, thunder, fire, and rain with his own strength. Is that even humanly possible?!"
Zhang Sanfeng felt his worldview was overturned:
"How is this different from being an Immortal?!"
He took a deep breath, his eyes burning brighter and hotter:
"It seems this world is far stronger than I had imagined! If I wish to progress to Ding Ling’s level of cultivation, it won’t be easy. But I’ve finally seen the path ahead! No regrets!"
Regarding Ding Ling.
Zhang Sanfeng admired him profoundly, now completely sure that Ding Ling was an expert predecessor. Otherwise, how could he suddenly counterkill a Demon Cultivator Expert?
And could master the Demon Cultivator Expert’s entire knowledge and absorb others’ True Qi for his use, that’s terrifying.
Ding Ling was unaware of Zhang Sanfeng’s thoughts.
After breaking through again.
He felt much more powerful than before in innumerable ways.
When he first crossed to this world, he was merely a Grandmaster.
But now?
He could easily instantly kill groups of Grandmasters!
Armed with the Xuanyuan Sword, understanding the Shattering High Tier of the Ten Thousand Dao Forest, slaying groups of Grandmasters, truly a simple task.
"I never realized I had become this strong. The so-called Grandmasters, in retrospect, are not much at all."
After reaching the High Tier of Shattering.
The True Water in Ding Ling’s Dantian condensed, sublimated, and transformed into something even purer and supreme!
The power derived from this True Water was naturally even more formidable!
"Xiaao Aoshi, died deservedly."
Ding Ling took the Emperor’s Sword from Xiaao Aoshi’s hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 681: Full Level Wudang Secret Skill
paragraphs: Emperor’s Sword, a divine sword that can amplify sword intent and sword qi by dozens of times!
Anyone who obtains it can fight beyond their level as if it’s nothing!
And Ding Ling has obtained it?
Boom!

With a fortyfold amplification of his own sword qi and sword intent injected into the Emperor’s Sword, a slight shake of the divine sword made the Sword Realm seem unable to withstand it, emitting thunderous and cracking sounds as if it might completely shatter at any moment.

Zhang Sanfeng was stunned and was about to shout, ’Young Hero, please stop!’ when Ding Ling had already dispersed the fortyfold amplified power! Yet even so, the Sword Realm continued to tremble incessantly, occasionally sending out a mournful cry.
Ding Ling was moved.
This Emperor’s Sword is too powerful.
It’s practically a cheat tool!
"Fiftyfold amplification, truly!"
With this Emperor’s Sword.
Plus his own fortyfold amplification power.
A total of ninetyfold amplification.
Ding Ling has become invincible already!
"Who in this world can be my match?!"
"Even the gods would be utterly slain by me!"
Ding Ling’s confidence soared!
He really did not expect that the Emperor’s Sword could amplify him by fiftyfold.
He thought he was stronger than Xiaao Aoshi and couldn’t be amplified by fiftyfold!
Now it seems he underestimated the upper limit strength value of the Emperor’s Sword!
This sword is terrifying beyond measure.
No one knows who created it!
"Could it be that Emperor Qin Shi Huang from this world created the Emperor’s Sword?"
Ding Ling pondered.

In this world, Martial Saint Guan Yu is extraordinarily powerful, his blade can even split black holes! Others do not even have time to react, and with one stroke of City-Overturning Love, a massive city disappears.
As for Emperor Qin Shi Huang, he was the Human Emperor during the Qin Dynasty!
Earlier than the Three Kingdoms Era!
Even more ancient!

Emperor Qin Shi Huang, as the Jiuzhou Human Emperor, unified Jiuzhou, unrivaled in might, must be an extremely powerful figure, to know this Wind and Cloud World is not an ordinary Mortal World, without absolute strength, how could one suppress all worlds, making masters from across Jiuzhou dare not breathe.
Until Emperor Qin Shi Huang died, Xiang Yu, Liu Bang and other legendary figures began to rise!
It shows how terrifying Emperor Qin Shi Huang was!

"If the Emperor’s Sword was forged and wielded by Emperor Qin Shi Huang, it makes sense, perhaps the amplification power within is a special power possessed by Emperor Qin Shi Huang that can infinitely amplify sword intent and sword qi!"
Ding Ling guessed, sent out a casual palm strike that landed on Xiaao Aoshi, shattering him completely to ashes!
Ding Ling had previously thought about destroying Xiaao Aoshi utterly.
And now he finally accomplished it.
Whiz!
Ding Ling stepped into the void, resembling a flash of lightning, instantly arriving before Zhang Sanfeng.
Zhang Sanfeng immediately performed a grand salute:
"Greetings, Senior!"
He was solemn and serious, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of admiration and respect.
Ding Ling was taken aback but slightly pondered and understood why Zhang Sanfeng called him Senior and didn’t want to take advantage of this virtuous master, so he told the truth.
Zhang Sanfeng was shocked:
"Is this true?"
"I have no reason to deceive you."
"...indeed."
Considering it, Zhang Sanfeng found it reasonable, involuntarily admiring the lofty heights:

"Even so, in martial arts, cultivation, and skill, Ding Ling you could entirely be my teacher, my senior. I hope to have the opportunity to receive your guidance in the future. That would be my honor."
Zhang Sanfeng said this, and Ding Ling could only smile lightly before saying:
"I am leaving now. Farewell."
"Please wait a moment."
Zhang Sanfeng reached out and called, then said:
"I have yet to properly thank Ding Ling for saving my life. Please accept my gratitude once more!"
Ding Ling reached out and supported him:
"No need for a bow. If you feel obligated, perhaps you could pass on all your knowledge to me?"
"Pass on martial arts?"
Zhang Sanfeng was puzzled:

"Ding Ling, your expertise is boundless, your inner power cultivation deep beyond what I can aspire to. Your martial arts are divine, able to wield Powers of Nature like wind, thunder, fire, and rain at will. Too great. My martial arts are extremely mediocre, how could they catch your eye?"
"Daoist, just pass them on. Of course, if you don’t want to, I won’t force you."
"The grace of saving my life is as great as the heavens. If passing on some ordinary martial arts can repay Ding Ling your kindness, I am willing."
Zhang Sanfeng was about to say more.
But Ding Ling said:
"This is as good as it gets. Please, Daoist, pass on the techniques."
Zhang Sanfeng opened his mouth, only able to suppress his words, nodded, and began imparting techniques.
He first imparted the Inner Power Heart Method.
But here, the spiritual vitality had already been completely absorbed.
So Ding Ling used the power of Nine Heavens Profound Wind, with a wave of his hand, to take Zhang Sanfeng to a region with abundant spiritual vitality, hundreds of miles away.
Indicating Zhang Sanfeng could begin.
Zhang Sanfeng then methodically began to speak.
His first method was the Inner Power Heart Method.
Once finished, Ding Ling recalled slightly.
The next moment.
[Wudang Nine Yang Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This is a technique similar to Nine Yang Divine Skill, yet possessing unique divine might.
Though inferior to Nine Yang Divine Skill.
But compared to ordinary martial arts, it’s much stronger.
At full level, the surging spiritual qi engulfed Ding Ling, rapidly refined by Ten Thousand Dao Forest into a colorful true qi.
Zhang Sanfeng was bewildered.
Learning it from just one hearing, and seemingly reaching the Great Perfection realm! What kind of divine being is this?!
Yet recalling Ding Ling’s previous actions, movements, and current age.
Though Zhang Sanfeng felt relieved, his heart was still wildly stirred, unable to calm down.
He soon passed on "Taihe Skill," "Pine Crane Heart Scripture," "Nine Heavens Primordial Qi," "Weak Water Soft and Easy Nine Transformations Skill" to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling reached full level for all.
But because these techniques were not as great as Nine Yang Skill and due to Ding Ling’s transcending strength, ordinary inner power heart methods no longer
provided assistance to him. Naturally, they did not increase Inner Power Value.
Yet even so.
Also made Ding Ling’s presence increasingly profound, pure, and extraordinary!
His foundation enhanced, the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace stood three-legged also increased.
"Continue."
Ding Ling glanced at Zhang Sanfeng.

Zhang Sanfeng, recovering from the shock, continued to speak about "Nine Dragon Lion Skill," "Tai Chi Profound Skill," "Cloud Ladder Ascension," "Thirty-Two Forms of Wudang Long Fist," "Cotton Palm," "Returning Wind Palm," "Mountain Shocking Palm," "Eight Trigrams Fist," "Tai Chi Pushing Hands," "Thousand Mountains Overlapping," "Eight Trigrams Dragon Palm," "Infinite Profound Skill Fist," "Nine Palace Divine Palm" and other martial arts.
Ding Ling learned them all instantly to full level!
Because although most martial arts were first-class, they did not reach Grandmaster Level Skill’s standard, thus not providing Attribute Points.
Only a scarce three or four achieved the Grandmaster Level Skill’s standard, offering Ding Ling agility: 0.5.
Zhang Sanfeng was completely speechless.
