chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 682: Sword Spirit Perfect Form
paragraphs: Zhang Sanfeng confirmed repeatedly that Ding Ling, aside from learning Tai Chi Fist in the Lower Realm and coincidentally mastering Tai Chi Sword, had not learned other supreme skills of the Wudang Sect.
Exactly because of this realization.
Seeing Ding Ling instantly mastering various supreme skills of the Wudang Sect to the level of Great Perfection, Zhang Sanfeng was deeply shaken, as if struck by lightning!
Later on!
Zhang Sanfeng became completely numb!
He even started to feel somewhat dazed!
He found it hard to believe that there actually existed a divine being like Ding Ling in the world!
Or perhaps...
The supreme skills of his Wudang Sect were too simple for a high-level person like Ding Ling?!
[Nine Palace Linked Sword Full Level]
[Lightly Drawn Sword Full Level]
[Profound Void Saber Technique Full Level]
[Wudang Night Traveling Saber Full Level]
[Thirty-nine Bridges Nodding in Unison Full Level]
After Zhang Sanfeng had passed on all his knowledge to Ding Ling.
A large part of the day had already passed.
It must be said.
Zhang Sanfeng was also a walking human martial arsenal!
The martial arts secret manuals he learned, understood, knew, and did not learn but remembered were too numerous!
It’s somewhat exaggerated to say endless as the sea, but having several hundred or even a thousand secret manuals is quite normal.
After Ding Ling broke through again.
He found that even Grandmaster Level skills could not provide him with assistance.
Only Grandmaster Level skills could provide assistance.
Thus, the vast majority of skills were merely at full level, providing foundation, serving as the material for evolution and sublimation for the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
But even so.
It was remarkable.
After all, the deeper one’s foundation, the more martial strength one can exert, and often one portion of strength can produce three or four times the effect due to the deep foundation!
"Thank you for passing on the skills."
Ding Ling expressed gratitude, then took out paper and pen from the Storage Pouch, and quickly wrote out two secret manuals to hand over to Zhang Sanfeng:
’These are the Sword God Breathing Technique and the Heart Technique of the World-Ending Demon Body. You take them. They’re enough to train to the Shattered Realm!’
The Sword God Breathing Technique, at the Shattered Realm, can also exert full power, truly miraculous!
To put it plainly.
This Breathing Technique is like the foundational strength of a person; everyone needs to forge their foundation, so naturally, it is needed!
As for the World-Ending Demon Body.
Many know this technique, and Bai Suzhen is generous and magnanimous, also looking for talents, and once found, she will voluntarily teach this World-Ending Demon Body.
I believe if Bai Suzhen saw Zhang Sanfeng, she would definitely generously bestow this technique, so Ding Ling felt there was no need to hide it.
However, Zhang Sanfeng did not know the details, and when he carefully looked over this technique, he was shocked and moved:
"This, this, this... This is too precious. I can’t accept it!"
In comparison to the many techniques he taught.
Just in terms of value, Ding Ling’s two techniques were enough to rival all the techniques he taught!
And he was passing on the techniques to repay the debt of saving his life.
Now receiving this technique, isn’t it equivalent to not repaying?
"Just take it without worry."

Ding Ling turned around, took a step, and instantly vanished from Zhang Sanfeng’s sight, like a stream of blue smoke rushing straight to the sky, disappearing in the blink of an eye, leaving only a hearty and bold voice reverberating endlessly in the void:
"Taoist priest, we’ll meet again if fate allows!"
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling!"
Zhang Sanfeng called out a few times, but there was no response.
He sighed deeply, looking at the two techniques in his hand, feeling somewhat touched and even more ashamed:
"No matter what, I will repay this favor when there’s a chance in the future!"
Zhang Sanfeng kept this gratitude in his heart, starting to meticulously study the two techniques, frequently displaying expressions of sudden enlightenment on his face.
His comprehension and talent had also reached an unbelievable level!
In the Lower Realm.
He had created quite a few methods and skills that could reach Grandmaster Level!
Now having obtained techniques that could lead straight to the Shattering Level!
He felt like parched land encountering nourishing rain!
Frantically absorbing the nutrients of this technique to enrich himself!
Visible to the naked eye.
In just a moment.
Mysterious aura began to emanate from Zhang Sanfeng’s body, indicating he had entered a state of enlightenment.
Ding Ling released the Sword Spirit from his body.
Swish swish!
The Sword Spirit began crazily absorbing Spiritual Light within a thousand-mile radius.
With each breath, the Sword Spirit would devour massive amounts of Spiritual Light.
Its speed of becoming stronger was unparalleled!
Its entire body solidified at a speed visible to the naked eye, becoming more substantial, majestic! Infinite, supreme!
In less than ten breaths of time!
The Sword Spirit stepped into the High Tier Peak state!
In another half an hour.
It stepped into the perfect form!
At this moment, the Sword Spirit’s body was already condensed as if a True Person!
Vividly lifelike!
Facial features, form, aura, even the clothing on its body were exactly the same as Ding Ling.
Standing with Ding Ling, they seemed like twins!

The only slight difference was that this Sword Spirit’s entire being exuded pure Sword Intent, Sword Qi, and Sword Thought! Its entire body radiated a piercing sword light, sharp and imposing, making it difficult for others to look directly at it!
This was a purely untainted Sword Spirit!
"To achieve the Great Perfection, it probably still takes a day."
Ding Ling glanced at the thousand-mile territory around:
"It’s much slower than I imagined, but that’s because the Spiritual Light here has become much more sparse."
The thousand-mile territory belonged to the Domain Territory.
This Domain Territory previously belonged to Jian Yue.
And Jian Yue’s unchecked absorption and devouring of Spiritual Light caused the amount of Spiritual Light to diminish significantly.
Although Spiritual Light can restore itself, it requires time, which may be measured in years.
And Ding Ling cannot wait that long.
"Even so, the Sword Spirit’s perfection. It’s definitely more powerful than the High Tier by at least three to five times."
Ding Ling felt the strength of the Sword Spirit, undoubtedly reaching the Shattering Level!
The mid stage of perfection is the Initial Tier of Shattering Level.
If it were the Great Perfection Peak.
It would definitely be the High Tier of Shattering Level, or even the Full Level of Shattering Level!
But Jian Yue clearly did not reach the High Tier of Shattering Level. His power was entirely borrowed from the Domain Crystal.
"It seems that Jian Yue has not reached the Great Perfection Level. Perhaps he just reached the Peak of Perfection?"
Ding Ling mused.
Even the dignified domain master Jian Yue had not reached the Great Perfection.
It would not be easy for his own Sword Spirit to achieve Great Perfection.
Indeed.
A day later.
The Sword Spirit reached the Peak of Perfection, only a step away from Great Perfection.
But just this one step was incredibly difficult to cross.
Ding Ling vaguely sensed that something crucial was missing.

"The Spiritual Light within a thousand miles is endless; though it has thinned greatly, it’s still enough for me to break through to the Initial Tier of Great Perfection form. But failing to break through is because of the lack of a quintessential Yin Sword Thought, Sword Intent, and Sword Qi!"
Only through the fusion of Yin and Yang!
Can the Sword Spirit become flawless, entering a state of Great Perfection.
And the so-called quintessential Yin Sword Qi, Sword Intent exists within the Sword Pool!
"Sword Pool."
Jian Yue did not go to the Sword Pool, or rather, he was unable to defeat the domain expert within the Sword Pool, so he could not achieve Great Perfection?

chapters.title: Chapter 694 683: Wuming and Little Zhao in the Sword Sea
paragraphs: What's the truth of the matter?
It's impossible to know.
After all, Jian Yue is already dead.
But Ding Ling was already prepared to venture into the Sword Realm, so naturally, he didn't give up on going to the Sword Pool.
"Let's take a look outside the domain first."
Whoosh!

Ding Ling stepped into the void, covering a thousand feet in an instant. With the Sword Spirit's support, his speed within the domain was unbelievably fast, almost like instant teleportation. In a few strides, he was outside the domain.
Upon reaching outside the domain,
his speed slowed down.
That was because the Domain Crystal lost its effect!
"It seems the Domain Crystal only exerts its strongest effect within its own domain. It's not without use in other realms either; at the very least, it can stabilize the Sword Spirit's form.
But compared to its invincible form within the domain, it's worlds apart."
Although Ding Ling felt a bit regretful,
he didn't dwell on it.
He was already well aware of this.
Moreover, the purpose for obtaining the Domain Crystal was basically achieved.

If not for the Domain Crystal, the Sword Spirit could not have devoured the Sword Scorpion for evolution or easily killed Xiaao Aoshi, and it certainly couldn't have evolved to the Peak of Perfection Form in just over a day!
It was because of the Domain Crystal.
The evolution of the Sword Spirit was spared countless years!
If the Sword Spirit were to evolve on its own to the Perfect Form, it would definitely take hundreds or thousands of years.

With the Domain Crystal, it saved at least hundreds of years of evolution time, which shows how terrifying it is. This is why other Sword Spirits and Residual Spirits are so desperately trying to seize it.
"Once I obtain a bit of pure Supreme Yin Sword Intent, Sword Thought, and Sword Qi, I can return here to devour the Spiritual Light and evolve to the Great Perfection Form."
The Spiritual Light within the domain has dimmed greatly.
But it is enough for the Sword Spirit to step into the Great Perfection Form!
Now, what's missing is just a bit of pure Supreme Yin Sword Intent and Sword Thought!
Whoosh!
A pair of Vast Sea Wings emerged from behind Ding Ling.

These are Sword Wings formed from the Azure Sea Wings Swordsmanship! With a slight flutter, Ding Ling could ascend to the clouds like a flash of sword light, providing an unparalleled boost to his speed!
"Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling shuttled through the high skies of the Sword Realm, his eyes ablaze with light as he looked down at the lower realm.
Through the Eye of the Sword Spirit,
Ding Ling saw everything clearly.
This Sword Realm, indeed, from sky to earth, was filled with Sword Intent, Sword Thought, and Sword Qi.
This is a world for swordsmen! No other extraneous material exists!
"Huh!"
After flying a thousand miles, Ding Ling suddenly sensed something unusual in the void ahead.
It seemed because the Sword Qi and Sword Thought here were not pure, but rather mixed with an extremely evil, dark, and chaotic aura.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling arrived instantly, temporarily abandoning the Eye of the Sword Spirit to use his normal human eyes to observe, and found that this was indeed the Sword Pool from the Sword Scorpion's memories!
At a glance,
the Sword Pool seemed to have undergone changes in just over a day.

It was evident that the interference of players and the increase in swordsmen led to more slaughter within the Jiuzhou Territory, and evil thoughts were growing at a terrifying speed! The changes in the Sword Pool naturally followed as a matter of course.
Therefore,
what Ding Ling saw in the Sword Pool was not really a pool, but rather a sea that was impossible to see the edge of with just one look!
"The Sword Realm is experiencing turmoil, even Zhang Sanfeng and others have inexplicably been drawn in; it seems something mysterious and unknown is quietly happening."
Ding Ling looked towards the sky.
There, a serpentine rift had torn open.
The unusual changes Ding Ling previously saw through the Eye of the Sword Spirit emanated from there!
Distorted and strange serpentine figures poured out from the rift.
They roared and howled but seemed extremely wary of the Sword Realm. Before long, they fled back into the serpentine rift.
"What kind of ghostly place is that?"
Ding Ling carefully perceived, suddenly his expression changed slightly, and he uncontrollably looked towards the direction of the Sword Pool.
Sure enough.
He saw two familiar figures.
"Little Zhao, Wuming!"
The two were in the Sword Pool, no, the depths of the Sword Sea, drifting up and down.
Little Zhao had a profound and terrifying Sword Intent erupting around her!
Wuming seemed to be struggling against some kind of spiritual object, with a pained expression.
Ding Ling was shocked.
How did Little Zhao and Wuming appear in the Sword Sea?

Without thinking, Ding Ling gave a slight flutter of his Vast Sea Wings from behind, whoosh! Ding Ling, like lightning cutting through clouds, unleashed a boundless storm and reached above Little Zhao with a swift motion, then reached out to grab her.
Boom!

Suddenly, a surge of extreme black Sword Qi erupted from Little Zhao, the Sword Qi shot towards Ding Ling's brow as if to kill him. Ding Ling's brow twitched, his Sword Wings fluttered and spun, carrying him into a flip to evade and formed a sword shield in front of him with a clanging sound.
Boom!
The black Sword Qi pierced through the sea with immense oppressive power, and in the roaring sound, it pierced through the sword shield, shooting towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling's face changed dramatically, since when did Little Zhao become so strong!
It seems someone is controlling Little Zhao's body.
Who is it?
Could it be a spirit like Jian Yue? Is he, or she, possessing Little Zhao?
Ding Ling was shocked and uncertain. Without hesitation, he amplified his power forty times, casually pointing forward, unleashing the Six Meridian Divine Sword!
A dazzling Sword Qi shot out from Ding Ling's fingertips, colliding with the black Sword Qi, boom boom boom!
They collided like auroras clashing violently, in the roaring sound, the black Sword Qi and the Sword Qi of the Six Meridian Divine Sword dissipated into nothingness.
"Huh?"

Someone in the dark seemed very surprised by this; after a sigh of astonishment, whoosh! Little Zhao walked out from the Sword Sea unhurriedly, like a sea deity riding the waves. Her eyes were utterly murky, no longer having the crystal brightness of the past.
She tilted her head to look at Ding Ling, full of wonder:
"Such strong Sword Intent and Sword Qi, who are you?"
"Who are you!"
Ding Ling shouted angrily:
"Why possess the body of a weak girl."
"... She is not weak."
Little Zhao paused and then shook her head, saying,

"She is a peerless genius, possessing a pure Perfect Supreme Sword Bone. Now, twelve of us have combined our efforts to forge her Supreme Sword Bone into a Tongtian Sword! With this sword as the core, her entire skeleton has now transformed into Sword Bone! Thus, she can withstand our twelve persons' astonishing Sword Intent and Sword Thought!
Now, she has fully withstood our Sword Intent and Sword Thought.
She could be said to be the strongest in this Sword Realm.
How could she be weak?"
Ding Ling was taken aback, Little Zhao possessing a Sword Bone was something he hadn't detected, which indicates the Sword Bone must have been deeply hidden in a place he didn't know.

sentences.text: What's the truth of the matter?
It's impossible to know.
After all, Jian Yue is already dead.
But Ding Ling was already prepared to venture into the Sword Realm, so naturally, he didn't give up on going to the Sword Pool.
"Let's take a look outside the domain first."
Whoosh!
Ding Ling stepped into the void, covering a thousand feet in an instant.

In a few strides, he was outside the domain.
Upon reaching outside the domain,
his speed slowed down.
That was because the Domain Crystal lost its effect!
"It seems the Domain Crystal only exerts its strongest effect within its own domain.
It's not without use in other realms either; at the very least, it can stabilize the Sword Spirit's form.
But compared to its invincible form within the domain, it's worlds apart."
Although Ding Ling felt a bit regretful,
he didn't dwell on it.
He was already well aware of this.
Moreover, the purpose for obtaining the Domain Crystal was basically achieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 684: Cleaving the Sword Realm
paragraphs: But even so, it is not a reason for this group to possess Little Zhao.
Thinking of their claim to be twelve people, Ding Ling associated it with the scenes in Sword Scorpion's memory, and couldn't help but loudly shout:
"Are you the Twelve Sword Stars?!"
"Exactly."
Little Zhao's voice suddenly changed, as if twelve people spoke simultaneously:
"We are the Sword Stars of the Twelve Swords in the Sword Pool!"
"Since you are the Twelve Sword Stars, why forcefully possess her body!"
"The great change of heaven and earth allows us Twelve Sword Stars to escape from the Sword Pool, to achieve our true selves!"
The Twelve Sword Stars spoke in unison, their voices booming like thunder:
"When the time for the true self arrives, a person with the Perfect Supreme Sword Bone suddenly appeared in this Sword Pool, which clearly must be fate sent by heaven! How can we miss this?
Now our sword intent, sword thought, and sword qi are engraved in her bones, meridians, and dantian. Our true selves have also merged into her sea of consciousness!
We the Twelve Sword Stars are in your heart as Little Zhao, and Little Zhao is us! Why treat us so distantly?"
"Nonsense!"
Ding Ling angrily shouted:
"Shameless!"
Boom!
Ding Ling fiercely initiated the Supreme Sword Dao of Heartless Dao!
Whizz whizz whizz!

The densely packed Spirit Killing Sword formed into a Sword River, launching with Ding Ling's fortyfold amplification power, as if a galaxy flowing down from ninefold heaven, rushing toward Little Zhao in an instant!
Just as it was about to cover Little Zhao, the Twelve Sword Stars shouted clearly:
"Heaven and Earth, Only My Dao!"
Little Zhao extended her hand forward, clang! Threads of sword qi and sword intent condensed into a net before her, blocking the roaring galaxy-like Spirit Killing Sword!
"Celestial Thunder Guiding Sword!"
The Twelve Sword Stars shouted again!
Her left hand pointed toward Ding Ling's position!
A thunderous explosion sounded, the void became filled with storm clouds, and a blinding lightning bolt struck down from above, swiftly aiming towards Ding Ling!
Ding Ling was shocked; the Twelve Sword Stars were far stronger than he imagined!

It seems that the achievement of their true self must involve some unknown mysterious transformation, which caused them to suddenly evolve into an extremely terrifying realm. This realm even surpassed the understanding of Sword Scorpion!
Because in Sword Scorpion's knowledge, the Twelve Sword Stars were not this strong!
Now they can easily block his Spirit Killing Sword and still have the strength to counterattack!
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly, without hesitation, initiated the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao!
A punch aimed at the lightning.
Thunder Strike Fist!

Lightning traversed the sky, condensed within the fist, followed by the punch, boom! Striking the incoming lightning, the two collided and blended in the void, crackling and fizzing, mutually dissolving into nothing.
Little Zhao's expression changed, the Twelve Sword Stars' voices echoed across Heaven's Edge:

"Such a strong young man! You seem even more talented than Little Zhao. What a pity. If we had encountered you earlier, we would have definitely forged you into a Heaven-Reaching Divine Sword! But now it's too late! Nonetheless, your physique and sword intent are extremely strong; keeping you as a backup plan isn't wrong. Haha, you may withstand two swords from us, but can you withstand three swords, five swords, or even ten swords?"
"Take this move! All Things Become My Sword!"
Little Zhao formed seals with her hands, and shouted!
In the void, dense spiritual light and evil thought materialized, within a breath, transformed into countless sharp swords!
In less than the blink of an eye.
Around Little Zhao, in all directions, throughout nine heavens and ten earths, were covered with sharp swords!
She looked sacred, her whole body radiating brilliant sword light, resembling a Sword Saint descending to the mortal world.
Her hand seal quickened, suddenly pointed forward, the dense sharp swords became Sword Rain, whizzing harshly through the air, covering, pouring toward Ding Ling!
The speed of Sword Rain was too fast!
It seemed like a gust of wind and lightning!
In one moment, they were hundreds of meters away, in the next, they were right at hand!
Ding Ling didn't overthink.
He took out the Emperor's Sword to amplify himself!
Then a fortyfold amplification of himself!
After a ninefold amplification!
Ding Ling stabbed toward the direction of Sword Rain!
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root!

With a single stab, countless vigorous qi transformed into sword qi, smashing toward the Sword Rain, resembling Mount Tai crushing eggs, more like the sky collapsing, it shattered forward with crushing speed!
Where the vigorous qi reached, like rotten wood being shattered, all sword qi was dissolved away!
Whizz whizz whizz!
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root, with ninetyfold amplification, powerfully tore apart the void and Sword Realm!
The seemingly powerful Sword Rain, under this move, only resisted for an instant before dispersing into smoke!
Crack!
Under Ding Ling's deliberate control!
This sword split open the Sword Realm, creating a huge chasm!
Ding Ling walked with the Free-Will Ascension Step, holding the Emperor's Sword, in the dense flying vigorous qi, smoothly advancing to Little Zhao's side:
"Twelve Sword Stars! This is the end!"
If not for concerns, afraid of damaging Little Zhao's body.
Ding Ling would have already struck Little Zhao with his sword, even the formidable Twelve Sword Stars facing this move would perish!
But doing so would also mean Little Zhao's death, which Ding Ling obviously cannot do.
Thus, he chose to split open the Sword Realm, forcing the Twelve Sword Stars to evade to a certain position, thereby achieving his goal.
And indeed, as he thought!
Facing this earth-shattering, seemingly capable of fully cleaving the Sword Realm sword.
The Twelve Sword Stars were shocked, incredulous:
"Is this a human sword technique?! Why is it so strong! Not good! We can't avoid this, quick dodge!"

The Twelve Sword Stars, driven by their survival instinct, flashed sideways, landing right in the crack Ding Ling created, Ding Ling immediately followed, striking the back of Little Zhao with a palm. Whap!
Directly hitting Little Zhao's back, making her groan, involuntarily falling toward the depths of the chasm.
Ding Ling swiftly followed like light and electricity.
Moments later.
In the Sword Realm, the huge chasm just split open by the Emperor's Sword, began to close again.
The Sword Sea, stirred with waves by the vigorous qi, rolling out thousands of waves, started to calm down.
And the other spiritual objects living in the Sword Sea, looked at each other, clearly seeing the shock in each other's eyes.
"Unbelievable, how can such a strong person exist in this world!"
"Too terrifying! This person seems to come from the Sword Mountain. He seems to have the aura of a Domain Crystal. Could he be a king from a certain realm of Sword Mountain?!"
"If Sword Mountain has such a strong person, Yin and Yang oppose and complement, achieving each other, there's no reason our Sword Pool doesn't have a corresponding king appearing!"

"Just now, Little Zhao was already a new generation leader. Too bad, she was still defeated by this incredible strong person. Who exactly is he? What is his origin? Will he return to the Sword Pool? If he comes, how will we resist?"

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 685: Twelve Sword Stars
paragraphs: The spiritual objects within the Sword Pool were discussing fervently.
The spiritual objects in Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness seemed to be stirred.

He was none other than Mo Kui, the leader of all spiritual objects in the Sword Pool, also reputed as the strongest in the Sword Realm, witnessing Ding Ling shatter the void and slice through the Sword Realm with one stroke, he was equally apprehensive, thinking:
"This person is too terrifying. He seems to know Little Zhao and Wuming. Could he be their acquaintance?"
With this thought, he then inquired Wuming about it.
Wuming’s consciousness body was surrounded by the ever-surging Sword Intent of Supreme Sword Dao, forming a defensive Sword Shield around him, he gazed coldly at Mo Kui and said:
"He is Ding Ling, the New Emperor of Jiuzhou, the supreme ruler! I consider him a friend. If you don’t want to die, you’d better let me leave now and stop entangling with me endlessly!"
Wuming never imagined he would have a day using others as leverage to intimidate someone.
But times change.
The Jiuzhou World is no longer what it used to be.
Though strong, he is far inferior compared to Ding Ling, and with Ding Ling as the New Emperor of Jiuzhou, acting as his backer seemed reasonable.
Thinking thus, Wuming felt relieved.
"Are you truly friends?"
Mo Kui asked with uncertainty.
"Whether or not, you may know in some time."
Wuming was also unsure if Ding Ling would purposefully return to the Sword Realm to save him, so could only choose to delay the time.
Mo Kui seemed to read through Wuming’s thoughts, snorted, and said:
"If you cooperate with me, I wouldn’t take over your body. Sadly, you remain obstinate!"
He paused momentarily, then continued:
"Nowadays the world is undergoing great changes, the Sword Pool has expanded countless times. As the strongest in the Sword Pool, I, Mo Kui, have grown incredibly powerful as the tide rises.

Any single one of the Twelve Sword Stars challenging me, would be crushed by me. They fear being killed and having their domain seized by me, hence opted to join forces creating a sword array to perfectly harness their combined supreme skills.
Yet even so, the twelve of them together barely matched me.
So strong am I, why would I fear Ding Ling?!"
He seemed to be encouraging himself.
But the tone betrayed a hint of insecurity, anyone could hear it.
Wuming was no exception, he chuckled softly:

"Ding Ling’s progress far surpasses yours, Mo Kui. Given time he will grow stronger; by then you might lack even the qualification to negotiate with him. Before you anger him, you’d best let me go immediately."
"Hmph."
Mo Kui remained unmoved:
"Once I succeed in possessing your body, I will immediately leave the Sword Realm. The world is vast, no matter how high Ding Ling’s skills are, how could he find me when I deliberately hide?
Mo Kui was extremely covetous towards Wuming,
Merely because Wuming’s talent was truly extraordinary!
Now, with the expansion of the Sword Pool making him stronger, the possibility of possessing Wuming was not improbable!
Jiuzhou.
The human realm.
Above the East Sea.

A graceful figure was surrounded by streaks of Sword Qi, flying rapidly like streamers upon the Sword Qi, boom! Suddenly a silhouette descended from above, stamping on the void heavily in front of her, the force seemingly cracked the void:
"Twelve Sword Stars! Where are you fleeing?!"
The newcomer was Ding Ling.
And the owner of the graceful figure was Little Zhao.
At this moment, blood seeped from Little Zhao’s lips, evidently suffering not minor injuries, her eyes still dazed, only her exquisite face etched with shock and disbelief:
"Young man, do not push people too far."
"It was you who bullied Little Zhao first."
Ding Ling wielded the Emperor’s Sword, his attire billowing in the fierce wind, his aura deep as an abyss, with sword intent surging like the sea, standing amid the void, akin to a Wind God.
He gazed dispassionately at Little Zhao and said:
"Roll out from Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness immediately, I may spare you! Otherwise bear the consequences!"
"Hmph!"
The Twelve Sword Stars collectively snorted in anger, as if the twelve shouting:
"Who knows who will triumph, don’t be overly arrogant!"
Little Zhao suddenly clasped her hands forming seals again, shouting:
"Dazzling Color Annihilation!"
Boom!
A sword light dazzling to the extreme suddenly surged from Little Zhao’s body!
As this sword light emerged, even the sun seemed to pale by comparison.
Between heaven and earth, there seemed to remain only this pure sword light.
In the ocean, many species even without intentionally gazing at this sword light, were momentarily blinded.
Transforming into frantic blind creatures!
Ding Ling, relying on the Dao of the Ten Thousand Dao of Forest Guard, had pre-sensed this, closing his eyes timely, utilizing the Eye of the Sword Spirit to counter this move!

Thus as the Twelve Sword Stars unleashed this move, Ding Ling’s closed eyes remained unharmed, and the Eye of the Sword Spirit clearly saw, after employing this move, Little Zhao immediately executed another Unrivaled Sword Technique.
Her form lively, within the dazzling sword light, she clasped her hands forming seals, conjuring a Sword Pool from thin air!
Then pointed towards Ding Ling.
The force of the Sword Pool within, like a gentle rain, doused upon Ding Ling.
The Eye of the Sword Spirit perceived clearly.
Such a move.
Evidently borrowing the unmatched power of the Sword Realm’s Sword Pool, if within the Sword Realm, this move’s effect would increase tenfold, several times!
Fortunately, in Jiuzhou. Otherwise, Ding Ling might need to exert full force to break it!
Now, during this move.
Ding Ling slightly raised the Emperor’s Sword, a ninety-fold amplified Emperor Sword Dao shot forth a Sword Qi, akin to a War God wielding spear sweeping thousands in an instant.
Boom!
Like autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves, with a loud roar, Sword Qi forcibly pierced through the power of the Sword Pool!
As the Emperor’s Sword repeatedly emitted Sword Qi.
The Sword Pool shattered into fragments amidst the roar.
Little Zhao groaned, unable to resist retreating a step, blood trickled again at her lips.
"How is it possible?!"
The voice of the Twelve Sword Stars roared, exceptionally loud:
"You’re not blind!"
"Actually able to block Dazzling Color Annihilation! This move even gods, caught off guard, would be blinded, how did you avoid that?!"
The Twelve Sword Stars initially baffled and stunned.
But sensing Ding Ling’s overflowing Sword Spirit Qi, they suddenly understood:
"You’ve cultivated into an extraordinary Sword Spirit Body!"
They were astonished:
"Throughout ages, how many Residual Spirits have existed, yet few cultivate an extraordinary Sword Spirit Body, how did you achieve that?! Could it be..."
They seemed to have realized something:

"Jian Yue was killed by you. You took his Domain Crystal?! Certainly. We sensed upheaval and turmoil at the Sword Mountain location earlier. But we were occupied perfecting the Supreme Sword Bone, unable to handle multiple tasks, now it seems clear! Definitely back then you killed Jian Yue!"
They collectively were shaken:
"Jian Yue was the king of Sword Mountain territory. We dared not duel him in his domain, as we would surely lose. How did you kill him?!"

The spiritual objects in Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness seemed to be stirred.

He was none other than Mo Kui, the leader of all spiritual objects in the Sword Pool, also reputed as the strongest in the Sword Realm, witnessing Ding Ling shatter the void and slice through the Sword Realm with one stroke, he was equally apprehensive, thinking:
"This person is too terrifying.
He seems to know Little Zhao and Wuming.
Could he be their acquaintance?"
With this thought, he then inquired Wuming about it.
Wuming’s consciousness body was surrounded by the ever-surging Sword Intent of Supreme Sword Dao, forming a defensive Sword Shield around him, he gazed coldly at Mo Kui and said:
"He is Ding Ling, the New Emperor of Jiuzhou, the supreme ruler!
I consider him a friend.
If you don’t want to die, you’d better let me leave now and stop entangling with me endlessly!"
Wuming never imagined he would have a day using others as leverage to intimidate someone.
But times change.
The Jiuzhou World is no longer what it used to be.
Though strong, he is far inferior compared to Ding Ling, and with Ding Ling as the New Emperor of Jiuzhou, acting as his backer seemed reasonable.
Thinking thus, Wuming felt relieved.
"Are you truly friends?"
Mo Kui asked with uncertainty.
"Whether or not, you may know in some time."
Wuming was also unsure if Ding Ling would purposefully return to the Sword Realm to save him, so could only choose to delay the time.
Mo Kui seemed to read through Wuming’s thoughts, snorted, and said:
"If you cooperate with me, I wouldn’t take over your body.
Sadly, you remain obstinate!"

"Nowadays the world is undergoing great changes, the Sword Pool has expanded countless times.
As the strongest in the Sword Pool, I, Mo Kui, have grown incredibly powerful as the tide rises.
Any single one of the Twelve Sword Stars challenging me, would be crushed by me.
They fear being killed and having their domain seized by me, hence opted to join forces creating a sword array to perfectly harness their combined supreme skills.
Yet even so, the twelve of them together barely matched me.
So strong am I, why would I fear Ding Ling?!"
He seemed to be encouraging himself.
But the tone betrayed a hint of insecurity, anyone could hear it.
Wuming was no exception, he chuckled softly:
"Ding Ling’s progress far surpasses yours, Mo Kui.
Given time he will grow stronger; by then you might lack even the qualification to negotiate with him.
Before you anger him, you’d best let me go immediately."
"Hmph."
Mo Kui remained unmoved:
"Once I succeed in possessing your body, I will immediately leave the Sword Realm.
The world is vast, no matter how high Ding Ling’s skills are, how could he find me when I deliberately hide?
Mo Kui was extremely covetous towards Wuming,
Merely because Wuming’s talent was truly extraordinary!
Now, with the expansion of the Sword Pool making him stronger, the possibility of possessing Wuming was not improbable!
Jiuzhou.
The human realm.
Above the East Sea.
A graceful figure was surrounded by streaks of Sword Qi, flying rapidly like streamers upon the Sword Qi, boom!
Suddenly a silhouette descended from above, stamping on the void heavily in front of her, the force seemingly cracked the void:
"Twelve Sword Stars!
Where are you fleeing?!"
The newcomer was Ding Ling.
And the owner of the graceful figure was Little Zhao.

"Young man, do not push people too far."
"It was you who bullied Little Zhao first."

"Roll out from Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness immediately, I may spare you!
Otherwise bear the consequences!"

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 686: Little Zhao’s Transformation
paragraphs: The Twelve Sword Stars felt as if their entire worldview had been overturned!
What kind of formidable person is Jian Yue?
Invincible within his domain!
Even Mo Kui wouldn’t dare to challenge him one-on-one in Jian Yue’s domain.
Naturally, the Twelve Sword Stars wouldn’t dare either!
Such an unbeatable sword spirit, actually dead?!
Thinking about it makes them feel bewildered and their hearts tremble!
They could not accept this fact for the moment!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling took advantage of the Twelve Sword Stars’ momentary distraction and immediately struck with a sword, knocking Little Zhao out of the void, who then fell onto an island in the East Sea!
Ding Ling followed closely, moving swiftly like a flash of lightning.

He reached the island before Little Zhao and casually thrust his sword, causing a small mountain to crumble into dozens of pieces. Ding Ling then used the Dragon Capturing Skill, scattering these fragments in an orderly manner, in an instant.
Boom! An Eight Array Map sprang up from the ground, with Ding Ling sitting at its center, unleashing a tumult of clouds and winds, fog rising and Evil Qi shooting straight into the sky!
Snap!
Just as Little Zhao, who had fallen on the island, tried to ascend, he immediately realized he couldn’t get out, as if trapped in a maze.
"What grand array is this?"
The Twelve Sword Stars spoke in unison, their voices booming throughout the Ten Directions Realm:
"How is it possible to set up such a powerful odd array so quickly?!"
Ding Ling’s speed was too fast.
In an instant, the Eight Array Map was completed.
The Twelve Sword Stars didn’t react in time. By the time they realized it was an array map, it was too late.
They tried to break through several times.

However, this island was extraordinary, containing boundless Spiritual Vitality, which enhanced the Eight Array Map. As a result, the map’s power was not lacking compared to when it was supported by Celestial Might.
Moreover, since the core of this array had Ding Ling wielding the Emperor’s Sword, it made the Eight Array Map unbreakable and immensely powerful!
The Twelve Sword Stars attempted to manipulate Little Zhao’s body to break through the map several times but failed.
With Ding Ling sitting at the core, amplifying the array ninety times over, the trapping ability of this Eight Array Map was terrifyingly extreme!
The Twelve Sword Stars could not understand after several attempts.
They could only wander irritably within the array map, trying to find a solution.
Initially, they were careful with Little Zhao’s body, considering it might become their future vessel.
But as time passed.
In the blink of an eye, several days went by.
They felt the lack of Evil Thoughts and Demonic Thoughts in Little Zhao’s body. If this continued, they would inevitably become weaker, causing them to lose control and roar:
"If we’re not let out soon, we’ll devour Little Zhao! Let all your hard work be in vain."
"Is it really intolerable?"
Ding Ling had learned from the Sword Scorpion’s memory.
That the spiritual objects living in the Sword Pool must devour Evil Thoughts, Demonic Thoughts! If not consumed, their power would gradually decline until they eventually died!
And since Little Zhao had fallen from the Sword Realm without taking lives, naturally, there were no Evil Thoughts to nurture the Twelve Sword Stars!

Moreover, Little Zhao’s consciousness was trapped, and being a kind and upright character, it was impossible for Demonic Thoughts to arise. So unless the Twelve Sword Stars escaped soon, went to the Sword Pool, or traveled around killing others to devour their Evil Thoughts and Demonic Thoughts, they would grow weaker!
Understanding this,
is why Ding Ling chose to trap the Twelve Sword Stars first.
He couldn’t bring himself to harm Little Zhao’s body, so he could only trap the enemy.
Otherwise, this battle would have been over long ago.
Now the other party wanted to use Little Zhao as a threat, which seemed to suggest they had run out of options.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling immediately let the Sword Spirit walk out of his shell, controlling it so that the Sword Spirit moved like a light, traversing various locations within the Eight Array Map.
Because Ding Ling understood the Eight Array Map so well, he could ambush the Twelve Sword Stars.
Whoosh!

At this moment, the Twelve Sword Stars were scurrying like headless chickens within the Eight Array Map. The Sword Spirit seized the opportunity, suddenly entering Little Zhao’s body, darting into Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness with lightning speed. It glanced around quickly and spotted Little Zhao trapped at the core of the Sea of Consciousness.
Little Zhao sat cross-legged, eyes closed, with her hands forming seals. Mysterious auras rose from her body, and the black corrosive qi around her couldn’t harm her at all.
"Is this the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique? Or the World-Ending Demon Body? Or some other method?"
Ding Ling saw traces of various divine skills from the seals Little Zhao formed with her hands, quietly astonished.
How long had it been?
Little Zhao had comprehended the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique to this degree?
It seemed she had gained an extraordinary destiny and opportunity.
No wonder she could resist the corrosive qi from the Twelve Sword Stars.
However, the protective barrier formed by the mysterious aura was growing thinner, and it wouldn’t last much longer.

Ding Ling didn’t hesitate. Suddenly, he appeared before Little Zhao, casually pointed, and invoked Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root! A myriad of Sword Qi danced in the air, converging into a net to protect Little Zhao.
"Young master."
Little Zhao seemed to sense something, opened her eyes, saw Ding Ling, and felt a surge of joy as she exclaimed.
’Continue to concentrate and maintain your composure. Protect yourself.’
Ding Ling said.
"Yes, young master."
Little Zhao solemnly nodded, closed her eyes again, and quickly moved her hands, forming mysterious seals!
Perhaps Ding Ling’s presence gave Little Zhao immense courage and confidence.
Or was it accumulated strength manifesting suddenly? Spiritual light and inspiration burst forth?
Her hand seals seemed to achieve a breakthrough amidst this emergency, becoming stronger and more ethereal, and the protective light for her soul expanded from one foot to ten feet instantly!
"How is this possible?!"
The Twelve Sword Stars all turned, surprised, then angered:
"No more holding back, attack!"

Earlier, they didn’t want to kill Little Zhao’s consciousness, intending to perfectly seize everything that was Little Zhao. This way, they could fully integrate with Little Zhao’s Perfect Supreme Sword Bone, enhancing their future potential.
If they forcibly killed Little Zhao, her potential would be greatly diminished, adversely affecting their future, so they were cautious.
But as days passed, they grew weaker! Coupled with Ding Ling’s sudden intrusion and Little Zhao’s breakthrough, it seemed to provoke them.
Making them realize if they didn’t end Little Zhao, they might not have a future at all.
Thus, their actions were ruthless this time.
"Invert Heaven and Earth!"

The Twelve Sword Stars also organized themselves in Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness. Originally, six of them maintained the stability of the Sea of Consciousness, but now four immediately split off, leaving only two to maintain it:
"Young man, don’t make a mistake! We spared Little Zhao, which is why she isn’t dead. If you keep pushing us.
The mutual destruction will leave no victor."
"Let me say something to you as well."
Ding Ling glanced at the Twelve Sword Stars:
’Leave Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness now, and I won’t pursue this matter further.’
"Do you think we will believe you?"
The Twelve Sword Stars responded in unison.

One of them could no longer hold back, dispersing the hand seal that had been prepared long ago. In an instant, a Sword Qi infused with Ying and Yang Qi, with the force to invert Heaven and Earth, shot rapidly towards the center of Ding Ling’s brow.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 687: Profound Yin Twelve Swords
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s figure blurred, and in an instant, transformed into twenty-one swordsman shadows.
In each swordsman’s hand, an invisible sword materialized!
Each swordsman was practicing a top-tier sword skill!

As Ding Ling’s figure moved, in an instant, sword qi shot out, transforming into sword rain that collided head-on with Yin Yang Sword Qi, shattering it in a blink, then continued with an unstoppable force towards the Twelve Sword Stars!

The Twelve Sword Stars, seeing this, shouted in unison, and the two Sword Stars maintaining the stability of the Sea of Consciousness began to cooperate with the other ten Sword Stars, intending to suppress and eliminate the Sword Spirit controlled by Ding Ling.
It was when all twelve of them were distracted dealing with the Sword Spirit.
Ding Ling’s true body had already "Shrinking Inches" appeared beside Little Zhao, then holding the Emperor’s Sword, fifty times power amplification, followed by another forty times amplification.
A full ninety times amplification of the Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Boom!

A torrent of Spirit Killing Sword suddenly covered Little Zhao’s figure, and under the Sword Spirit’s guidance, this time the Spirit Killing Sword seemed to find its coordinates, rushing into the Sea of Consciousness like a Sword River, as fast as wind or lightning!
"What?!"
The other Twelve Sword Stars sensed something, awakened in unison and looked, but it was already too late.
The Spirit Killing Sword swept over like a galactic waterfall, and in just an instant, it hit their backs.
"Ah!"
The Twelve Sword Stars roared in anger simultaneously:
"Go for broke!"
"We can’t hold back anymore!"
"This strike is too strong, we can’t stop it!"
Boom!

The Twelve Sword Stars formed a Sword Array, all twelve exhibiting their might, each Sword Star excelling in an unparalleled sword skill, at this moment, infusing the essence of what they had learned into the Sword Array, boom! The Sword Array shot out boundless radiance, the soaring sword intent seemed able to annihilate everything!
Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness couldn’t fully withstand it, about to completely shatter!
Ding Ling thought darkly that things were not going well.
Immediately controlled the torrent of Spirit Killing Sword!

With lightning speed, amidst a booming sound, it struck the Sword Array, breaking the sword intent, shattering the Sword Array, then like a Flying Rainbow with halo light, swept up and directly carried the Twelve Sword Stars out of the Sea of Consciousness.
The Sword Spirit, upon seeing this, immediately began stabilizing the Sea of Consciousness.
Little Zhao’s speed of becoming stronger had already surpassed ordinary imagination.
Moreover, the Twelve Sword Stars seemed to have reinforced the Sea of Consciousness.
Making Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness exceptionally strong, incomparable to ordinary people.

If not for this, the power of this blow would have long shattered this Sea of Consciousness, but even so, the Sea of Consciousness was on the verge of collapse, as if it might disintegrate at any moment.
Little Zhao, stationed at the core of the Sea of Consciousness, was pale-faced, swaying unsteadily, as if about to disperse into smoke at any moment.
The Sword Spirit could only exert all its strength to maintain the stability of the Sea of Consciousness.
He knew that the Sea of Consciousness required the true body’s ninety times amplified power to settle, otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to maintain it for long!
Boom!

After Ding Ling’s torrent of Spirit Killing Sword swept the Twelve Sword Stars out of the Sea of Consciousness, he didn’t hesitate to once again use ninety times amplification of Heartless Dao, densely covered Spirit Killing Sword descended like obliterating the sky and earth, annihilating the Twelve Sword Stars in an instant.

The Twelve Sword Stars didn’t even have time to let out a scream before their spiritual bodies were pierced through, dispersing into smoke, leaving only a faint trace like a meteor’s tail swinging in the void!
This spiritual light was extremely thin, dim, invisible to the naked eye and imperceptible.
Only the Eye of the Sword Spirit saw it!
Ding Ling knew this was the ’Supreme Yin Spirit’ belonging to the Twelve Sword Stars! It was the substance needed for the Sword Spirit to break through to Great Perfection.

He reached out towards the void, capturing these spiritual lights through the Eye of the Sword Spirit, attempting to merge them into his own body, but no matter what, the spiritual light wouldn’t merge in.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling, though perplexed, thought for a moment, then flicked his hand.
He flicked all these spiritual lights towards Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness.
As the spiritual light entered the Sea of Consciousness, the Sword Spirit opened its mouth and inhaled, swooooosh! The twelve spiritual lights flowed into his mouth like streams merging into the sea.
In an instant.
The aura on the Sword Spirit increased explosively, as if a broken moon was mended, becoming complete, harmonious, and supremely natural!
Not only that.
The Sword Spirit’s body also gained a total of twelve intricate and complex sword intents.
These were precisely the unique sword skills from the Twelve Sword Stars.
Ding Ling gently recalled in his mind.
[Profound Yin Twelve Swords Full Level]
[Agility +2.4]
The sword intent on the true body became even more powerful!
Twelve different Great Perfection sword intents fused into one, transforming into a giant sword, piercing straight into the sky, momentarily breaking through the clouds, revealing the azure sky.
On this island, there was actually someone hidden all along.
That someone was Emperor Shitian.
What Ding Ling didn’t know was.
This island was the true Phoenix Island that Emperor Shitian valued.
Except for him who knew the exact location of this Phoenix Island, no one else knew.
As for the rumored locations of Phoenix Island spread externally, they were merely cultivation spots for some disciples’ Phoenix Island, naturally a blinding technique to mislead others.
Emperor Shitian left this Phoenix Island to have a secret refuge in case he encountered a formidable enemy he couldn’t handle in the future.
Therefore.
He arranged numerous Mist Arrays around this Phoenix Island, making it impossible for anyone externally to see this island, let alone talk about it being leaked.
However, what Emperor Shitian never imagined was that even after hiding so meticulously here, he was still discovered?!

At this moment, Emperor Shitian looked at the profound sword intent rising from Ding Ling’s position, and his legs started trembling, then without hesitation, he turned around, leaped into the sea, dove into the seabed like a swimming fish, and then crazily fled!
His heart was filled with extreme fear:

"That’s definitely Ding Ling, right? It must be him! Too familiar! Never imagined, after not seeing him for a while, his skills had already advanced to such a pinnacle, making me frightened and awe-struck at this Supreme Realm! This is a peerless genius a hundred, even a thousand times more terrifying than Wu Wudi!"
Emperor Shitian simply couldn’t comprehend how Ding Ling cultivated.
How could he have cultivated to such an unbelievably terrifying Martial Arts Realm in just a few decades?
Wasn’t Wu Wudi a genius?
Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun were even once-in-a-millennium talents.
But compared to Ding Ling?
They were completely like great witches encountering a greater witch!
Ding Ling was like a celestial immortal descended to the mortal world, his cultivation progress speed defied all logic, rules, and principles!

"Earlier, when I watched Ding Ling battle with the Immortal God through the Eagle, I was astonished by his might, thus I quickly left, not even returning to the Celestial Sect. Because Ding Ling’s speed was too fast, I feared if I returned to the Celestial Sect and got blocked by him, I’d be doomed with nowhere to retreat or advance!"
Back then, Ding Ling’s northward journey clearly aimed at the Celestial Sect.
Moreover, when Ding Ling battled with the Immortal God, the speed he demonstrated was at least ten times faster than when he first fought me, Emperor Shitian!

sentences.text: Ding Ling’s figure blurred, and in an instant, transformed into twenty-one swordsman shadows.
In each swordsman’s hand, an invisible sword materialized!
Each swordsman was practicing a top-tier sword skill!

As Ding Ling’s figure moved, in an instant, sword qi shot out, transforming into sword rain that collided head-on with Yin Yang Sword Qi, shattering it in a blink, then continued with an unstoppable force towards the Twelve Sword Stars!

The Twelve Sword Stars, seeing this, shouted in unison, and the two Sword Stars maintaining the stability of the Sea of Consciousness began to cooperate with the other ten Sword Stars, intending to suppress and eliminate the Sword Spirit controlled by Ding Ling.
It was when all twelve of them were distracted dealing with the Sword Spirit.
Ding Ling’s true body had already "Shrinking Inches" appeared beside Little Zhao, then holding the Emperor’s Sword, fifty times power amplification, followed by another forty times amplification.
A full ninety times amplification of the Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Boom!

A torrent of Spirit Killing Sword suddenly covered Little Zhao’s figure, and under the Sword Spirit’s guidance, this time the Spirit Killing Sword seemed to find its coordinates, rushing into the Sea of Consciousness like a Sword River, as fast as wind or lightning!
"What?!"
The other Twelve Sword Stars sensed something, awakened in unison and looked, but it was already too late.
The Spirit Killing Sword swept over like a galactic waterfall, and in just an instant, it hit their backs.
"Ah!"
The Twelve Sword Stars roared in anger simultaneously:
"Go for broke!"
"We can’t hold back anymore!"
"This strike is too strong, we can’t stop it!"
Boom!

The Twelve Sword Stars formed a Sword Array, all twelve exhibiting their might, each Sword Star excelling in an unparalleled sword skill, at this moment, infusing the essence of what they had learned into the Sword Array, boom!
The Sword Array shot out boundless radiance, the soaring sword intent seemed able to annihilate everything!
Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness couldn’t fully withstand it, about to completely shatter!
Ding Ling thought darkly that things were not going well.
Immediately controlled the torrent of Spirit Killing Sword!

With lightning speed, amidst a booming sound, it struck the Sword Array, breaking the sword intent, shattering the Sword Array, then like a Flying Rainbow with halo light, swept up and directly carried the Twelve Sword Stars out of the Sea of Consciousness.
The Sword Spirit, upon seeing this, immediately began stabilizing the Sea of Consciousness.
Little Zhao’s speed of becoming stronger had already surpassed ordinary imagination.
Moreover, the Twelve Sword Stars seemed to have reinforced the Sea of Consciousness.
Making Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness exceptionally strong, incomparable to ordinary people.

If not for this, the power of this blow would have long shattered this Sea of Consciousness, but even so, the Sea of Consciousness was on the verge of collapse, as if it might disintegrate at any moment.
Little Zhao, stationed at the core of the Sea of Consciousness, was pale-faced, swaying unsteadily, as if about to disperse into smoke at any moment.
The Sword Spirit could only exert all its strength to maintain the stability of the Sea of Consciousness.
He knew that the Sea of Consciousness required the true body’s ninety times amplified power to settle, otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to maintain it for long!
Boom!

After Ding Ling’s torrent of Spirit Killing Sword swept the Twelve Sword Stars out of the Sea of Consciousness, he didn’t hesitate to once again use ninety times amplification of Heartless Dao, densely covered Spirit Killing Sword descended like obliterating the sky and earth, annihilating the Twelve Sword Stars in an instant.

The Twelve Sword Stars didn’t even have time to let out a scream before their spiritual bodies were pierced through, dispersing into smoke, leaving only a faint trace like a meteor’s tail swinging in the void!
This spiritual light was extremely thin, dim, invisible to the naked eye and imperceptible.
Only the Eye of the Sword Spirit saw it!
Ding Ling knew this was the ’Supreme Yin Spirit’ belonging to the Twelve Sword Stars!
It was the substance needed for the Sword Spirit to break through to Great Perfection.

He reached out towards the void, capturing these spiritual lights through the Eye of the Sword Spirit, attempting to merge them into his own body, but no matter what, the spiritual light wouldn’t merge in.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling, though perplexed, thought for a moment, then flicked his hand.
He flicked all these spiritual lights towards Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness.
As the spiritual light entered the Sea of Consciousness, the Sword Spirit opened its mouth and inhaled, swooooosh!
The twelve spiritual lights flowed into his mouth like streams merging into the sea.
In an instant.
The aura on the Sword Spirit increased explosively, as if a broken moon was mended, becoming complete, harmonious, and supremely natural!
Not only that.
The Sword Spirit’s body also gained a total of twelve intricate and complex sword intents.
These were precisely the unique sword skills from the Twelve Sword Stars.
Ding Ling gently recalled in his mind.
[Profound Yin Twelve Swords Full Level]
[Agility +2.4]
The sword intent on the true body became even more powerful!
Twelve different Great Perfection sword intents fused into one, transforming into a giant sword, piercing straight into the sky, momentarily breaking through the clouds, revealing the azure sky.
On this island, there was actually someone hidden all along.
That someone was Emperor Shitian.
What Ding Ling didn’t know was.
This island was the true Phoenix Island that Emperor Shitian valued.
Except for him who knew the exact location of this Phoenix Island, no one else knew.
As for the rumored locations of Phoenix Island spread externally, they were merely cultivation spots for some disciples’ Phoenix Island, naturally a blinding technique to mislead others.
Emperor Shitian left this Phoenix Island to have a secret refuge in case he encountered a formidable enemy he couldn’t handle in the future.
Therefore.
He arranged numerous Mist Arrays around this Phoenix Island, making it impossible for anyone externally to see this island, let alone talk about it being leaked.
However, what Emperor Shitian never imagined was that even after hiding so meticulously here, he was still discovered?!

At this moment, Emperor Shitian looked at the profound sword intent rising from Ding Ling’s position, and his legs started trembling, then without hesitation, he turned around, leaped into the sea, dove into the seabed like a swimming fish, and then crazily fled!
His heart was filled with extreme fear:
"That’s definitely Ding Ling, right?
It must be him!
Too familiar!
Never imagined, after not seeing him for a while, his skills had already advanced to such a pinnacle, making me frightened and awe-struck at this Supreme Realm!
This is a peerless genius a hundred, even a thousand times more terrifying than Wu Wudi!"
Emperor Shitian simply couldn’t comprehend how Ding Ling cultivated.
How could he have cultivated to such an unbelievably terrifying Martial Arts Realm in just a few decades?
Wasn’t Wu Wudi a genius?
Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun were even once-in-a-millennium talents.
But compared to Ding Ling?
They were completely like great witches encountering a greater witch!
Ding Ling was like a celestial immortal descended to the mortal world, his cultivation progress speed defied all logic, rules, and principles!
"Earlier, when I watched Ding Ling battle with the Immortal God through the Eagle, I was astonished by his might, thus I quickly left, not even returning to the Celestial Sect.
Because Ding Ling’s speed was too fast, I feared if I returned to the Celestial Sect and got blocked by him, I’d be doomed with nowhere to retreat or advance!"
Back then, Ding Ling’s northward journey clearly aimed at the Celestial Sect.
Moreover, when Ding Ling battled with the Immortal God, the speed he demonstrated was at least ten times faster than when he first fought me, Emperor Shitian!

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 688: Sword Spirit Great Perfection
paragraphs: It was precisely because he felt his path blocked, unable to outrun Ding Ling.
That’s why Emperor Shitian decided to retreat first.
Although he had several experts to assist him,
those around Ding Ling, such as the Demon Lord and Wuming, were also very strong. The most critical factor was that Ding Ling himself was too powerful, and he had no confidence in stopping him.
Facts proved
his guess was correct.
The Celestial Sect was easily annihilated by Ding Ling.
The team of Japanese experts led by Xiaao Aoshi was also slaughtered by Ding Ling, reaching the Otherworld at one point!
This was something Emperor Shitian had just learned through a Pigeon Post.
He marveled at Ding Ling’s prowess.

Then Ding Ling descended from the sky with a sixteen-year-old maiden, battling intensely in the void, leaving Emperor Shitian terrified and astonished, not knowing how Ding Ling appeared out of nowhere above Phoenix Island!
This Phoenix Island could be hidden from others,
but how could it be hidden from Ding Ling?
Emperor Shitian was frightened, immediately hiding, not daring to run, just observing on the side, thus witnessing the entire battle process.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling seemed to be practicing some Sword Skill, he dared not hesitate further, with a splash, he jumped into the water, diving deep into the sea, choosing to head west.
In Emperor Shitian’s view, even hiding on this godforsaken Phoenix Island!
Yet he was still found by Ding Ling!
Who could guarantee that hiding in other remote places, he wouldn’t encounter Ding Ling?

Therefore, he decided to return to the Central Plains once more. This time, he would disguise and change identities to hide in plain sight! He didn’t believe that hidden among the masses of millions, Ding Ling could still find him!
Besides.
He needed to wait for the right opportunity, seek fortune, and become stronger!
This cowardly, hiding life was not what Emperor Shitian desired!
Ding Ling was unaware there was someone on Phoenix Island.
Only because he had all his attention focused on the Twelve Sword Stars and naturally had no time to pay attention to other matters.
He didn’t even know the name of this island,
only felt the massive Spiritual Vitality contained within it, which moved his heart to use this island as the base to lay out the Eight Array Map to delay time.
In his confrontation with the Twelve Sword Stars, he had to be at his absolute best, so how could Ding Ling notice someone so well-hidden on this island?

However, though it was the case, when Emperor Shitian leaped into the water, he did have a sense of it, only he was engrossed in understanding the Profound Yin Twelve Swords at the time, so he did not pay attention to the anomaly.

After all, it was above the East Sea, filled with countless swimming fish, and some small animals on the island would be startled and flee during the fighting, many diving into the sea. Ding Ling had become used to it, so he didn’t pay it special attention.
Now, with the Profound Yin Twelve Swords at Full Level,
Ding Ling profoundly felt the terror of this Sword Skill.
"No wonder it can increase agility by 2.4 points. So these twelve swords represent twelve supreme Sword Skills!"
Who exactly are the Twelve Sword Stars?
Were they grown from the Residual Spirit of some ancient swordsman?
Ding Ling did not know,
but he did know one thing clearly:
These twelve Sword Skills had been practiced and studied to an Extreme Realm!
The intricate sword maneuvers eventually condensed into one sword!
Hence, these twelve Sword Skills can also be called the Twelve Swords!
And these twelve swords finally refined into one, forming a set of Sword Skills!
That is the current Profound Yin Twelve Swords!

The Profound Yin Twelve Swords include: Heaven and Earth, Only My Dao; Celestial Thunder Guiding Sword; All Things Become My Sword; Heaven and Earth Let Me Go; All Living Beings Are Destroyed by Me; Two-Level Bounce My Sword; Dazzling Color Annihilation; Sword Scorpion’s Cross and Vertical Movement; Instant Cold Reflecting Thousands of Years; Yin Yang Reversing Heaven and Earth; Sword Demon Born of the Heart; All Things Chaos Destruction.
Every sword move is terrifying to the extreme.
Ding Ling had previously faced several moves directly.
Moreover, these twelve swords can also form a Sword Array.
Arranged into one Ultimate Technique: Six Paths Reversal, No Rival,
In addition.
When the Profound Yin Twelve Swords reach a certain level, they can naturally form a ’Profound Yin Sword Armor’ for protection.
"Offensive and defensive, truly extraordinary."

Ding Ling looked at Little Zhao, utilizing his ninety-fold self-amplification, wielded the Profound Yin Sword Armor, boom! The Sword Armor fell on Little Zhao, then integrated into her Sea of Consciousness, stabilizing the precarious, seemingly on the verge of collapse, Sea of Consciousness in an instant!
The ninety-fold amplified Profound Yin Sword Armor was frightening, terror beyond words.
Changing the heavens and earth was all but trivial.
Stabilizing Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness naturally was a breeze.
The next moment.
"Young Master!"
Little Zhao awoke, calling out with bright eyes.
"Hmm.
Ding Ling smiled and nodded, with a thought, the Sword Spirit darted from Little Zhao’s Sea of Consciousness into his own body, boom! The Sword Spirit entered his body.
Ding Ling’s aura became even deeper, boundless!
The Sword Spirit had evolved again, reaching the Initial Tier of Great Perfection!

It just needed to return to the Sword Realm, absorb enough Spiritual Light, and it could naturally reach the Peak of Perfection. Upon reaching that step, the Sword Spirit would be able to walk freely in the real world like a True Person.
It could exist independently of Ding Ling’s form in the world.
If it did not reach the Peak of Perfection,
it couldn’t exist away from Ding Ling for too long.

It’s like Jian Yue and the Twelve Sword Stars, leaving the shelter of the Sword Realm, coming to the world, without a host, or having seized others, or without special fortune, etc., exposed to various places in Jiuzhou for long without absorbing Sword Thought and such, they would wither to death on their own even without enemies killing them!
Only upon reaching the Peak of Great Perfection
can it achieve a certain degree of ’fasting,’ meaning existing for long without needing to absorb ’Sword Thought’ and such.
"Jian Yue cannot achieve Great Perfection. It seems there’s no way to kill masters like the Twelve Sword Stars."
Ding Ling pondered:

"Jian Yue, outside the domain, seems to be at the level of the Twelve Sword Stars! Naturally, they cannot be killed, and thus cannot deprive this Supreme Yin’s Sword Intent, Sword Thought, and Sword Qi."
Invincible within the domain.
Limited power outside the domain.
"And for as strong as the Twelve Sword Stars are, they don’t have Domain Crystals. It seems my previous assumption was wrong."
"Perhaps only a very few exceptional geniuses can obtain a Domain Crystal. Perhaps, in the Sword Realm, only Jian Yue has a Domain Crystal?"
This probability is high.
Considering even the Twelve Sword Stars do not have one.
The probability of other spirits lacking it is greater.
"Why does Jian Yue have one? Besides being a peerless genius, perhaps because he is a complete and pure spirit?"
While the Twelve Sword Stars and others might be derived from residual spirits, souls, and thoughts.
Thus they lack the qualification to find and refine the Light of Dawn!
"That should be correct."
Ding Ling sighed.
In this sense.
The fact that he could kill Jian Yue was truly a stroke of luck.
However, fortunately, Jian Yue perished, enhancing his Sword Spirit; otherwise, he wouldn’t have navigated the Sword Realm so smoothly.
"How do you feel?"
