chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 689: Mo Kui
paragraphs: Ding Ling looked at Little Zhao and asked:
"Do you feel anything different?"
"I feel so strong now."
Little Zhao blinked her bright, sparkling eyes and said crisply:
"It’s like I could shatter the void and leave at any moment."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s heart stirred, and he asked Little Zhao to extend her hand.
He placed his hand on Little Zhao’s wrist and carefully sensed it.
With that sensing, he was taken aback.
It was because Little Zhao’s cultivation had undergone an earth-shattering transformation.
Leaving aside the fact that the Eight Extraordinary Meridians were completely unblocked.
Many small, hidden channels had also been thoroughly penetrated by a fine, dense Sword Qi.
And this Sword Qi was omnipresent, spread throughout Little Zhao’s Dantian, meridians, and bones.
Especially within the Dantian.

A total of seventy-one colorful drops of True Water had formed a ’Sword Array Reincarnation Circle’, continuously spinning, absorbing Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi, and automatically refining Sword Qi.
And as this continuous refinement of Sword Qi progressed.
Little Zhao’s cultivation rose with the tide!
"Is this an unparalleled Fundamental Technique?"
Ding Ling had only obtained the Sword Skill of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords.
But he had not acquired this Technique.
And without any doubt.
Little Zhao had not only obtained this Technique.
But it had also reached the state of Great Perfection, automatically operating within her Dantian, meridians, continuously strengthening her.
Not only was the Technique perfected.
The Sword Skill of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords seemed to be engraved into the essence of this Technique.
The Sword Intent of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords filled every part of Little Zhao’s meridians, omnipresent!

"Not only that, it seems Little Zhao is indeed as the Twelve Sword Stars said, possessing a perfect Sword Bone. Especially this spine, brilliant and shining, as sharp as the Supreme Divine Sword, too dazzling to look at directly."
Ding Ling was moved.
Little Zhao’s cultivation had instantly reached the Middle Stage of Shattering Realm, leaving aside!
Her related Techniques and Laws were all perfect or at Great Perfection.
Instantly saving hundreds of years of hard work for ordinary people.
This was a great fortune!
"Remarkable."
Ding Ling explained the truth to Little Zhao, who was both surprised and delighted, but amidst the joy, there was also an unavoidable sense of apprehension.
Ding Ling inquired about the cause.
Little Zhao then revealed the truth.
It turned out that the day the Sword Realm opened, after being drawn in with Xiaao Aoshi, Bai Suzhen also entered.
Subsequently, Little Zhao and Wuming entered one after the other.
Little Zhao was unfortunately caught near the Twelve Sword Stars by the Sword Pool, where she experienced fear, coercion, and promises of advantages, the bitterness of which was indescribable.
Wuming wanted to save Little Zhao but ended up trapped himself, seemingly engaged in a ’life and death battle’ of the Sea of Consciousness with some powerful Spiritual Object from the Sword Pool.
This was something Little Zhao sensed in the dark.
As for Bai Suzhen?
Little Zhao only knew she seemed to have been drawn into a more mystical world.
"More mystical."
Ding Ling pondered thoughtfully.
At that moment.
He remembered the snake-shaped opening in the sky above the Sword Realm.
"Wuming got into trouble because he saved you, he must be saved."
Ding Ling took out the Emperor’s Sword, sensed the direction of the Sword Realm, and casually slashed toward the void, instantly cleaving a massive opening.
This opening coincided with the Sword Pool.
From here, one could directly reach the Sword Pool.
If one went to the Celestial Sect region, perhaps they could reach the Sword Mountain region.
The Sword Realm was vast.

Entering from different places, one could naturally reach different regions, and to avoid getting separated from Little Zhao, Ding Ling deliberately held onto Little Zhao’s hand. Little Zhao did not resist, her face blushing slightly, a bit shy but soon, she proactively held Ding Ling’s hand.

Previously, she also wanted to take the initiative, but she lacked the courage, feeling that her status, cultivation, and strength were too far behind Ding Ling’s, unworthy of Ding Ling, and only hoped to spend her life by Ding Ling’s side, serving him, content to be a maidservant.
Since Ding Ling saved her.
Alone and dependent on no one, she decided to follow Ding Ling for the rest of her life.
Now that she had become stronger, she gained some confidence and dared to proactively hold Ding Ling’s hand, something she wouldn’t have dared before.

Ding Ling was oblivious to the thoughts of Little Zhao’s maiden heart, he merely glanced at this island and then, using the Free-Will Ascension Step, transformed into a streak of light, pulling Little Zhao, and flew into the opening.
This island was quite mystical.
Having sensed its uniqueness, Ding Ling decided that he might build a villa here for cultivation in the future.
Sword Realm.
Sword Pool.
Ding Ling had returned once again.
His arrival caused the spiritual objects in the Sword Pool to be surprised and agitated.
Wuming was also pleasantly surprised.
He had been waiting for days, almost in despair.
Unexpectedly, things took a turn for the better, and Ding Ling actually came back to save him!
At this moment.
Even someone as composed as him couldn’t help but feel a turmoil in his heart; he thought that if he were saved this time, he would owe Ding Ling too much and must repay this kindness in the future.
"Shoo shoo!"

Upon seeing Wuming, Ding Ling did not say a word but repeated the process, his Sword Spirit leaving his body, transforming into a stream of light, and entering Wuming’s body, arriving at the core of the Sea of Consciousness, where he saw Wuming’s vague conscious form and a ferocious-looking Spiritual Object, akin to an Evil Ghost.
"Ding Ling."
Wuming called out.
He was almost obliterated from being suppressed by the Mo Kui.

If not for the Supreme Sword Dao being powerful enough, with his extraordinary Sword Soul and Sword Bone reaching the Celestial Sword Realm, and with strange energy from this Sword Realm supporting him, he might have been killed by the Mo Kui long ago!
Now that he saw Ding Ling, he naturally breathed a sigh of relief.
If Ding Ling had not come.
He couldn’t have held on.
Ding Ling hadn’t even asked questions yet.
Wuming quickly relayed the basic details about the Mo Kui to Ding Ling, clearly and comprehensively.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, Mo Kui felt a jolt in his heart, especially sensing Little Zhao’s surging and pure Profound Yin Sword Intent from the outside, causing his expression to change dramatically:
"The Twelve, the Twelve Sword Stars, they..."
"They are dead."
Ding Ling’s eyes shifted toward Mo Kui, coldly saying:
"Do you want to live or die?"
"Of course I want to live."
Upon hearing that the Twelve Sword Stars were indeed dead, Mo Kui’s heart trembled, and he couldn’t help but show a frightened expression.
Though he touted himself as the strongest in the Sword Realm.
Not even putting Jian Yue and others in his eyes.
But he knew his own capabilities well.
Jian Yue, the Twelve Sword Stars, they could each dominate an area.
While they were inferior to him in many aspects, they surpassed him in others.
If the Twelve Sword Stars joined forces, they could contend with him.
However, such strong figures were easily eliminated by Ding Ling, leaving aside the fact that outside, Little Zhao seemed to have inherited the fortunes and skills of the Twelve Sword Stars entirely!
Such a benevolent deed of dying and giving all one’s learning and fortune freely to another, Mo Kui could not commit.
"If you want to live, then get out of Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness, or else, you will promptly die."
Mo Kui felt both frightened and uncertain, hesitating.
If he were to leave the Sea of Consciousness.
And if Ding Ling were to go back on his word, wouldn’t he die even faster?

sentences.text: Ding Ling looked at Little Zhao and asked:
"Do you feel anything different?"
"I feel so strong now."
Little Zhao blinked her bright, sparkling eyes and said crisply:
"It’s like I could shatter the void and leave at any moment."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s heart stirred, and he asked Little Zhao to extend her hand.
He placed his hand on Little Zhao’s wrist and carefully sensed it.
With that sensing, he was taken aback.
It was because Little Zhao’s cultivation had undergone an earth-shattering transformation.
Leaving aside the fact that the Eight Extraordinary Meridians were completely unblocked.
Many small, hidden channels had also been thoroughly penetrated by a fine, dense Sword Qi.
And this Sword Qi was omnipresent, spread throughout Little Zhao’s Dantian, meridians, and bones.
Especially within the Dantian.

A total of seventy-one colorful drops of True Water had formed a ’Sword Array Reincarnation Circle’, continuously spinning, absorbing Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi, and automatically refining Sword Qi.
And as this continuous refinement of Sword Qi progressed.
Little Zhao’s cultivation rose with the tide!
"Is this an unparalleled Fundamental Technique?"
Ding Ling had only obtained the Sword Skill of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords.
But he had not acquired this Technique.
And without any doubt.
Little Zhao had not only obtained this Technique.
But it had also reached the state of Great Perfection, automatically operating within her Dantian, meridians, continuously strengthening her.
Not only was the Technique perfected.
The Sword Skill of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords seemed to be engraved into the essence of this Technique.
The Sword Intent of the Profound Yin Twelve Swords filled every part of Little Zhao’s meridians, omnipresent!
"Not only that, it seems Little Zhao is indeed as the Twelve Sword Stars said, possessing a perfect Sword Bone.
Especially this spine, brilliant and shining, as sharp as the Supreme Divine Sword, too dazzling to look at directly."
Ding Ling was moved.
Little Zhao’s cultivation had instantly reached the Middle Stage of Shattering Realm, leaving aside!
Her related Techniques and Laws were all perfect or at Great Perfection.
Instantly saving hundreds of years of hard work for ordinary people.
This was a great fortune!
"Remarkable."
Ding Ling explained the truth to Little Zhao, who was both surprised and delighted, but amidst the joy, there was also an unavoidable sense of apprehension.
Ding Ling inquired about the cause.
Little Zhao then revealed the truth.
It turned out that the day the Sword Realm opened, after being drawn in with Xiaao Aoshi, Bai Suzhen also entered.
Subsequently, Little Zhao and Wuming entered one after the other.
Little Zhao was unfortunately caught near the Twelve Sword Stars by the Sword Pool, where she experienced fear, coercion, and promises of advantages, the bitterness of which was indescribable.
Wuming wanted to save Little Zhao but ended up trapped himself, seemingly engaged in a ’life and death battle’ of the Sea of Consciousness with some powerful Spiritual Object from the Sword Pool.
This was something Little Zhao sensed in the dark.
As for Bai Suzhen?
Little Zhao only knew she seemed to have been drawn into a more mystical world.
"More mystical."
Ding Ling pondered thoughtfully.
At that moment.
He remembered the snake-shaped opening in the sky above the Sword Realm.
"Wuming got into trouble because he saved you, he must be saved."
Ding Ling took out the Emperor’s Sword, sensed the direction of the Sword Realm, and casually slashed toward the void, instantly cleaving a massive opening.
This opening coincided with the Sword Pool.
From here, one could directly reach the Sword Pool.
If one went to the Celestial Sect region, perhaps they could reach the Sword Mountain region.
The Sword Realm was vast.
Entering from different places, one could naturally reach different regions, and to avoid getting separated from Little Zhao, Ding Ling deliberately held onto Little Zhao’s hand.
Little Zhao did not resist, her face blushing slightly, a bit shy but soon, she proactively held Ding Ling’s hand.

Previously, she also wanted to take the initiative, but she lacked the courage, feeling that her status, cultivation, and strength were too far behind Ding Ling’s, unworthy of Ding Ling, and only hoped to spend her life by Ding Ling’s side, serving him, content to be a maidservant.
Since Ding Ling saved her.
Alone and dependent on no one, she decided to follow Ding Ling for the rest of her life.
Now that she had become stronger, she gained some confidence and dared to proactively hold Ding Ling’s hand, something she wouldn’t have dared before.

Ding Ling was oblivious to the thoughts of Little Zhao’s maiden heart, he merely glanced at this island and then, using the Free-Will Ascension Step, transformed into a streak of light, pulling Little Zhao, and flew into the opening.
This island was quite mystical.
Having sensed its uniqueness, Ding Ling decided that he might build a villa here for cultivation in the future.
Sword Realm.
Sword Pool.
Ding Ling had returned once again.
His arrival caused the spiritual objects in the Sword Pool to be surprised and agitated.
Wuming was also pleasantly surprised.
He had been waiting for days, almost in despair.
Unexpectedly, things took a turn for the better, and Ding Ling actually came back to save him!
At this moment.
Even someone as composed as him couldn’t help but feel a turmoil in his heart; he thought that if he were saved this time, he would owe Ding Ling too much and must repay this kindness in the future.
"Shoo shoo!"

Upon seeing Wuming, Ding Ling did not say a word but repeated the process, his Sword Spirit leaving his body, transforming into a stream of light, and entering Wuming’s body, arriving at the core of the Sea of Consciousness, where he saw Wuming’s vague conscious form and a ferocious-looking Spiritual Object, akin to an Evil Ghost.
"Ding Ling."
Wuming called out.
He was almost obliterated from being suppressed by the Mo Kui.

If not for the Supreme Sword Dao being powerful enough, with his extraordinary Sword Soul and Sword Bone reaching the Celestial Sword Realm, and with strange energy from this Sword Realm supporting him, he might have been killed by the Mo Kui long ago!
Now that he saw Ding Ling, he naturally breathed a sigh of relief.
If Ding Ling had not come.
He couldn’t have held on.
Ding Ling hadn’t even asked questions yet.
Wuming quickly relayed the basic details about the Mo Kui to Ding Ling, clearly and comprehensively.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, Mo Kui felt a jolt in his heart, especially sensing Little Zhao’s surging and pure Profound Yin Sword Intent from the outside, causing his expression to change dramatically:
"The Twelve, the Twelve Sword Stars, they..."
"They are dead."
Ding Ling’s eyes shifted toward Mo Kui, coldly saying:
"Do you want to live or die?"
"Of course I want to live."
Upon hearing that the Twelve Sword Stars were indeed dead, Mo Kui’s heart trembled, and he couldn’t help but show a frightened expression.
Though he touted himself as the strongest in the Sword Realm.
Not even putting Jian Yue and others in his eyes.
But he knew his own capabilities well.
Jian Yue, the Twelve Sword Stars, they could each dominate an area.
While they were inferior to him in many aspects, they surpassed him in others.
If the Twelve Sword Stars joined forces, they could contend with him.
However, such strong figures were easily eliminated by Ding Ling, leaving aside the fact that outside, Little Zhao seemed to have inherited the fortunes and skills of the Twelve Sword Stars entirely!
Such a benevolent deed of dying and giving all one’s learning and fortune freely to another, Mo Kui could not commit.
"If you want to live, then get out of Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness, or else, you will promptly die."
Mo Kui felt both frightened and uncertain, hesitating.
If he were to leave the Sea of Consciousness.
And if Ding Ling were to go back on his word, wouldn’t he die even faster?
